In the lands of Lordran, the Flame subsides to soon become complete Darkness. Will the Chosen Undead embrace self sacrifice, linking the Flame and removing the Undead Curse, or will one become the Dark Lord and usher in the new age of Darkness.

Dark Souls Remastered is a fantasy role-playing game released in 2018 by FromSoftware Inc and is a remaster of Dark Souls. It is well renowned and infamous for being difficult and unforgiving in nature. For new players to the series, this game may prove quite a challenge with its inherent difficulty. Compared to the later titles Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin & Dark Souls III, it is much slower and clunkier than those games, and at times more forgiving.

What is this guide? This guide aims to create an easier and streamlined pathway to acquiring the Platinum Trophy. This guide was made for Dark Souls Remastered; however, you may use this guide for the original release of Dark Souls. The walkthrough provided in this guide is for strictly Offline play, but you may trade with other players through boosting sessions through this site.

What lies ahead? If you are not a fan of collecting items, there is a plethora of things to do that are tied to trophies. The majority of these items are missable, so consider any item colorized missable, or potentially missable if you don't clean up prior to finishing a playthrough. There is minimal grinding required compared to the original Dark Souls and the other 2 titles, as Item Discovery is much more friendly in this game.

The difficulty of this guide is based on the guide author's suggestion to a new player to the series, who follows this guide and utilizes the Soul Duplication Glitch. This difficulty may be higher or lower depending on your personal skill level. If you have the help of other players through summoning, the difficulty will decrease even further. If there are any tips or strategies not provided in this guide that will help you, please feel free to use those in lieu to suit your own playstyle.

Because of this, it is recommended you follow the suggested routes and pick up items, even if they are not required for trophies. Items of interest or missables will be bolded and have a specific color to get your attention. Those are shown below:

Guide Color Legend

This will be used quite frequently through the walkthrough. This commonly refers to items that you can loot off corpses throughout the Loot game, acquired items from enemies or bosses, and for items that you can purchase from merchants.

This color is used to identify Soul Items used for levelling up purposes. Soul Items As this guide relies heavily on the level of your character for acquiring spells or some additional items, and to make easy work of bosses and enemies, Soul Items will differ from loot.

Embers are key items required to upgrade weapons to certain levels Embers and to put infusions on them. These will be numbered as well, so you can check them off as you collect them.

This refers to enemies and bosses that you will encounter throughout the game. Some friendly NPCs later become enemies, but will not be Enemies referred to as such until that time.

This also refers to hostile Dark Spirits that may invade you.

Allies You will come across NPCs throughout the game that are friendly or non-hostile towards you. As a general rule, if they don't attack you, don't attack them. These characters may have items to sell you, may help you out, or are generally nice.

Merchants that sell items will also be assigned this color.

If an item is in this color, it is important and is required for the Unique Weapons Knight's Honor trophy. These weapons should be considered extremely missable or hard to find. Some have very poor RNG drop rates and some farming may be required.

Boss souls that are required for these weapons are also covered under this color assignment.

Throughout the playthrough you come across miracles that are required for Prayer of a Maiden. This color will also refer to items

that may be required for, or will acquire you a miracle. These are all considered missable.

Items that are required for covenant levels that unlock miracles will also be assigned this color.

There will be other spells you need to collect that are pyromancies. All of these are easily found, but are considered missable. The majority are

purchased through merchants, so keep an eye out for them when they are mentioned in the walkthrough. These pyromancies are required for Bond of a Pyromancer.

Sorceries are identified by this color and will be the main spell type that will be used for this walkthrough. Most are purchased by merchants,

but some are highly missable and require questlines of certain NPCs. These spells are required for Wisdom of a Sage.

This BOLD text will be used to highlight something important such an action or place the Guide Author wants to highlight to you. This will Other mainly be used to direct you to another area in the playthrough to progress the story.

Cloud Save / USB Device

Dark Souls Remastered has some seriously missable items, with some being locked to a subsequent playthrough if you miss it. Some bosses have items that you must acquire and must be acquired on the first try. Attempting to get these items on NG+ and onwards is very difficult and not recommended. This guide will recommend save-file backup for these parts and will notify you.

This is only a suggestion and is not mandatory; however, if you fail to acquire a weapon or item on the first attempt, you will make that section more difficult to complete. If you do wish to use this feature, ensure Auto Upload is turned off to the cloud and upload before attempting those sections. Download your save if you fail so you can attempt it again without ruining your progress.

GAMEPLAY INFORMATION

Dark Souls Remastered can be very uninformative when it comes to how to actually play the game.

You are presented with a screen when you begin the game with all of the buttons for controls, and that's basically it. Along the way you may find messages on the ground, prompts to perform certain actions, but nothing is really informing you.

Let's begin with the controls of this game. As this is the first title in the trilogy, there is nothing fancy compared to the other two titles. If you want to attack, you can press a button and it will happen. You want to power attack, that happens with a button press as well. There are some other niche attacks and combos with certain weapons, but for the purposes of acquiring the Platinum trophy, the weapons are simple to use.

Controls - Movement & Gameplay

L The left analog stick is used to move your character in any direction. Depending on how far you move the stick determines how fast your character walks/jogs.

R The right analog stick is used to control the camera. Depending on how far you move the stick determines how quickly your camera rotates in any direction.

R3 Pressing the right analog stick will lock onto a target within range, whether that be a NPC or an enemy. It also resets the camera to the centre of where your character is facing.

The right D-Pad button will select your right-hand weapon, or switch between primary and secondary right-hand weapon.

Moves menu selection right.

The left D-Pad button will select your left-hand weapon, or switch between primary and secondary left-hand weapon.

Moves menu selection left.

The up D-Pad button will select the next magic ability you have in your attuned spells list.

Moves menu selection up.

The down D-Pad button will select the next equipped consumable item you have in your usable item slots.

Moves menu selection down.

R1 / R2 Both buttons are assigned to a right-hand weapon action, be that of a light attack or a strong attack. If you have a sword, it will perform a strike, slash or thrust. If you have a magical item, it will perform the selected spell.

R1 selects right in menu type, R2 scrolls down the menus.

Both buttons are assigned to a left-hand weapon action, be that of a block, parry or magical spell. If a shield is equipped, it will either block an attack or make a L1 / L2 parry action. If you have a magical item, it will perform the selected spell.

L1 selects left in menu type, L2 scrolls up the menus.

The button will use any item you currently have selected on your button consumable list. If you have no items left, the character will gesture as if they are empty of the item.

Menu Function 1: Toggles the display of an item or equipment for lore information Removes equipment when in the equipment menu.

The circle button will allow the character to roll in any direction when used with the L stick. If no analog stick input is given, the character will back-step.

Holding this button while using the L analog stick will make the character run. Holding this button whilst using a ladder will slide down it.

Cancels the selection of an item or action within the menus.

When your character is running, pressing the circle button again quickly will make the character jump.

This button is for picking up items, speaking to NPCs and interacting with the environment where possible.

If held while moving the controller, it will use a gesture that you have selected in the gesture menu.

Confirms the selection of an item or action within the menus.

Two-hand wield current right-hand weapon Menu function 2: switches the status of a piece of equipment or weapon.

L R1 When facing forward, quickly using these two buttons together will make the character kick. You can also point the analog stick in whatever direction the character is facing to kick as well.

OPT Opens the menu.

TP Opens the gesture menu. Explanation of an item or term (whilst in the menus).

With those controls in mind, you can play around with them a bit before you are expected to fight strong enemies. There is Tutorial enemies you are expected to beat, but you won't be forced to be an expert straight away. As this is the first Dark Souls title, things are a bit slower and you have a better chance of learning what your enemy is doing, or is going to do, and react in a way to avoid damage and deal it back when possible.

Above is an image of a rather full screen of information, with some explanation on what's going on.

First and foremost, almost every RPG out there will have a character Health bar, usually indicated in Red. Dark Souls is no different and it is shown as such in the image above. When health is lost, it will change a section in % to Yellow briefly to show you how much was lost by an attack. Shortly after, it will disappear completely and the amount lost will be Black.

Certain enemies deal more damage than others, and certain attacks deal more damage than others. This is something to watch and learn when playing through the game.

When playing on subsequent playthroughs, you will need to re-learn how much damage an enemy can do as this increases with each new cycle.

Next is your character's Stamina, which is indicated by the Green bar below the health bar.

Each action you take or blocking enemy attacks consumes this bar, and it must be managed in battles to be able to survive.

Depending on Equip Load (will be explained), current equipment or consumables used, this will recharge quickly or slowly.

If you have all of your Stamina depleted, you will take longer to recharge it, take more damage by enemies and won't be able to run away in the same time as it normally would to action.

To the left of the Health and Stamina bar is the Humanity count your player currently has on them. Humanity is a currency used in the game for set purposes, such as reversing Hollowing and kindling bonfires. It is also an indication of your character's Hollowing status, where white numerals is Human Form, and Grey is Hollow.

Being in Human form is a requirement of summoning Friendly NPCs and other Players, but it is also a requirement to be invaded by Hostile NPCs and Players, so keep that in mind.

The more higher the number, the higher your Physical and Elemental damage resistance will be, up to 99 Humanity. This will increase Curse resistance at the maximum of 30 Humanity, but will not increase Bleed or Poison resistance.

Item Discovery is increased by your Humanity up to a value of 10. You will want to keep this going for the entire playthrough for increased drops from enemies.

Below the Health and Stamina bar are two symbols and which indicate current augmentations on a character, which are normally given by a piece of equipment. Some

augmentations indicate summoning aspects, such as invading other players or password locked matchmaking.

To the left of the character on screen is four icons, with those icons corresponding to the controls mentioned at the start of this section. These will change according to what equipment you are using, what Sorceries, Pyromancies or Miracles you are using, and what consumables you have equipped. It takes some getting used to, but this is the standard format across the Dark Souls titles.

The bottom right corner of this image has a numeral value, which will increase and decrease throughout the game. This is your Souls total amount your character has on them. This does not include Souls Items or Boss Souls that are in your inventory.

If you die, your souls will be removed from your character and will be placed on the ground near where you died. If you die again without collecting those souls, they are gone forever.

On this screen there is a Health bar directly at the bottom. This is unique for Bosses, giving the player information on screen at all times. If you encounter non-boss enemies, they will have their Health bar above their head instead.

This will differentiate between the two enemies, as some Bosses have common enemies with them. Additionally, summons will have their Health displayed above their heads as well.

Bonfires are a unique mechanic to the Dark Souls series and they give the player the ability to rest, repair Weapons & Equipment, attune Sorceries, Pyromancies or Miracles to spell slots and Reverse Hollowing. With the discovery of certain items explained in this walkthrough, you may also upgrade your Weapons & Equipment at the bonfire, which is unique to Dark Souls & Dark Souls Remastered.

In addition to the above, at a point in the story you will gain the ability to Warp to specific bonfires in Lordran. This is the only Dark Souls game that warping is not unlocked from the beginning of the game, which increases the difficulty slightly.

Resting at a bonfire resets 99% of all common enemies in all areas. There are some enemies that do not respawn, such as Black Knights and Crystal Lizards. You can use this mechanic to farm certain areas such as Darkroot Garden if you choose not to use the Soul Duplication Glitch.

Do keep in mind that if any enemies follow you close to the bonfire, you will not be able to rest. You will also not be able to rest if you have summoned an Ally, or if you have been invaded by a Dark Spirit.

SOUL DUPLICATION GLITCH

There are numerous glitches that can be performed in Dark Souls Remastered that can aid you in completing the game easier, with less bosses or can flat-out break the game. For simplicity, this guide will only utilise the Souls Duplication Glitch, which enables you to consume 999 of a soul item, or other consumable that does not require a confirmation.

The way this glitch works is it bugs out the menu to make the game think you are using 999 units of an item, when in fact you are only using 1. By exploiting the arrows and consumables menu, you can overlay the settings menu to trick the game. It is very easy to setup and use, and will expected during this walkthrough. The video below explains it in detail how to get the glitch to work.

This glitch is mainly going to be used with Souls Items and Humanity Items during this walkthrough. It will not work with Boss Souls or with the Fire Keeper Soul. Using this glitch will allow your character to gain very high levels early on and hit the soft caps for all attributes mid game. If there are any other glitches you wish to perform that are not included, please feel free to experiment and enjoy the game how you want to.

The chosen build for this Platinum Walkthrough Guide is the Sorcerer Class. Multiple playthroughs were completed using different builds to try and find what would be best suited for an easy Platinum Trophy acquisition. Throughout the first playthrough you will be directed when to level up and this build will be utilizing the Soul Duplication Glitch. Despite the fact that this build is Sorcery orientated, you will have the stats to play with whatever you like mid-game.

Taking a look at the stats here, these numbers are at the physical cap of 99 for three attributes, with the remainder being at their soft or hard caps for Dark Souls Remastered. This is what your stats will look like, or something similar by the end of the first playthrough. If you are confused as to what allocations you need to make, don't worry as the guide will direct you how to spend points.

When you begin the game, ensure you choose the Master Key starting gift. This will allow you to access areas and unlock things that have their keys hidden, or require backtracking to use. Using this item will also allow you to skip portions of the game during your NG+ and NG++ playthroughs.

When using this class, you will utilise a Catalyst either in the right-hand (preferred) or left hand, then cast a spell with R1 . You will also have a shield in the primary left-hand slot, guarding with L1 for most attacks. Swords will vary through this playthrough and will always be in the right-hand slot, secondary to the Catalyst and only being used when enemies guard against spells, or when you run out of spells.

Below will be the recommended weapons use in Dark Souls Remastered with the Sorcerer Class build in this guide. These are only suggestions, but will suit the above stats and build. If you find other information with better weapons, please feel free to use whatever you are comfortable with.

Shields are situational and will not be mentioned, but try to keep 100% Physical at all times, swapping when a boss has a certain attack advantage.

Sorcerer's Catalyst - RH1 This will be your primary catalyst until you reach the Duke's Archives area in playthrough 1. It has quite a high MAG ADJ for the starting weapon which scales with your Intelligence attribute.

Logan's Catalyst - RH1 This will be the end-game catalyst that you should use from when you acquire it to the end of your Platinum journey. Compared to the other catalysts, it has the best "bang for buck" with MAG ADJ and spell usage.

Tin Crystallization Catalyst - RH1 This is the alternative to Logan's Catalyst, with higher MAG ADJ it deals insane damage. The downside to using this catalyst is your spell counts are all halved. Great for bosses, not so great for dealing with large quantities of enemies.

Quelaag's Furysword - RH2 Unlocked mid-game, this fast slashing Chaos based weapon deals part fire and part physical damage in quick slashes. Very useful for NG and NG+, but starts to fall of during the NG++ playthrough.

Dragon Tooth - RH2 A very powerful smashing weapon that is acquire in Anor Londo. With the stats presented in the build, hits over 900 are very easy to perform. If you equip high Poise armor, you can smash through attacks without flinching. This weapon is on the slower side, so you could use this or the Moonlight Greatsword.

Moonlight Greatsword - RH2 Old faithful, this weapon is a powerhouse for magical attack. With the end-game stats shown above, enemies will be crushed with one swipe and stun-locked with slashes.

Guide Author's favorite weapon in the Souls series.

Gold-Hemmed Black Set Arguably the best light armor set in the game for resistances. This guide will use other forms of armor throughout, but if you are finding you are not taking much damage from enemies, this is a great set to use. It is found during Part 3 in the walkthrough.

Black Iron Set This is the best heavy armor set that can be acquired without requiring certain unlock requirements. It can be upgraded to +5 and is recommended for mid-game NG+ to NG++ when you unlock the platinum trophy.

Crown of Dusk Not an equipment set, but a head piece that increases your magic power. It is recommended for the entire walkthrough once you acquire it. One thing to be mindful of is that it increases damage from magic to your character.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
This first portion of the walkthrough is your guide to escaping the dilapidated prison that is the Northern Undead Asylum, reaching Firelink Shrine and ringing the First Bell of Awakening in the Undead Parish, your first story objective. Use this time to become acquainted with some Friendly NPCs, Hostile Enemies and begin to grasp the controls and mechanisms of Dark Souls Remastered.

Once you gain control of your character, Press to pillage the corpse in the cell for a Dungeon Cell Key.

Open the cell door and walk down the hallway, ignoring the Hollows.

Follow the pathway through the flooded area and climb up the ladder, ignoring the Hollow in the water.

Press to Light bonfire and acquire your first trophy Enkindle. Rest at the bonfire, then open the large doors directly in front, stopping before entering.

Run immediately to the left side of the open area and enter the opening door. If you fail to do so, you will most likely be killed by the Asylum Demon and respawn at the bonfire.

Light the bonfire and continue through the next door Acquire the Small Leather Shield from the corpse on the left, then chase the bow-wielding Hollow.

Loot the Dagger and equip both of the picked up items, with the latter in the right hand, and the former in the left.

Kill the Hollow, then traverse the white light in front of you. Walk to the right and you will see two stairs, one leading up and one leading down. Head down and open the gate, resting at the bonfire.

With the one leading up, walk halfway up, then quickly run down or off the side, as this will cause a large ball to roll down the stairs.

The ball will destroy the wall behind you, revealing a man sitting down. Speak to this man, Oscar of Astora, selecting YES when the option is given.

You will be given 5 Estus Flasks, the Undead Asylum F2 East Key and unlock another trophy, Estus Flask.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Kill the Hollow at the top of stairs and head past it into the next room. Loot the corpse on the right for a Sorcerer's Catalyst and equip it in the second right slot.

Kill any remaining Hollows in the area, including the small room directly ahead.

The white light door in front of you has a boss waiting for you, so ensure you have your Dagger equipped two-hand ready.

Ensure you read the below strategy on how to defeat the first boss, the Asylum Demon.

Begin by doing a Plunging Attack, which is R1 while falling. This will cause massive damage to the Asylum Demon and stun it briefly.

Run to the right to create some distance between it and you, switching to your Sorcerer's Catalyst by pressing .

What you need to do now is bait an attack, dodge, then cast 1-2 Soul Arrows and repeat. The video provided above shows this strategy.

It has 4 general attacks, which have long wind up times and are explained as: Floats up in the air with hammer in hand. It will slam down and crush you if you are close to it or under it.

Pulls hammer to either side of it's body. It will do a sweeping attack with its hammer. You can roll through this or away from it, forward or back. Dodging to the side may inflict damage to your character.

Raises hammer above its head. It will either slam the hammer down directly in front, or at range. It does this attack when you are close or far away.

It may take you a couple of tries to beat this boss, but that is okay as it teaches you dodging, plunge attacks and baiting attacks, which will be useful for the majority of the game ahead.

Once the Asylum Demon is defeated, you will acquire the Big Pilgrim's Key and a Humanity. Open the large doors in front, which will lead to the outside area of the Northern Undead Asylum.

As you walk along the pathway leading up, take a look to the right to see a large nest. You will need to come back here at a later point, so take note.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Walk to the top of the hill, stopping before the top to be placed into a cutscene. You will be taken by the Giant Crow to Lordran, specifically Firelink Shrine, which will unlock another trophy, Reach Lordran.

Levelling Up

Now that you have arrived in Lordran, you now have the ability to allocate Souls towards your parameters and increase in level at the bonfire. At this point, do not do this, save the current souls you have until directed to use them.

Additionally, you are not to use Soul Items unless it is specifically mentioned to do so. This also includes Boss Souls. If you choose to use these items outside of specific times, you risk not having enough souls for purchases needed, or be unable to craft weapons required for trophies.

Rest at the bonfire to refill your spells and any Estus Flasks you may have used. The man sitting by the bonfire is the Crestfallen Knight, who will give you information about your task ahead, including two bells and about hollowing.

Nearby there is a dead body at a well, which has 3 Humanity.

To the left of the Crestfallen Knight is some stairs leading down to a woman in a cell to the left.

This is a Fire Keeper, Anastacia of Astora, who will be utilized later for some upgrades. Do not follow the next set of stairs down, as there is some enemies you will not be able to damage or kill just yet.

Important NPC

Do not attack Petrus of Thorolund, as doing so will lock you out of a future trophy. He sells Miracles and is also important to another NPCs questline.

To the right of the Crestfallen Knight is an archway, with three paths after it. Ignore the left and right, entering the centre to find a man standing alone.

Speak to this man, Petrus of Thorolund and exhaust his dialogue. Keep speaking to him to acquire a Copper Coin, then continue to conversation.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
When given the option, select YES, and then YES to join the Way of White covenant, unlocking Covenant: Way of White.

To the right of Petrus of Thorolund is some stairs leading up to an elevator, which is currently inactive and will be activated later.

Up the next stairs is a Soul of a Lost Undead, which you should not use just yet.

As you head back to the bonfire. Head into the right of three archways to find a small nook with a corpse, which can be looted for 6 Firebombs.

Past the well is a path leading up, which has 6 Hollows. They can be killed in one shot with your Soul Arrow, except for the armored one at the bottom.

In this area you can find corpses with 2 Souls of a Lost Undead, ignoring the corpse under the bridge (too risky for too little reward)

Enter the waterway at the top to find a Sewer Rat to the left, guarding another Soul of a Lost Undead. Be careful as their bites inflict poison.

Head out of the waterway the other end, bearing in mind the gate will be locked here further up.

Prior to the next fog gate there will be 5 Undead Soldiers ahead, one which throws bombs. One will ambush you from behind, appearing near the waterway.

Don't enter the fog gate just yet as there is some exploring to do.

Roll through the nearby barrels and drop down for a Large Soul of a Lost Undead. When you drop down again you will be ambushed by two Hollows who are hanging on the ledge to your right.

Turn around and enter the house by where you dropped, looting the corpse hanging by a ledge for a Soul of a Lost Undead.

Exit this house, enter the next house and heading through will reveal a corpse and a ladder.

Approaching these will result in an ambush by 4 Hollows. Kill them with Soul Arrow while keeping distance.

The corpse has some Rubbish, and at the top of the ladder you can find a path leading to a corpse with some Humanity.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Return to the white fog gate and enter it. Under the stairs you can find a corpse with a Soul of a Lost Undead.

Ignore the room to the left as you cannot jump across, then slowly walk up the stairs and path to the right. This will cause the Hellkite Drake to attack.

Once it leaves continue on and kill the 4 Undead Soldiers directly ahead, ignoring the 2 lance-wielding ones to the right for now.

Once they are dead, enter the area to the left with the bonfire and rest. This will respawn all previous enemies, but that's fine as you need the souls.

Kill the 4 previous Undead Soldiers, then kill the 2 lance-wielding Undead Soldiers nearby.

Roll through the crates to reveal a stairway leading down. To the right as you head down is a dormant fireplace, which has a hidden Undead Soldier next to it.

Leave through the doorway directly at the bottom of the stairs.

Speak to the Undead Merchant and purchase the following items: 999 Wooden Arrows for a total of 2997 Souls.

Leave and head back to the bonfire. If you don't have enough souls, farm the Undead Soldiers in this area until you can purchase all 999.

From this point on, DO NOT use the Wooden Arrows, as they are going to be used for glitching souls.

Levelling Up

This is the first point where you will be allocating souls towards your attributes. At this point, if you have followed the guide with collecting the Souls items, you will have 6 Souls of a Lost Undead & 1 Large Soul of a Lost Undead. You will now need to perform the Soul Duplication Glitch. Prior to doing this, ensure you only have 1 Soul of a Lost Undead in your inventory at a time, so drop the remainder on the ground away from the bonfire. Allocate your souls to the following attributes below

Prior to leaving, using the same method as above for glitching, drop 4 Humanity on the ground (you should have 5 total) and perform the glitch.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Pick up the remaining Humanity and you will notice you have 99 next to your health and stamina. This is your 'soft humanity' Reverse Hollowing at the bonfire, then Kindle the bonfire.

Return to the Undead Merchant and purchase the following items: Residence Key, Repairbox & Bottomless Box.

Short Bow, Shortsword & Heater Shield 999 Standard Arrows

Head past the dormant fireplace to the left in the previous room and walk down the stairs. Kill the 4 Hollows from a distance with Soul Arrow, as they can all attack at once if you get close.

At the top of the ladder you will find a corpse with 10 Throwing Knives. There is a house you can jump to ahead, which is performed by running with (Hold ) and pressing to jump.

Timing isn't very strict, but if you fail to make it, retrace your steps and try again.

At the top of the stairs inside the house you will find a corpse outside with a Light Crossbow and 16 Standard Bolts Return to the bonfire, on the way you can collect a Wooden Shield behind a door in the area with Undead Soldiers.

Swap out your Small Leather Shield for the Heater Shield, as this new shield has 100% Physical damage reduction.

The next path is to the left when exiting the bonfire, being cautious of the 2 bomb-throwing Undead Soldiers to the left above.

They can be killed with the Short Bow and Standard Arrows, or ignored by running into the next room.

The next room has 3 Undead Soldiers, with one of those kicking the nearby door down on the left.

The nearby metal gate cannot be opened at this time, but will be done later as a shortcut.

The next house as you exit has 2 Undead Soldiers hiding inside, with a chest containing 5 Black Firebombs.

Kill the 3 Undead Soldiers, then turn around to find a ladder, which you can climb. The 3 Undead Soldiers at the top can be killed and then loot the nearby corpse for a Soul of a Lost Undead.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
The house behind the ground level Hollows can be entered by using the Residence Key. Loot the chest inside for 3 Gold Pine Resins.

Leave the house and continue on to find 3 Undead Soldiers on the path ahead. Ignore them and turn around to enter the tower, killing the Undead Soldier at the top.

Kill the 3 Undead Soldiers by luring them up to you 1 at a time.

The stairs leading down to the right has a very tough enemy at the bottom, a Black Knight. It is guarding a Blue Tearstone Ring, which isn't really required for anything.

If you feel brave, lure it back to the open area try and backstab it to death, or bait attacks, then dodge and cast Soul Arrow.

It may also drop a Black Knight Sword, which is required for a trophy, and a Titanite Chunk.

The stairs leading up to the left has a Undead Soldier standing behind a barrel, which will be used as a trap.

Walk up, then run back out of the way of the flaming barrel as it starts to roll. Kill the Undead Soldier and proceed past it into the tower to the fog gate at the top, ignoring the door as you entered on the lower level

Ensure you read the below strategy before entering the fog gate to battle the Taurus Demon.

You may equip the Black Firebombs from earlier onto your hotbar for use during this upcoming battle.

Before heading forward along the pathway, turn around and climb the ladder. Kill both of the Undead Soldiers at the top, as they will shoot you while you fight the boss.

Climb back down the ladder and begin to walk along the wall. As you walk, keep an eye on the distant tower for the boss, who will jump down as you get close.

Immediately turn around, run and climb up the ladder. Wait for the boss to get close, where it may attack once, then perform a Plunging Attack, similar to what was done with the Asylum Demon.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Run behind it to create some distance, then begin baiting attacks. During this time you can do either of the following:

Bait an attack and dodge, then use 1-2 Soul Arrows, repeating until dead. Bait an attack and dodge, then throw a Black Firebomb, repeating until dead.

The Taurus Demon has 4 general attacks that you need to be aware of and can be telegraphed as follows:

Jumping attack, where it will sort of squat and then jump with an overhead swing of it's axe. This usually occurs if you are very far away from it, so just roll backwards to avoid.

Swinging sweep attack, is shown with it drawing it's axe to one side of it's body and horizontally sweeping in front of it. You can roll backward to avoid this attack.

The demon will bring it's axe above it's head and smash down directly in front of it. This usually occurs if you are right up in it's face melee attacking. You can just roll to the left or right of the demon to avoid it.

There is a quicker variant of the attack above, but will drive the axe into the ground in front of it. Occurs with the same proximity, and can be dodged the same way.

Once the Taurus Demon has been defeated it will drop 1 Humanity & 1 Homeward Bone. Continue forward, looting the Large Soul of a Lost Undead amongst the crates to the left of the stairs.

At the exit, turn right and speak to Solaire of Astora, selecting YES both times, granting you a White Sign Soapstone.

The bridge ahead has some Undead Soldiers in the distance, which will be killed shortly. Advance onto the bridge, then run back towards Solaire. This will cause the Hellkite Drake to fly over and breathe fire on the bridge.

Once the fire is extinguished, run quickly towards the Hellkite Drake, then run into the nearby stairs on the right.

Ignore the doorway on the right, instead head go forward and interact with the ladder to kick it down.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Rest at the bonfire and head back up the ladder to the lower room under the bridge. Exit through the other doorway in this room (not the stairs) and you will be outside under the bridge.

Equip the Short Bow and Standard Arrows, then two-hand the bow and stand to the right of the first pillar so you can see the Hellkite Drake's tail.

Pressing L1 will place you into first-person shooter mode, and you will want to shoot the tip of the Hellkite Drake's tail until it breaks.

With your current build of 15 Strength & 20 Dexterity it will take 16 Standard Arrows to break it's tail off.

This will grant you the Drake Sword (1/48).

Re-equip the weapon you swapped out, then head up to the top of the bridge, stopping before you walk out.

You can bait the Hellkite Drake's attack, then walk back down, which will kill all the Undead Soldiers.

Wait on the edge of the wall next to the stairs, which after a few seconds will make the Hellkite Drake jump down.

Once it does this, run straight past it into the Undead Parish and into the doorway on the right.

The Hellkite Drake will then fly off, leaving all the items on the bridge available for looting.

Before you loot, approach the nearby statue in the grass and Pray at the Altar of Sunlight. As you have 25 Faith you will able to join the Warrior of Sunlight covenant, unlocking Covenant: Warrior of Sunlight.

You will also unlock Miracle: Lightning Spear (1/23).

On the bridge you will find a Claymore & the Soul of a Nameless Soldier. Interact with the nearby lever to open up the next area, then rest at the bonfire and Kindle.

As you enter the next area, there will be a lone Undead Soldier that you can kill. The doorway to your right will have a ladder leading down, which you can ignore.

The stairs upwards leads to another Black Knight which you can kill if you feel confident, by luring it back to the bonfire and backstabbing/baiting then using Soul Arrow.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
It has a chance to drop a Black Knight Greatsword and will drop a Titanite Chunk.

In the next courtyard, there is 6 Undead Soldiers and a Fang Boar, which will try to group up and kill you.

Walk slightly forward and 2 Undead Soldiers will approach, one in front and one to your right with a lance.

Once dealt with, move further forward until the Fang Boar begins to charge, then retreat to the previous doorway.

The Fang Boar will de-aggro, giving you a free couple of shots with Soul Arrow. Kill it and then kill all remaining Undead Soldiers in the courtyard and loot for 4 Alluring Skulls.

The large gate is shut, so head down into the nearby tunnel. Be cautious as there will be an ambush if you chase the Hollow.

Kill all of the Hollows in this room and loot the corpses for a Mystery Key & a Large Soul of a Lost Undead, which is found on one of the roof beams.

Enter the fog gate on the upper floor into the next area.

There is an enemy ahead of you to the right that is particularly troublesome when fighting melee. It has the ability to Riposte or Parry your attacks when it raises it's sword and it points it towards you.

This enemy is a Balder Knight and is tougher than the previous enemies fought. Backstab this one to get started, then either Parry it's attacks, or hit it with Soul Arrow.

Loot the corpse ahead for a Knight Shield (will be used for Unique Weapon), which you can replace your current shield with.

Continue walking through and ahead will be some more Undead Soldiers and another Balder Knight.

Ignoring the large doorway to the left, take the path to the right and enter the Undead Chapel. Rest at the bonfire here and Kindle.

Important NPC

There is two NPCs nearby who are important for both story and upgrading purposes, and also for trophies. These are Andre of Astora, who is one of three blacksmiths required in the game, and Siegmeyer of Catarina, who is required for a spell and a special material. Do not hurt them as you will miss these items and trophies until the next playthrough.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Leave through the nearby doorway outside to see a large set of closed gates, with a man sitting next to the steps.

Speak to him, Siegmeyer of Catarina, until his dialogue begins repeating, then return to the bonfire.

Using the souls glitch, glitch the 1 Soul of a Lost Undead you have in your inventory.

Downstairs you will hear the clanging of a hammer, which is where Andre of Astora does his finest work.

Speak to Andre and you will want to purchase the following items: Crest of Artorias, Weapon Smithbox & Armor Smithbox for 24000 Souls 99 Titanite Shards for 77600 Souls 1 Longsword for 1000 Souls

Weapon & Armor Upgrades

Before you leave Andre of Astora into the upcoming area, you use the Titanite Shards you just purchased to upgrade some of your equipment. This will enable you to deal some more damage against enemies, whilst also reducing some of it incoming as well. Upgrade the following weapons with Andre.

Short Bow to Short Knight Shield to Knight Shortsword to Shortsword+5 Bow+5 Shield+5 You will also want to upgrade your current Sorcerer Set to Sorcerer Set+3, then re-purchase all of the used Titanite Shards afterwards.

Swap your Dagger out for the Shortsword+5. Ignore the nearby doorway, instead returning to the area outside the large doorway from earlier, with the 3 Undead Soldiers.

Inside this church on the right will be a large Tower Knight who deals large damage. To beat it, you can hold your shield out and run around the back of it to strike it. Your shield will be able to tank it's hits.

You can also bait an attack, roll, and then use Soul Arrow.

Afterwards, loot the nearby corpse at the altar for a Fire Keeper Soul. Nearby there is an elevator next to some stairs that you will want to enter. This will activate a shortcut between the Undead Parish and Firelink Shrine.

h: Part 1: The First Bell Of Awakening
t:
Talk to Petrus again, this time purchasing the following spells from him: Great Heal Excerpt (2/23) for 10000 Souls Homeward (3/23) for 8000 Souls Force (4/23) for 4000 Souls Seek Guidance (5/23) for 2000 Souls Heal (6/23) for 4000 Souls You will also want to purchase the Talisman as well, for 1000 Souls. Equip this in your left hand second slot.

Rest at the nearby bonfire, attune the following

Soul Arrow Heal Lightning Spear Head down the nearby stairs and speak to Anastacia of Astora, reinforcing your Estus Flask to the next level, Estus Flask+1.

Return to the Undead Parish with the elevator shortcut and return to the area with the Tower Knight.

Directly opposite the altar you will see an enemy high up, which is a Channeler. You will want to kill this with Lightning Spear, using your Talisman L1 .

Directly ahead will be 3 Balder Knights, which you will want to fight one at a time. Continue outside past them to find an Undead Soldier that has a Basement Key, a lever which you want to use, and a corpse with a Halberd (required for Unique Weapon creation).

Back inside the church, return to the elevator, instead heading up the stairs to the right for another Balder Knight.

In this next area, there is a large number of Hollows that will ambush you, so stand in the hallway, wait until they attack, the slash and retreat. Repeat until they are all dead.

Turn left as you enter the room to find a small room with a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier, and a long hallway with another Balder Knight.

Kill the knight, then follow the path around for a corpse in a barrel with a Humanity.

One of the doors here is breakable, so attack it to reveal a cell with Knight Lautrec of Carim inside of it. Open his cell with the Mystery Key, then attack and kill him in the previous hallway (very important).

Loot him for 5 Humanity and a Ring of Favor and Protection, which you should equip. Never take this ring off as it breaks upon removal.

You may return to the Firelink Shrine bonfire to rest and refill spells, then return to the room with the Hollows, killing them once again.

Instead of heading left, go straight ahead and you will see some stairs and a ladder, head up to the top to find a Summon Sign for Solaire and the fog gate for the next boss.

Please read below for the strategy for the upcoming bosses (yes there is two of them).

Missable Item

One of the upcoming bosses has a special weapon you require, which is called the Gargoyle Tail Axe. This axe is acquired by cutting off the tail of the first boss with numerous attacks. As you will require the positioning of the Gargoyle to be specific, and the boss moves around frequently, it can be difficult to do. It is recommended you use the Cloud Save or a USB Device to back your save up and retry if you miss the opportunity.

Summon Solaire using the nearby summon sign and enter the fog gate once he appears. Walk forward until the cutscene begins and then once over, the battle begins with the first Bell Gargoyle.

Your priority is to sever the tail before Solaire kills it, or before the other Bell Gargoyle appears, which occurs around 50% health depleted on the first. Once you have done this, you will acquire the Gargoyle Tail Axe (2/48).

Allow Solaire to bait the attacks of the Bell Gargoyle, while you attack it with Lightning Spear from a distance. If the Bell Gargoyle targets you, keep your shield up and wait for Solaire to get it's attention again.

Once the second Bell Gargoyle appears, the first one should be dead, or close to it, as you will be dealing close to 1/3 to 1/2 the health bar of the Bell Gargoyle in damage. Kill the second using the same strategy as the first, although the second will only breathe fire.

The attacks of the Bell Gargoyles can be summarized as below: Flies up in the air with it's lance above it's head. This means the monster is going to do a sweep attack below it, or a poking attack. When locked on, you can either roll out of the way, or run around behind it when it is above.

Flies up in the air, but pokes with it's tail. This only occurs if you are in front, and the tail is still intact. Roll to the sides to avoid this attack.

Sweeps it's lance side to side. This is telegraphed by the Bell Gargoyle moving the lance to either side of the body, and will usually attack twice. You can roll to avoid this attack, or tank it with the shield.

Sweeps with the tail, which only occurs if you are behind it when it is targeting you, but does not occur when tail is removed. Simply roll trough the attack, or tank it with the shield.

Flame Breath only occurs once the second Bell Gargoyle appears. Keep your distance, or get in close and behind once you see them raise their head or start breathing the fire.

Once the battle is over you will acquire a Twin Humanities and a Sunlight Medal for having Solaire fight with you.

Head into the large tower in front of you, climb the two ladders inside, and interact with the lever at the top.

This will ring the first Bell of Awakening, completing the first portion of this guide, and unlocking Ring the Bell (Undead Church)

Important NPC

Downstairs from your current location, a NPC has spawned in to greet you when you descend the two ladders. You must not attack him, as he has a Miracle you need, and is also the only means of absolving yourself of crimes you may commit to other NPCs.

Before you continue on to the next portion of the guide, head back down the two ladders and speak to the man gesturing in front of you, Oswald of Carim.

Speak to him and purchase the following from him: Karmic Justice (7/23) for 40000 Souls. Poisonbite Ring & Ring of Sacrifice for 20000 Souls.

Return to the Firelink Shrine bonfire to end this portion of the walkthrough.

Before you continue on to the next portion of the walkthrough, you should have unlocked, or purchased the following Miracles, Sorceries and Unique Weapons. If you haven't, please retrace your steps to find out what you have missed and acquire them before moving on.

Heal Purchased from Petrus of Thorolund. Great Heal Excerpt Purchased from Petrus of Thorolund.

Homeward Purchased from Petrus of Thorolund. Seek Guidance Purchased from Petrus of Thorolund.

Force Purchased from Petrus of Thorolund. Lightning Spear Joined Warrior of Sunlight covenant.

Karmic Justice Purchased from Oswald of Carim. Soul Arrow Acquired at beginning of game.

Drake Sword Gargoyle Tail Axe Cut the tail off the Hellkite Drake Cut tail the off the Bell Gargoyle

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
This section of the walkthrough will focus on ringing the Second Bell of Awakening in Quelaag's Domain. There will be more exploring coming up, acquiring more Sorceries and your first set of Pyromancies, finding some friendly NPCs, and defeating some rather nasty bosses. This section will be longer than the first, as the trek to get to the next bell is quite a tough and arduous one.

Levelling Up

This is the next point where you will be allocating souls towards your attributes. At this point, if you have followed the guide with collecting the Souls items, you will have 2 Large Souls of a Lost Undead, 1 Soul of a Nameless Soldier and 1 Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier. You will now need to perform the Soul Duplication Glitch. Prior to doing this, ensure you only have 1 Large Soul of a Lost Undead in your inventory at a time, so drop the remainder on the ground away from the bonfire. Allocate your souls to the following attributes below.

Before moving on with the desired route, a short detour should be made to acquire another Fire Keeper Soul.

On the lower area of Firelink Shrine, near Anastacia, is a small staircase that leads to a lift mechanism. Head there now and descend to the lower area by stepping on the lift.

In this area you can see some ruins out in the distance, with some non-hostile Hollows in the immediate area.

Prior to heading towards those ruins, loot the area for a Soul of a Nameless Soldier, an Estoc, and 2 Transient Curses (which is found in a round container near the lower bridge.

Equip the Transient Curses onto your usable item menu, and keep the item visible before moving ahead. Move across the first bridge once you have done this.

There are enemies ahead that can only be damaged when you use a Transient Curse, and you can only block incoming damage while one is in use as well.

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
These enemies, Ghosts, can appear from the ground, attack and move through walls, and can fly out of range. Have your shield up and attack when the opportunity arises, or cast spells from a distance.

Consume a Transient Curse and move forward across the second wooden bridge. There will be 2 Ghosts that appear directly in front of you, in the destroyed building. Kill these two and move towards the structure to your right, ignoring the stairs directly ahead.

Enter the structure on the right, and in the distance you will see a lootable item on the ground. Do not run to this item just yet.

Once you leave the structure to walk over and pick it up, 3 Ghosts will appear behind you and from below. Quickly step out onto the very thin walkway, then run back in before the Ghosts appear. Kill them before moving on with Soul Arrow.

The walkway here is very difficult to see, but if you just walk directly straight to the item, you won't fall in.

Loot the corpse on the ground for another Fire Keeper Soul, then leave this area and return to Anastacia in Firelink Shrine.

Reinforce your Estus Flask+1 to Estus Flask+2.

Return to the area where you spoke to Solaire, either through the Undead Burg ladder shortcut, or through the Taurus Demon boss area.

Interact with the closed door here to open it with the Basement Key, then head down the long ladder.

Hold to slide down it quicker.

Open the shortcut nearby by ascending the stairs on the right and opening the metal gate. This will allow you to return from the Undead Burg bonfire, if you happen to die in the upcoming section.

This next area of the Undead Burg has two new enemies that can be troublesome. Undead Attack Dogs and Undead Assassins.

The dogs will attack erratically and inflict poison, so it's best to hold your shield up and attack once when an opening appears.

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
The assassins will also inflict poison, throw knives and have the ability to Backstab and Parry your attacks.

There is 3 Undead Attack Dogs that ambush immediately, and 3 Undead Assassins that appear as you move forward, so kill them before moving on.

Important NPC

There is an important NPC nearby that you must not harm by accident or on purpose. Griggs of Vinheim is a sorcerer, has Sorceries required for a trophy and increasing your arsenal, and is also important for another NPCs missable questline. He will return to Firelink Shrine once you rescue him.

Once these enemies are dead, turn around so the giant pile of burning bodies is to your front-right and you will see an alley to your left.

Open the second door on the left, which will have someone crying out for help inside. This NPC is Griggs of Vinheim. Speak to him and exhaust all dialogue, then leave the house.

Nearby is the end of the alley with 7 torch-wielding Hollows guarding a Twin Humanities. Turning around and returning to the first area, in one of the houses the Undead Assassins appeared from has a Mail Breaker on a corpse.

Directly ahead the alley narrows, with plenty of houses on either side. In these houses is a group of Undead Attack Dogs and Undead Assassins waiting to ambush you.

Walk slowly ahead waiting for the sound of doors opening, and when it occurs, back up to the previous area for more room to fight. Keep your distance and kill them with Soul Arrow.

Directly ahead is a fog gate, which has a real nasty boss behind it. Before entering, loot the remaining items in the area, which include a Thief Set and Target Shield.

There is also a corpse in a barrel with a Large Soul of a Lost Undead on the left side of this alley.

Please read the below strategy for the upcoming boss, Capra Demon, before entering the fog gate.

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
Ensure you equip the Poisonbite Ring to your second ring slot before beginning the fight.

This fight is going to be off on the defensive immediately after you enter the fog gate. You will be attacked straight away by the Capra Demon and an Undead Attack Dog.

Use your shield to tank the slam attack from the Capra Demon, or roll to the right side of it when it attacks. The first Undead Attack Dog will usually be on the left side of this area trying to attack you as well, so roll past them towards the stairs as shown in the video.

There will be another Undead Attack Dog that appears from the right as you ascend the stairs. Roll up the stairs, or jog, then roll across to the ledge, with your back towards the wall.

Hold your shield out to tank any hits and the Capra Demon will fall off the side of this ledge, leaving the Undead Attack Dogs to try and attack. The demon usually fumbles around below for a few seconds, giving you an opportunity to kill the dogs.

What you need to do is block with the shield, wait for an attack by the Undead Attack Dog, then quickly two-hand with , slash once to kill the dog, then one hand the sword , and block with your shield again until the second dog attacks. This has to be done quickly to reduce any incoming damage from the dog, although minimal.

Once both are dead, watch the Capra Demon and wait for it to either fumble below, or begin walking up the stairs again. If it is below you, or not at the stairs yet, equip your Talisman and cast Lightning Spear. If the demon begins walking up the stairs, hold your shield out and block it's attacks. It will fall down again, so repeat the Lightning Spear until it is dead.

This strategy may take a couple of tries, but it will get the job done without having to roll and trying to defend yourself below with such a confined area. Don't worry too much about taking damage from the Undead Attack Dogs while trying to kill them, you should be more concerned about the boss dealing damage.

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
For reference, the Capra Demon has three main attacks that can be telegraphed as follows: It usually begins the first attack on you as a slamming attack, which has a short wind up time and is telegraphed by it briefly squatting to jump. It will slam both of it's machetes in your direction, dealing large amounts of stamina damage. You can either tank the damage with your shield, or roll to the right.

It may hold both machetes above it's head, shortly after slamming both down directly in front of it to hit you. Recommended to roll to the right, as this will break your guard.

The demon can also sweep it's machetes from side to side in a horizontal pattern. It will pull both machetes to one side of it's body before swinging once or twice. You can tank this with your shield, or by rolling backwards away from the attack.

Once the battle is over you will receive a Key to the Depths, 1 Homeward Bone and 1 Humanity for your efforts.

Leave the boss area, then walk down the stairs to your left. Be mindful of the Undead Assassin at the bottom of the stairs, as there is one in hiding also to your left.

The next area you will be exploring is the Depths, which is entered through a locked door on your right using the Key to the Depths.

Nearby is a Large Soul of a Lost Undead you can loot before heading inside. From this point forward, try solely using your Sorceries and resorting to melee attacks only when you run out of spells, or when the range is too close for them to work with enemies.

As you descend down the stairs you will see 2 Hollows ahead, with another waiting in ambush to the right from behind.

You may pillage the corpse at the end of the corridor for a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Kill all the Hollows on the next level down, then descend further to find some Undead Attack Dogs and a new enemy, a Butcher. Kill all of these from a distance.

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
In the chest next to the Butcher you will find an important item, the Large Ember (1/10), which is used to upgrade weapons to +10.

Important NPC

There is a NPC in distress nearby who has been trapped by a Butcher. You must not injure this NPC, either by accident or on purpose. He sells Pyromancies you need for a trophy, and also gives you a Pyromancy Flame.

Turn around and head into the nearby water, being careful of 2 Undead Attack Dogs and a Hollow waiting for you. You can always bait them out of the water if need be.

Exit the water on the opposite side and enter the room on the left and roll through the barrels on the far end, do not attack.

Speak to Laurentius of the Great Swamp and he will thank you for saving him. Once he repeats his dialogue, you will need to return to Firelink Shrine for some purchases.

Return to the door you opened with the key and you will see a large stairway opposite the door, heading up a tower. Ascend this stairway until you enter a waterway.

As you enter, you will find another Undead Merchant to your right. She has some items for sale which will be useful shortly.

Follow the waterway to a metal gate, which you can open to create a shortcut to Firelink Shrine which will be further through on your left.

Griggs of Vinheim has now taken up residence in Firelink Shrine directly ahead as you descend the stairs. You will now need to buy some Sorceries from him.

You may duplicate the 2 of your Large Souls of a Lost Undead to cover the costs of the upcoming purchases.

Speak to him and when given the opportunity, select YES, then purchase the following: Soul Arrow (1/24) for 1000 Souls Heavy Soul Arrow (2/24) for 2000 Souls Great Soul Arrow (3/24) for 6000 Souls Fall Control (4/24) for 1500 Souls Great Heavy Soul Arrow (5/24) for 8000 Souls Magic Weapon (6/24) for 3000 Souls Aural Decoy (7/24) for 1000 Souls Magic Shield (8/24) for 3000 Souls You will also want to purchase the Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring for 20000 Souls as well, replacing your Poisonbite Ring in your equipment.

h: Part 2: The Second Bell Of Awakening
t:
Laurentius of the Great Swamp is also located nearby, directly above the Crestfallen Knight on the upper level. Speak to him and select NO when the option appears.

He will gift you a Pyromancy Flame, which will be used for Pyromancies you can use throughout this playthrough. Purchase the following spells from him:

Fire Orb (1/19) for 8000 Souls Combustion (2/19) for 500 Souls Iron Flesh (3/19) for 2000 Souls Flash Sweat (4/19) for 2000 Souls Fireball (5/19) for 800 Souls Modify equipment and upgrade your Pyromancy Flame to Pyromancy Flame+15 for 149500 Souls. This is everything from him for now.

Rest at the nearby bonfire, then attune the following

Soul Arrow (x2) Heavy Soul Arrow Great Soul Arrow Great Heavy Soul Arrow Lightning Spear Return to the Undead Merchant in the waterway leading to the lower Undead Burg and purchase the following items: 99 Blooming Purple Moss Clumps for 99000 Souls 4 Transient Curses for 16000 Souls 97 Homeward Bones for 48500 Souls 99 Prism Stones for 990 Souls 1 Humanity for 5000 Souls 5 Purging Stones for 30000 Souls 999 Poison Arrows for 99000 Souls Leave her once you have purchased these items, return to the Depths, kill the enemies you previously killed and leave the water again.

As you exit the water, look to the doorway on your left, then directly up to find a Butcher waiting to ambush you as you move further down the hall.

Use Great Heavy Soul Arrow to deal massive damage, then finish it off. It will drop a Sack head dress.

In this next part of the Depths you will be exploring some sewers, with many enemies hiding in boxes and on the roof of certain areas.

As you enter the sewer, you will see a corpse to your left, but this is a trap. Above you will be a Slime, which drop down from above and deal large damage.

Get close to the item, then roll away to avoid the attack. Kill it with your spells and loot the Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

In the next long hallway you can see a large group of Slimes on the roof, but some may avoid targeting. Walk close and kill them in one shot with Heavy Soul Arrow.

Kill the Hollows and enter the nearby door, unlocking it with the Master Key. Head inside, rest and Kindle at the bonfire.

As you get further into the game, your equipment will begin to degrade. Each time you rest at the bonfire, it's best to repair it through the bonfire menu.

Exit the small room and walk into the doorway on your right. There will be some boxes here that you need to destroy. Doing so will allow a shortcut later.

Once you have done this, return to the area where you killed the first Butcher, killing any enemies along the way if they bother you.

Behind the table it was chopping at some meat are some boxes. Destroy these and it will reveal a hidden path. Drop down and you will be in a new area above a Giant Rat.

From this upper area you can safely kill it with any of your spells. Before you drop down to collect some items below, you can collect a Spider Shield on the opposite side of this area.

Loot the body of the Giant Rat, then nearby you can find 2 corpses with a Soul of a Nameless Soldier and a Sewer Chamber Key.

Nearby is a water slide heading down to a lower level, ignore this and head to the opposite end of this sewer section and enter the nearby tunnel.

Loot the corpse for another Soul of a Nameless Soldier, then ignore the hole directly ahead.

Follow the tunnel to the left, then at the fork turn right to ignore the next hole in the floor. Continue and turn left at the next fork to find four Sewer Rats directly ahead, with one in ambush to the left as you exit the tunnel.

They accompany a Channeler who must be killed, as it causes issues in an upcoming boss fight if you don't. You can kill all these enemies by baiting them into the tunnel.

Beware of the two boxes ahead as Sewer Rats are waiting to ambush, then loot the corpse at the end for a Large Titanite Shard.

Enter the nearby fog gate on the upper level and head into the tunnels again. Loot the corpse nearby for another Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Continue through the tunnel to reach a more open area, with plenty of Sewer Rats. Kill them and head upwards to find more of them and a corpse with a Greataxe (needed for Unique Weapon creation).

You are now close to the bonfire, so this area can be considered cleared out. Return to the area with the large Giant Rat and approach the water slide.

You are now going to enter the lower area of the Depths where you will some new enemies called Basilisks. You must be cautious as their breath attacks can turn you to stone and curse you. Try to keep your distance; however, they are quite slow sometimes and you can kill them before they notice you.

Slide down the water slide to enter this next area. As you land, you will find one of these Basilisks waiting and some larger Sewer Rats.

At the fork here, turn left where the Basilisk is/was sitting and follow it through to find more of them behind a barred fence. Follow the path through, looting a corpse with a Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Kill these Basilisks on the left as you pass the corpse, but beware as there is more on the right around the next corner, which you should kill.

In this area you will want to loot all of the items which include a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier, a Ring of the Evil Eye and a Humanity.

The more important part of killing these Basilisks is that they have a chance to drop an item called an Eye of Death, which will be important in acquiring a Miracle later in the game.

For now, loot any off their bodies that they drop and you will return here once you have unlocked the shortcut to the area bonfire.

Return to where you dropped down from the water slide and head left, as you do this you will be invaded by Dark Spirit Knight Kirk, as you will most likely be in human form.

Beware of his attacks as they deal Bleeding damage, and his rolls can damage you due to Thorns. If you try to use Sorceries he will try to roll out of the way, so use Lightning Spear or melee attacks to kill him.

Continue moving through this tunnel section and you will reach an open area.

Directly ahead you will see a stairway leading up, this is where you will want to go. Once at the top, open the door to create a shortcut back to the bonfire.

This is the final bonfire stop of this area before the upcoming boss, so rest, repair and level up.

Prior to fighting the area boss, ensure you have farmed the Basilisks until you have a minimum of 7 Eyes of Death.

Levelling Up

Once again you will level your character up, with some stats beginning to show diminishing returns. You will now need to perform the Soul Duplication Glitch with 6 Souls of a Nameless Soldier and 2 Large Souls of a Nameless Soldier. Prior to doing this, ensure you only have 1 of each soul item by dropping any remainder on the ground away from the bonfire. If you didn't collect all of these items, try to get as close as possible to what is shown. Allocate your souls to the following attributes below.

Return to the bottom of the previously accessed stairs and kill any Sewer Rats or Slimes down in that area.

To the right of this area is a tunnel that leads to the boss of this area, but before this, continue forward and there will be a NPC, Domhnall of Zena.

Speak to him and purchase the following items: 3 Gold Pine Resins Don't purchase anything else from him as they are not worth it for their stats. Equip the Gold Pine Resins and previously purchased Blooming Purple Moss Clumps to your equipment bar.

Head into the nearby tunnel and you will see a very large open area ahead, which is where the next boss Gaping Dragon is located.

Follow the path around to find a summon sign for Solaire of Astora and a corpse with a Heavy Crossbow and 11 Heavy Bolts.

Please read the strategy below for this upcoming boss as it has some very damaging attacks and can kill you instantly if you are not careful.

Missable Item

The upcoming boss Gaping Dragon has a special weapon you require, which is called the Dragon King Greataxe. This axe is acquired by cutting off the tail of this dragon, but it can take some damage to do so and the point where it cuts off is specific. It is recommended you use the Cloud Save or a USB Device to back your save up and retry if you miss the opportunity.

Prior to entering the fog gate, summon Solaire and wait for him to spawn in. Once he has done this, approach the fog gate and apply the Gold Pine Resin to your Shortsword+5, then enter.

There will be a cutscene where the Gaping Dragon appears, showing off its large size and many teeth it will use to try and kill you. Once this cutscene ends, it will most likely try to charge you, so run to one side of it and get behind it immediately.

Your first priority is to cut it's tail off, so two-hand the sword and begin swinging away. Whilst you're doing this you must be careful of it's tail as it can swing and hit you for decent damage. Hopefully it will be focused on Solaire and after 2-3 hits, the tail will be cut and you will acquire the Dragon King Greataxe (3/48).

For this fight the Gaping Dragon will vary it's attacks, but mainly on Solaire, so stay behind it and spam it with Lightning Spear. Once you run out of casts for this spell, move onto your Sorceries to finish it off.

For your own safety, keep your distance from it and avoid melee attacks (other than to cut the tail), and watch out for its attacks as described below:

The Gaping Dragon lifts it's head up and will bend it's body backwards, with ribcage baring outwards. It will slam it's body down on the ground and begin moving the ribcage around to deal damage. If you are caught in this, you will take extreme damage, nearly killing you. Don't try to attack it with melee.

Shortly after the above attack, it will normally charge ahead dragging it's ribcage on the ground. This will kill you if you are caught in it, which is why you should remain to the side or behind it. If you have Solaire, it will almost kill him as well.

It can do a pounding attack on the ground in front of it. It will normally do this if you are attacking it from the front of it, or attacking it's forward legs. Avoid melee attacking to avoid this attack.

The Gaping Dragon can float up in the air and will normally do this to reposition itself to face you. This normally occurs if aggro changes from Solaire to you and you are behind it. Just run away if you see it start to fly and reposition behind it.

It can swipe at you with it's tail, but this is completely negated if you cut it off to begin with. On subsequent playthroughs you don't need to cut the tail off again, so it's something to be aware of.

Beware if you are close to it's front legs as it can grab you, which can lead to an instant death if you aren't quick to get out of the way. If you do get grabbed, spam L2 + R2 to avoid the deadly damage it will inflict.

Once it's health begins to get low it will spew out a large pool of acid underneath it. This acid will destroy your equipment, so simply run away from it as it can spread rather quickly.

Once you are successful in defeating the Gaping Dragon you will acquire the Blighttown Key, 1 Homeward Bone, 1 Twin Humanities and another Sunlight Medal for fighting with Solaire and him surviving.

Use a Homeward Bone to return to the bonfire before heading on to the next area of the walkthrough.

Head past Domhnall of Zena and open the large doors to the next area, Blighttown.

Blighttown is infamous for being a terrible area to get through, with low light, small walkways and platforms, and a poisonous swamp at the bottom to finish it off.

Take things slow and watch where you walk in this area. If you get stuck, you can always use a Homeward Bone to reset and get yourself out of a bad situation.

Descend the nearby ladder to get started.

The first enemy you will find in here is an Infested Barbarian, which will approach you and attack you as soon as you step off the second ladder.

Their club attacks can knock you back and if you have poor positioning, you'll fall off any walkways.

Get behind it and backstab, or bait an attack, dodge and cast any of your Sorceries.

Directly ahead will be two more Infested Barbarians, so try and aggro one at a time, or you may have trouble dealing with both with such small room.

Once these are dead, there will be another new enemy ahead, Infested Ghouls. Be careful as they can grab you and deal large amounts of damage and can push you off ledges.

As there are numerous amount of these Infested Ghouls ahead, it will be up to you to scout forward and deal with them. The guide will not warn you of their locations from this point.

To your right as you move forward you will find a Blowdart Sniper that shoots from a distance and inflicts Toxic. Use Blooming Purple Moss Clumps to remove this status.

The nearby ladder drops down to a lower level with a corpse that has a Soul of a Proud Knight.

The path forward splits, with the right path having two pathways to move. Ignore the left side for now, but take a look at the wooden path ahead. It will move as you walk on it, and if not careful, you can slip off.

Continue past this moving path and along the right of the wooden walls to find a dirt path. There is an item below that you can loot, which is the Shadow Set. Swap out your current Sorcerer Set+3 for this set as it gives better Poison Resistance.

Drop off the current platform near the ladder and loot the corpse underneath for a Soul of a Proud Knight.

Roll off the platform and walk right to find another corpse with another Soul of a Proud Knight.

To continue on from this area, you will need to jump to a lower platform ahead. Take a run up and jump across the gap, just being careful of a Flaming Attack Dog to the left as you land.

To the left is a bonfire, which you should rest at, Kindle and repair any of your equipment that may be damaged.

Nearby from where you encountered the Flaming Attack Dog is a ladder you can climb to return to the fork in the paths you passed earlier. Climb it, kill any enemies and loot the corpse along the way to the fork for a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

To the left of this fork is an item ahead that is needed for an Unique Weapon and is useful for some future bosses. To get to this item, you will need to jump across the gap. If you miss the item, you will most likely fall and die.

The point to jump is the pointing wooden beam at the end of the path. Once you jump across, loot the corpse for the Iaito. Drop off the roof and return to the bonfire nearby.

Head past the bonfire and ignore the nearby ladder. Beware of an ambush as you move ahead and kill any enemies on the walkway ahead.

To your lower right as you enter this next wooden structure you will see some sort of monster with tentacles. This is a Parasitic Wall Hugger, and this monster is guarding a Pyromancy.

Work your way down to its location and along the way, loot the Soul of a Proud Knight and descend a nearby ladder. At the bottom of this ladder is a Blowdart Sniper you can kill.

Follow the pathway around to the left and you will find a corpse on a large beam with an Eagle Shield.

Return up the ladder afterwards.

There is another ladder nearby that you can descend, it's difficult to see but it is close to a lit torch. To the left you can find the Parasitic Wall Hugger.

To the right is a sloped path leading to a cave, with a corpse on the path with a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Kill the Parasitic Wall Hugger with Soul Arrow or any similar sorceries from a distance, as it can swipe you off the walkway.

Loot the nearby corpse it was guarding to find Pyromancy: Power Within (6/19). This spell should be used frequently when dealing with bosses to deal larger damage. It is optional to use, but it is recommended.

Enter the nearby cave, killing the Infested Barbarian and Infested Ghoul inside. Approach the ladder directly in front and you will see a fog gate. There is a corpse below you can drop to for a Whip, but this is optional.

Descend the ladder ahead and you can enter the fog gate at the bottom to enter the next area. If you acquire the Whip, drop down further and leave this area.

There is some enemies ahead that deal Fire based damage called Cragspiders. You can one shot kill them with Soul Arrow with your current stats.

Continue forward, being particularly careful of dropping down levels. For some reason, some falls here will result in death, even if the fall isn't deadly.

There is Giant Mosquitoes that will attack you whilst navigating down the platform in twos. Once you kill them three times each they will stop spawning.

To the left is a Blowdart Sniper that you should kill before moving down, which is also guarding a Wanderer Set and a Falchion (required for Unique Weapon creation).

Some exploration of this swamp area is going to be required to find some items, an important NPC that sells Pyromancies and killing a Hostile Phantom.

Once you reach the bottom, head to the right of the giant concrete pillar and follow this wall. As you drop off the wooden structure, look under the structure to the right to find a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

As you follow the right wall, kill any enemies that attack you and enter the sewer to the right to find a bonfire. Rest, kindle and repair any equipment.

If you follow the sewer in further you will find a chest with a Dragon Scale inside, which can be used later to upgrade weapons.

Return near the bonfire to level up with your soul items you have found.

Levelling Up

At this point in the walkthrough you will need to perform the Soul Duplication Glitch with 2 Large Souls of a Nameless Soldier, 4 Souls of a Proud Knight and 1 Large Soul of a Proud Knight. Any extra soul items dropped by Infested Ghouls were not accounted for. If you have those soul items, you may use them to increase your stats further than below. As usual, ensure you have only 1 of each soul item in your inventory before duplicating. Allocate your souls to the following attributes below.

Exit the sewer once you have finished levelling up and as you walk to the right a bit, you will be invaded by Dark Spirit Maneater Mildred. Lure her into the sewer to fight her.

She has a habit of rolling to avoid your Sorceries, so you can either try to land a hit just after you roll to dodge her attacks, or move around her and backstab.

Once she is dead, she drops 3 Humanity and a Butcher Knife.

Near where she spawned in to the right is a large lift mechanism that heads upwards. You can ignore this for now, but just know this is your path out of this swamp once you are done here.

Nearby is a concrete pillar next to the torches that has a Cragspider and a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Important NPC

Ahead is a Pyromancer called Quelana of Izalith, who sells Pyromancies and can upgrade your Pyromancy Flame+15 to an ascended variant. Do not attack her as this will lock you out of these items until the next playthrough.

Continue past the lift mechanism to your right to the next large concrete pillar and there will be a lady sitting on the ground, Quelana of Izalith. Speak to her and select YES.

Purchase the following Pyromancies from her: Fire Orb for 8000 Souls Great Fireball (7/19) for 20000 Souls Firestorm (8/19) for 30000 Souls Fire Whip (9/19) for 10000 Souls Combustion for 500 Souls Great Combustion (10/19) for 5000 Souls Undead Rapport (11/19) for 10000 Souls Fireball for 800 Souls Do not upgrade your Pyromancy Flame+15 just yet, you will return to her once you defeat the upcoming boss and acquire another Pyromancy Flame.

Directly ahead are 3 Infested Barbarians in the swamp, at the base of a hill that leads to a tunnel.

You can avoid these by walking into the swamp as far right as possible and walking into the tunnel.

If they attack you, they will pick up large rocks and either throw them at you, or attempt to roll them over you.
