Behind Quelana on your way across you can loot a corpse for a Large Titanite Shard.

In the tunnel are some Egg Carriers that are docile. Don't attack them as they when they die they will release Vile Maggots which are annoying to deal with.

Just past these enemies is the fog gate to the next boss and a summon sign for Maneater Mildred who will be a great distraction for the upcoming fight.

Please read the following strategy on how to beat the next boss, Chaos Witch Quelaag.

Prior to entering the fog gate, summon Maneater Mildred to help you defeat Chaos Witch Quelaag. She can deal some damage, but she will mainly be used to distract the boss and re-focus aggro so you can shoot Sorceries with no incoming attacks.

Chaos Witch Quelaag will open this fight normally by rushing you and doing a leaping attack and spewing out Chaos lava on the ground directly in front of it. With your current setup, if you roll out of the way, you will take minimal damage.

Run away from her once she does her opening attack, which will cause her to re-focus on Maneater Mildred. If she doesn't dodge her attacks and run back towards your summon support.

Spam Great Heavy Soul Arrow once she is focused on your summon and when you run out of that, finish her off with Heavy Soul Arrow. The fight should really only last a minute or so as you have quite high Intelligence.

If you choose to engage her, or she does not focus on Maneater Mildred, her attacks are as follows:

As mentioned, she can leap and spew Chaos lava on the ground in front. This is indicative of her briefly pausing, crouching, then leaping with the lower half's mouth open. You should roll directly to the left when you see the Chaos come out of the mouth.

She can spew out the Chaos lava in another way, but it will be when you are close to her. She will pause when you are close, then spew out the Chaos on the ground directly in front of her. Very easy to dodge as you can just move to the left when she pauses, as the attack doesn't track.

Chaos Witch Quelaag has some sword slashing attacks to be careful of. She will run towards you, or when you are close and will raise her sword. The attack will either be a thrusting attack, or two slashing attack. For the thrust, roll to a side, and for the slash, roll backwards.

If you are directly behind her, her abdomen will begin to shake and she will eject Chaos lava in a spraying pattern. Roll away if she begins doing this. It is very hard to tell when she is going to do this, but it normally occurs during her aggro changing to Maneater Mildred.

If she dips her body down next to the face of the lower half of her body, she is about to perform a large fire explosion. Even at your level this is quite destructive, so if you see this, run away from her immediately.

If you want to cheese this fight, on the left side of the boss area there is a small nook to hide in and she can't hit you. You could run in here immediately as the fight starts and spam Sorceries safely.

Once the battle is over she will drop a Twin Humanities and your first boss soul, the Soul of Quelaag.

Continue to the end of this area to find a large lever, which is used to Ring the Second Bell of Awakening. Ringing this will unlock another trophy, Ring the Bell (Quelaag's Domain) and bringing this portion of the walkthrough to an end.

Before you continue on to the next portion of the walkthrough, you should have unlocked, or purchased the following Sorceries, Pyromancies and Unique Weapon. If you haven't, please retrace your steps to find out what you have missed and acquire them before moving on.

Great Soul Arrow Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim Heavy Soul Arrow Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim

Great Heavy Soul Arrow Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim Magic Weapon Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim

Magic Shield Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim Aural Decoy Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim

Fall Control Purchased from Griggs of Vinheim Fireball Purchased from Laurentius of the Great Swamp or Quelana of Izalith.

Fire Orb Purchased from Laurentius of the Great Swamp or Quelana of Izalith. Combustion Purchased from Laurentius of the Great Swamp or Quelana of Izalith.

Iron Flesh Flash Sweat Purchased from Laurentius of the Great Swamp Purchased from Laurentius of the Great Swamp

Great Fireball Purchased from Quelana of Izalith. Great Combustion Purchased from Quelana of Izalith.

Firestorm Fire Whip Purchased from Quelana of Izalith.

Undead Rapport Purchased from Quelana of Izalith. Power Within Found next to the Parasitic Wall Hugger in Blighttown.

Dragon King Greataxe Cut the tail off the Gaping Dragon.

This next portion of the walkthrough will find your main character acquiring the ability to navigate the Abyss, the Covenant of Artorias. Before that you'll need to escape this swamp you're in, fight some bosses, and acquire more Sorceries, Pyromancies and Unique Weapons.

Follow the nearby stairs down to the right of the lever and there will be a large blue circle on the ground.

As you face the next exit into a web-filled tunnel, to the right is an illusionary wall you can strike with a weapon. This will reveal a new area, but ignore this for now.

Walk down the tunnel until you leave Quelaag's Doman and enter the Demon Ruins. Rest at the nearby bonfire, Kindle and repair any of your equipment.

You will now need to get the Egg Head status by getting infected by one of the nearby Egg Carriers.

There are some further down the slope here that are hostile. Get close, but don't attack and it will grab you and attack with a Vile Maggot.

Rest at the bonfire and stand up once you have healed. After 5 minutes of waiting, and your character constantly scratching it's head, you will acquire the Egg Head status.

Important NPC

There is an Egg Carrier coming up that is not hostile and is a friendly NPC named Eingyi, who is also a member of the Chaos Servant covenant. Do not attack him as he sells Pyromancies, grants another Pyromancy Flame and will allow you to enter the covenant. Additionally, do not attack the Daughter of Chaos near him.

Head back through the tunnel and into the room behind the illusionary wall. Speak to the nearby Egg Carrier Eingyi and answer with YES for him to move aside.

Speak to the woman here, the Daughter of Chaos to enter the Chaos Servant covenant, acquire Pyromancy: Great Chaos Fireball (12/19) and Covenant: Chaos Servant.

Do not offer any Humanity at this time.

Speak to Eingyi again, select Talk and then choose YES when you need to make a choice. He will give you a Pyromancy Flame.

Purchase the following Pyromancies from him: Poison Mist (13/19) for 10000 Souls Toxic Mist (14/19) for 25000 Souls Modify your new Pyromancy Flame to Pyromancy Flame+15 for 149,500 Souls, then leave.

Rest at the nearby bonfire and head back out of this area through the tunnel. Consume the Egg Vermifuge that Eingyi gave you and re-equip your Shadow Mask.

To your right as you exit the tunnel you can see a fog gate in the distance. You are going to quickly defeat a boss to open a future area and acquire some great gear.

Move down the slope near the hostile Egg Carriers and around to the right across the bridge.

The next boss requires no real strategy as you aren't technically going to fight it; however, please read below on what is required of you so you don't get killed.

Yes, that is the correct name for this boss. This boss, Ceaseless Discharge, can be fought in two ways. One which requires fighting it, with it causing massive AOE attacks that can hit you through walls, and tough wide sweeping attacks.

Or you could just take something from it, run away, and hurt it while it is vulnerable for an easy kill, which is exactly what you should do.

Enter the fog gate and run all the way along the path ahead until you see Ceaseless Discharge on the left, non-hostile. Continue along the path around to the right and you will see a corpse with an item. Loot this corpse for a Gold-Hemmed Black Set, which will make the boss hostile.

Wait for the boss to do an upwards swing attack, then run straight past it. It will follow you, so continue on to the fog gate and wait for it to reach you. Sit close to the fog gate and Ceaseless Discharge will leap to try and attack you.

It is now stuck defenseless, so attack it with any means you want and after a few strikes it will fall to the depths below. Once this battle is over, there will be a cutscene.

Upon defeat, Ceaseless Discharge will drop 1 Humanity and a Homeward Bone. If you take a look at the area below you, you will notice all the lava has disappeared and there are plenty of Taurus Demons off in the distance.

Ignore this for now and use a Homeward Bone to return to the bonfire.

As ridiculous as it looks, equip the Gold-Hemmed Black Set as it has great defensive stats.

Unfortunately it cannot be upgraded, so it will be replaced later. Leave Quelaag's Domain for quite some time and return to Quelana of Izalith.

Modify your two Pyromancy Flame+15 to the following: Both to Ascended Pyromancy Flame for 50000 Souls.

Only ONE of the Ascended Pyromancy Flames to Ascended Pyromancy Flame+5 for 166,000 Souls

There are numerous items in the swamp of Blighttown, none which are really essential at the moment. You will need to return here at a later point, but for now ignore these items.

Kill the nearby Cragspider and return to the bonfire inside of the nearby sewer. Now it's time to leave, so head up to the lift mechanism from earlier and walk up the ladder.

There is a platform you will need to walk onto as it rises, then roll off at the top.

As you reach roughly 12 o'clock on the top of the rotating part, you can roll or walk off the side to reach an upper wooden platform. If you fail to do this, you will either follow the lift down, or fall off and die.

Climb up the nearby ladder and then another once you get to the top of it. There is a lower section we skipped for now as Blowdart Snipers will try to shoot you off some walkways.

Ignore the next ladder and to the right of it will be a Blowdart Sniper in front of a large sewer opening.

Head inside it, but cautiously as there is a big group of snipers inside.

Once inside, kill the enemies in here with your Sorceries, healing Toxic with the Blooming Purple Moss Clump when you need to. There is a Soul of a Proud Knight in the first left tunnel.

Below will be some Flaming Attack Dogs you can kill from above to make things easier. Climb down the ladder once they are dead.

Kill the remaining enemies down the bottom here, then loot the corpse in the right section of the sewer for a Fire Keeper Soul.

Return to the second ladder you climbed and go back down a level.

Continue along the lower path and you will come across some large tree roots. Walk across these carefully as you can slip and fall if you are not central on the path.

Ahead you will find a corpse with a Crimson Set and a Tin Banishment Catalyst. The chest contains Sorcery: Remedy (9/24) which you should also loot.

Return to the upper level and climb the ladders just before the large sewer opening. You will reach another level with a Cragspider, so kill it and continue upwards.

At the top you can find another chest over to the right. Open it for a Key to New Londo Ruins, which is quite useless at this point (Master Key).

Follow the pathway off to the left, killing the Infested Barbarians and you will finally be outside Blighttown.

Your destination is directly ahead, but prior to this there are some items you can collect. Follow the pathway heading right, crossing the rope bridge ahead.

There is a large Undead Dragon sleeping here, with some items you will need to collect. Head up the small walkway in front of it and spam your Sorceries. It won't react so you can safely kill it for a Dragon Scale.

Loot the corpses on the ground for a Astora's Straight Sword (4/48), Dragon Crest Shield (5/48) and a Soul of a Proud Knight.

Return to the entry of Blighttown, then cross over the gap and open the gate to New Londo Ruins, looting the nearby corpse for a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Head back to Firelink Shrine, ignoring any exploring in New Londo Ruins for now.

Rest at the bonfire, repair any damaged equipment and attune the following additional spell:

Fall Control Head to the lift that leads to the Undead Parish. Do not speak to Laurentius and ignore the large snake creature nearby.

There will be a few more NPCs next to Petrus who you can speak to, particularly the woman, Rhea of Thorolund.

Ride the lift up, but roll off as you pass the roof, roll or walk off so you have access to the cliff outside to the right.

At the edge of the cliff is a beam you can either jump to or roll to. You will need to follow this beam up to the large structure and to the left.

Either roll or drop down to a roof that is on the left of this large structure to find a corpse. Loot the corpse for the Undead Asylum F2 West Key, then drop down safely.

Take the lift back up and reach the large structure again.

Follow the stairs of the structure to the top and this time heading right towards the upper right.

You will come across a giant nest at the top with the prompt to Curl up like a ball, which is what you should do, and wait. This will take you back to the Northern Undead Asylum.

Once you arrive, kill any Hollows that approach you and then walk around to the left to find a small nest.

There is a crow here named Snuggly who will trade items with you, returning a worse or better item depending on the trade. To trade, you will drop an item, then quit the game. Reload and a new item will be on the ground, but only once per playthrough.

So, the following items you want to trade one at a time are: Rubbish for a Titanite Chunk Purple Moss Clump for a Twinkling Titanite Blooming Purple Moss Clump for 2 Twinkling Titanite Dung Pie for a Demon Titanite Twin Humanities for a Rare Ring of Sacrifice Prism Stone for a Demon Titanite Ascended Pyromancy Flame (not +5) for a Red Titanite Slab One thing to note is each time you reload your game your character moves back slightly.

Reposition yourself so you don't fall off the ledge.

Missable Item

The upcoming boss has an item that is used to upgrade weapons to +15. This item, the Titanite Slab, is missable due to the fact that if you and the next boss die simultaneously for whatever reason, the item will disappear. It is recommended you use the Cloud Save or a USB Device to back your save up and retry if you miss the opportunity.

Head inside the asylum, but do not go near the centre. The floor will break away and you will be forced into a boss fight.

Kill the two Hollows in this room, then read the strategy below on how to beat the next boss Stray Demon.

Cast Fall Control prior to approaching the centre section of this room, as not doing so will result in a large amount of fall damage. You get a few seconds to land a free hit on the Stray Demon as you land, so not healing will put you in a better place.

Use Heavy Soul Arrow to begin with and try to stay behind the demon at all times. This enemy will use magical blasts to hurt you, so avoiding these is the priority.

Only use your spells in between attacks, as you need to act accordingly and dodge the specific attack in a certain way. Getting greedy will spells will not give you much time to react.

In saying that, the attacks it will do are as follows and you should dodge and act in a certain way to not be damaged:

Pulls the staff to the left side of it's body, with a brief pause. This is a magical attack and it will make an explosion directly in front of itself. Run or roll to the right side of it's body to avoid the attack.

Pulls the staff quickly to either side of it's body is a melee attack and it is very quick. It normally does two quick swipes in succession horizontally. You can avoid this by rolling to the right side of it's body.

The Stray Demon will fly up in the air and slam down on the spot. This occurs when you are too close to it's back or in front of it. Just roll away to avoid this attack in any direction.

The demon will swing it's staff above and behind it's head. It is going to slam the staff directly down in front to melee attack you. There is no spell with this attack, so roll to the left or right to avoid damage. Rolling back or forward will result in damage.

The demon will point it's staff at the ground vertically, then raise it in the air. It will then slam it down vertically into the ground to cause a large magical explosion. Just run away when you see this.

Alternatively, you can swap your Shortsword+5 for the Iaito you acquired in Blighttown. Slashing the Stray Demon with this 3 times will inflict about 15% health damage for 3 hits.

Do this combo 7-8 times and it will be dead, using the same evading strategies as above.

Once it dies, loot the ground for a Titanite Slab. The Stray Demon will also drop a Humanity and a Homeward Bone.

There is a ladder you must climb to get out of the lower area. Once you climb it, there will be a Black Knight to the left, guarding the cell you started the game in. Kill it to acquire a Red Titanite Chunk, then enter the cell.

Loot the corpse in the cell for the Peculiar Doll.

Head up to the bonfire and rest, as you try to enter the gate you previously opened you will be attacked by a hollow Oscar of Astora.

Bring him out near the bonfire to fight him, which shouldn't be a problem for you. He fat rolls and can be beaten from a distance with your Sorceries.

Ensure you loot his body before resting at the bonfire for a Crest Shield (6/48).

If you follow the same route you did at the start of the game, through the gate in the Asylum Demon boss room, you will find a Black Knight that can be killed for another Red Titanite Chunk.

Continue on this path and return to the stairs that lead upwards with the rolling ball. The ball has returned, so dodge out of the way when it rolls down, then kill all of the Hollows at the top.

Head past where the fog gate was previously to find two Undead Soldiers by a door. Kill them both and open the door with the Undead Asylum F2 West Key.

Pillage the corpse at the end for a Rusted Iron Ring, which removes the restriction of walking through deep water or swamps.

Return to Firelink Shrine by approaching the cliff and Curling up like a ball inside the large nest.

Safely work your way down to the bonfire in Firelink Shrine, then rest and remove the following spells:

Soul Arrow (x2) Fall Control Lightning Spear Attune the following spells: Combustion (x2) Great Combustion Firestorm Great Fireball Replace your Talisman with the Ascended Pyromancy Flame+5. From this point forward, you can use either Sorceries or Pyromancies for most enemies, but sticking to strategies provided for bosses.

Speak to Anastacia of Astora and reinforce your Estus Flask+2 to Estus Flask+3, then head to Andre in the Undead Parish.

Speak to Andre and he will mention the Large Ember you have in your possession. Select YES when the option is given.

There is nothing of interest to purchased for the time being, so leave the menu and head out the door behind you.

There is a dangerous monster in here called a Titanite Demon that shoots Lightning from a distance. It can also deal heavy damage with it's weapon and leap to you from a distance.

Kill it with your Sorceries or Pyromancies from a distance, then loot it for a Demon Titanite. Walking through the next door will lead you into Darkroot Garden.

Some new enemies ahead, Ents, can appear from the ground, but they appear as grass patches. They will ambush you fairly often and have large aggro range. They are weak to Sorceries or Pyromancies, so use what you are comfortable with.

Follow the path ahead, killing Ents along the way. You can loot the corpse along the way for a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

At the door here, there is an illusionary wall to the right of it. Hit the wall, then rest, kindle and repair at the bonfire.

Levelling Up

At this point in the walkthrough you will need to level up once again using the Soul Duplication Glitch. In your inventory, the major soul items that are going to be used are 2 Large Souls of a Nameless Soldier, 2 Souls of a Proud Knight and 1 Large Soul of a Proud Knight. If you have more soul items, you may use those too. Allocate your souls to the following attributes below, keeping some souls for expensive purchases later.

Open the nearby door with the Crest of Artorias, which will lead to a forest area with some hostile NPCs. These NPCs are copies of all the starting classes, including weapons and spells.

It's best to take them on one by one with Pyromancies, as you can become overwhelmed quite easily. Do note that the Bandit is partially invisible, cannot be targeted, and can backstab you, so use Firestorm.

One of these hostile NPCs, the Archer, has some items to loot, particularly the Black Bow of Pharis.

This bow will be particularly useful later on, being the best bow for Dexterity scaling, and can be used to exploit certain bosses (which will occur).

Ignore the forest section past the Archer and enter the stone structure directly ahead from the steps you entered the forest from.

Inside will be a large cat, which you must not attack. Speak to Alvina, selecting YES three times when the options are given to join the Forest Hunter Forest Hunter. You will also acquire the Cat Covenant Ring.

Return to the bonfire to refill any spells you may have used against the hostile NPCs, then return to Alvina.

Continue through the structure to the next area. Walk around the structure to the left to find a chest with a Stone Set.

As you walk further into the forest you will find both small and large Mushroom People. The large ones are very dangerous, whereas the smaller ones will try to trip you while you fight the larger ones,

Kill the two large Mushroom People in the small patch of water to safely access the nearby chest.

Open this chest for an Enchanted Ember (2/10), which will be given to an NPC in New Londo Ruins at a later point.

On the other side of this forest will be a bridge leading to a large set of doors. This is the next boss you will need to face to progress the story.

Please read the below strategy on how to defeat Great Grey Wolf Sif, as this boss may be quite difficult for some players.

Before you enter the boss room, swap out your Shortsword+5 for your Ascended Pyromancy Flame+5, from left to right hand. You will also want to swap out your Gold-Hemmed Black Set for the Crimson Set, for more Physical Defense.

The boss Great Grey Wolf Sif is a giant wolf that has a rather large sword to fight you with.

This sword will deal extreme damage to you, even at your current level. The main strategy is to keep your shield up, dodge attacks you can, then get under it and use Combustion and Great Combustion.

Knowing what attacks it is going to use is key as some attacks can be tanked with the shield, where one of it's attacks may break your stamina and cause large damage if you are not at full stamina charge.

Great Grey Wolf Sif has a number of attacks, but are mostly sweeping attacks from it's sword. With your current build you should be able to tank all of these attacks, but you need to keep an eye on your stamina.

The attack she uses the most is a horizontal swing from side to side, and normally does this with two swipes. You should be able to tank this with the shield, or roll directly under her.

She can do a 360 degree spinning attack with the sword. This has a long wind up and is easy to spot. You can either roll backwards, or tank it with the shield.

Sif can get on her back legs and slam the sword down on the ground in front of her. Simply roll to either side of the sword, or tank it with the shield.

If you are close to her, or under her, she will regularly backflip and swipe you with the sword. Once again, you can tank this attack with your shield.

You will be given the Covenant of Artorias, Soul of Sif, a Humanity and another Homeward Bone for your success in this battle. You will also unlock Art of Abysswalking.

Before you leave, take a look behind the big tombstone to find a corpse with the Hornet Ring, which will be useful later.

Leave the boss area and head back across the bridge. Follow the lower pathway around to the left to collect some items before moving onto the next boss in Darkroot Garden.

In this next section of forest you can find a corpse with a Large Soul of a Brave Warrior. Be very careful with another enemy in this area, a Giant Cat, which are very quick and they deal big damage.

You can bait them towards the tree line and shoot them Sorceries, or with the Black Bow of Pharis and Poison Arrows, as they can't hit you.

Once all 3 Giant Cats are dead, continue on this path and cross the bridge and climb down the nearby ladder.

Loot the corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior and climb back up the ladder. Follow the path leading to the right away from the bridge.

In this next section of forest there are some items to collect. Beware of the large quantity of Ents that will ambush you here.

On the cliff at the end of this forest is the Eastern Set, with a great view of the Undead Burg and Undead Parish. You may also equip this set, but as the cost of losing your fast roll.

Return to the bonfire with a Homeward Bone.

There is one more boss remaining in this area before moving onto the next area, Darkroot Basin.

From the bonfire, look to the right of the door into the forest to see a path leading down.

Follow it down and there is a corpse to your right with a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier. Picking this up will cause 3 Ents to attack.

Enter the fog gate once you have finished them off.

In this next section of forest there are Giant Stone Knights which drop 2 Unique Weapons. They cast a spell called Tranquil Walk of Peace, which will prevent you from jogging/running. Once you see them move, kill them with Pyromancies immediately.

You can try to farm them for the Stone Greatsword or the Stone Greatshield now if you like, or you can wait until later in the walkthrough.

There is a corpse near 3 of them that you can loot for an Elite Knight Set.

To the right of the entrance to this area is a Possessed Tree blocking a path. They are weak to Pyromancies and are not hostile.

Following the path down you will discover a Frog- Ray enemy, which are a good source of Green Blossom consumables.

Continue down the path, killing the next Possessed Tree and entering a new area.

There is a tunnel to the right that returns to the area just before the bonfire, which you will go shortly.

If you approach the nearby cliffside, you will be ambushed by 4 Frog-Rays and a Giant Stone Knights. Kill the knight first, then follow the cliff along to find a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight.

Enter the tunnel and kill the Giant Stone Knight at the end. Loot the corpse for a Wolf Ring, which increases Poise (not something you have much of at the moment or really need).

Jump across the gap, or return to the bonfire with a Homeward Bone if you are not comfortable jumping.

Return to the area with the large group of Giant Stone Knights and Ents, this time moving along the left side to find a break in the wall. Kill the Tree Lizard and loot the Partizan (required for Unique Weapon creation).

Continue hugging the left wall to find a stone building with a Giant Stone Knight at the front of it.

Kill it and head inside. Please read the below strategy for the upcoming boss Moonlight Butterfly.

This fight will be over fairly quickly, there is more time spent waiting for your friendly summon to reach the top of the stairs and for the boss to appear than actually fighting it.

Summon Witch Beatrice who's sign is amongst the bushes under the stairs to make this fight finish quickly. The reason you are using her in this fight is for a future fight with a very tough boss. Otherwise, she's not really needed.

Enter the fog gate and wait for the Moonlight Butterfly to appear directly in front of the fog gate you entered. Once it spawns in, wait a couple of seconds to start firing off Great Heavy Soul Arrow. For some reason, even though you can target it, damage cannot be done for at least a few seconds.

The fight will be over, but if it isn't for some unknown reason, or you are on NG+ onwards, stay close to the wall and dodge it's attacks. For your reference, the Moonlight Butterfly has the following attacks:

It will shoot energy spears outwards in all directions. You can position yourself or dodge in the breaks between the spears. Additionally, you can stand hard against the wall to avoid damage.

It will shoot homing energy balls at you or your summon. Roll out of the way to avoid damage or run away to the far side of the bridge.

The Moonlight Butterfly will fly down and drink some nectar from plants on the bridge. Once it finishes this, it will release a large energy explosion. Attack from a distance and don't get greedy with attacks.

The butterfly will drop a large energy bomb when it's health gets below 50% and will position itself above you when it is about to do it. Run behind the Moonlight Butterfly and get some distance it to avoid the blast.

It has one final attack which is a large ray beam that sweeps from one side of the bridge to the other. You will need to roll through this attack to prevent any damage.

Once you have defeated this boss you will acquire the Soul of the Moonlight Butterfly and a Humanity.

Walk to the other side of the bridge and into the next tower. Climb the stairs to find a corpse with the Watchtower Basement Key, a Divine Ember (3/10) and a Homeward Bone.

Use a Homeward Bone to return to the bonfire.

Head back towards Undead Parish, but take the path leading to the left when you come across it.

Follow the path down to enter the Darkroot Basin.

Directly ahead as you walk down is a Crystal Lizard, which you should kill before it disappears. A quick cast of Great Soul Arrow will instantly kill it, dropping 2 Twinkling Titanites and 2 Titanite Chunks.

If you failed to kill it, you can always return to the bonfire and it will respawn.

Continue down the path and when the path splits, take the left and drop down to a ledge for a corpse with the Leather Set, a Longbow and 16 Feather Arrows.

Drop down and head right, ignoring the path ahead for now. Down this path is a Black Knight that drops a Blue Titanite Chunk and a chance of a Black Knight Halberd.

Follow the path down and loot the corpse at the bottom for the Grass Crest Shield. This shield has a passive augmentation of increasing Stamina regeneration.

It is probably best to equip this if you are struggling with Stamina management, but it does not have 100% Physical damage reduction.

Ignore the nearby tunnel and return to where you dropped off the ledge. Directly ahead are some Crystal Golems that are quite slow, but pack some serious punch. There is also a giant Hydra ahead that you will need to kill as well.

You can bait the Crystal Golems to get shot by the water blast the Hydra will be firing at you to kill them off.

Move towards the Hydra and to the right of the edge of the water is a rock formation you want to stand on with your shield up. When the Hydra attacks you, quickly cast Combustion or Great Combustion to damage the neck area. Do this enough times and one of them will break off.

Once it no longer hits you from this area, free cast Great Soul Arrow or other Sorceries to cut off the remaining heads. You may also use the Black Bow of Pharis if you are comfortable.

The Hydra will drop a Dragon Scale and Dusk Crown Ring. Loot the nearby corpse and other items in the forest for a Knight Set and a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Head to the far left to a waterfall, then stay as close to the left hand wall as possible. You want to head into the cave portion and there will be a ledge to the left with 3 rocks, jump up there.

Equip the Rusted Iron Ring in lieu of the Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring.

Quit the game and reload to spawn in the Golden Crystal Golem. It will aggro straight away, so hold your shield up and wait for it to leap to you.

Roll down and get a few free shots off with Great Fireball as it tries to get down. Once it lands, either tank it's attacks with your shield or roll out of the way. Finish it off with Combustion or Great Combustion.

Important NPC

Killing the Golden Crystal Golem will free a trapped woman named Dusk of Oolacile. She sells Sorceries you require for a trophy and has some great gear that you can loot once you purchase everything from her. Do not kill attack her by accident or on purpose.

Speak to Dusk of Oolacile and select YES when the option is given. She will vanish and reappear nearby.

Follow the wall to the right out of the cave and return to the area where you looted the corpse with the Knight Set.

There will be a white summon sign on the ground, which will allow you to summon Dusk of Oolacile.

Do so now and speak to her. You can learn the gesture if you wish, otherwise purchase the following from her:

Hidden Body (10/24) for 2000 Souls Cast Light (11/24) for 1000 Souls Repair (12/24) for 10000 Souls Chameleon (13/24) for 3000 Souls Hidden Weapon (14/24) for 2000 Souls Purchase the Oolacile Ivory Catalyst as well for 1000 Souls. Leave once you have purchased all of the above.

Quit the game, then reload. Return to the location you saved Dusk of Oolacile from the Golden Crystal Golem.

Loot the corpse here for the Antiquated Set, equipping the Crown of Dusk from this set to your character. This will boost the power of your Sorceries, but decrease magic defense by 30%.

If you haven't done so already, re-equip the Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring. Return to the forest section near the water's edge.

One final thing to tick of the list before you move onto the next part of the walkthrough. Look to the pathway you came down from Darkroot Garden and to the left is a tower.

Opening the door here will reveal a very tough NPC Havel the Rock. He can be quite slow, but his attacks are very dangerous. You can kill him from range with your Sorceries.

If you need a break to heal, run back outside as he will not follow you. Once dead, he drops Havel's Ring.

Before moving onto the next part of the walkthrough, ensure you have found or purchased the following Sorceries, Pyromancies and Unique Weapons. If you haven't, please retrace your steps to find out what you have missed and acquire them before moving on.

Poison Mist Toxic Mist Purchased from Egg Carrier Eingyi.

Great Chaos Fireball Joined Chaos Servant covenant. Remedy Found in a chest in Blighttown.

Hidden Weapon Purchased from Dusk of Oolacile. Repair Purchased from Dusk of Oolacile.

Cast Light Purchased from Dusk of Oolacile. Hidden Body Purchased from Dusk of Oolacile.

Crest Shield Chameleon Purchased from Dusk of Oolacile. Dropped by Oscar of Astora in Northern Undead Asylum.

Dragon Crest Shield Found in the Valley of Drakes. Astora's Straight Sword Found in the Valley of Drakes.

The fourth part of the walkthrough will guide you towards the glorious city of Anor Londo to acquire the next story-related item, the Lordvessel. There will be some sidetracking during this time to acquire another Sorcery and more Unique Weapons. At the end of this part, you will gain the ability to Warp between bonfires.

Return to Andre in the Undead Parish and he will comment on the Divine Ember you have in your inventory. Agree to hand it over by selecting YES.

Purchase the following items from him: Longsword for 1000 Souls Tower Kite Shield for 1000 Souls

Weapons & Armor Upgrades

Before you leave Andre of Astora into the upcoming area, you use the Titanite Shards to upgrade some of your equipment. This will enable you to use these newly and older acquired weapons and armor to deal more melee damage, whilst also reducing some of it incoming as well. Upgrade the following weapons with Andre.

Black Bow of Pharis to Longsword to Tower Kite Shield to Black Bow of Pharis+5 Longsword+5 Tower Kite Shield+5 You may also upgrade your Elite Knight Set to Elite Knight Set+5, then re-purchase all of the used Titanite Shards afterwards. If you prefer the Grass Crest Shield, upgrade that instead of the Tower Kite Shield.

Replace your Shortsword+5 for the Longsword+5, replace your Knight Shield+5 for Tower Kite Shield+5/Grass Crest Shield+5.

Replace your Eastern Set for the Elite Knight Set, but do not swap out the Crown of Dusk. Rest at the bonfire upstairs and attune the following

Remove Firestorm and attune Fall Control. Head out the nearby doorway towards the large open gate, which leads to Sen's Fortress.

This upcoming area may try your patience as there is pitfalls, traps and enemies that knock you off ledges. If you have a substantial amount of souls, feel free to use them to level up further in case you lose them.

As you approach the gates and are about to enter, look at the floor for a trap mechanism. Do not walk on it. Ahead are two Man-Serpents who will attack you as you approach.

You can activate the trap when a Man-Serpent is in front of it for an easy kill. Loot the corpse in the right corner of this room for a Soul of a Brave Warrior then head up the stairs.

Ahead is a stark introduction to what awaits you. These axes will push you off and you will die from the fall.

Look directly down to see a Titanite Demon in the water below. Equip the Rusted Iron Ring and walk to the other side of the thin walkway.

Cast Fall Control and drop down, then kill the Titanite Demon from a distance with your Sorceries. Loot the ground for a Demon Titanite.

Ahead are three Serpent Mages on a higher ledge that will shoot Lightning at you. Kill them with either Sorceries or the Black Bow of Pharis+5.

In a tunnel ahead is another Titanite Demon, which is easily killed with the box from a distance. It cannot pass the pillars in the water, so take advantage of that. It will drop another Demon Titanite.

Loot the corpses at the end for a Soul of a Brave Warrior and a Scythe.

Exit the tunnel and head left to find two Titanite Demons. You can fight the first one without the other one noticing, but they won't follow you back into the large area.

Once both are dead, you can loot them for 2 more Demon Titanite. Return to the larger area and head to where the first Titanite Demon was.

To the right is a ladder and the way out of this lower watery area. There may be a Man-Serpent on this ladder, so wait for it to drop down before heading up.

The wall ahead is an illusionary wall, so strike it to reveal another ladder. Loot the corpse for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight, then climb the ladder.

Kill the Giant at the top for a Titanite Chunk, then use a Homeward Bone to return to the previous bonfire.

Retrace your steps to the walkway with the axes. Re-equip the Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring and equip the Black Bow of Pharis+5.

Aim to the top right of the walkway ahead and you will see a Serpent Mage. Shoot it and wait for the Poison to kill it off. Do the same for the Man- Serpent that is directly ahead on the thin walkway.

Odds are it will get knocked off the walkway.

For the first set of axes you can pass them as follows, rolling if required: Move past 1 axe, then wait.

Move past the next axe, then wait. Move past 2 axes and move ahead. Pass the final axe into the corridor and head up the stairs.

For the second set of axes you can pass them as follows. Move past 2 axes, then wait. Move past the final 2 axes into the next room, being mindful of the trap on the floor.

Open the chest for 2 Large Titanite Shards. Enter the next room and as you approach the door to the outside, a Man-Serpent will appear and be crushed by a rolling ball.

Kill the Man-Serpent inside then wait at the small nook for the rolling ball to pass by. You will need to run to the next nook to be safe from damage.

Once clear, shoot a Sorcery at the Serpent Mage and run into the next room at the top. Loot the chest for a Ring of Steel Protection.

Cast Fall Control and roll off to the left as you exit this room. Pillage the corpse as you land for a Shotel.

Nearby is Siegmeyer of Catarina who you must speak to. He will speak to you about his problem with the rolling ball. Speak to him until he repeats himself, then walk to the end of the path.

Wait for the rolling ball to pass, then quickly run back to the first nook. Once clear, run to the next one and enter the fog gate.

Kill the Man-Serpent inside, being careful of the trap mechanism on the floor of the narrow corridor.

There is another rolling ball ahead, which you will need to time and chase down a slope to the bottom.

Quickly chase after the rolling ball and wait at the bottom in the hallway to the left. You need to wait for the balls to pile up in the hole, then wait for one to break a nearby wall.

Head inside this newly opened room and when you have the chance, loot the corpse on the right for a Covetous Gold Serpent Ring.

Enter the next room and DO NOT open the chest here. This will be your first encounter with a Mimic.

Get behind the chest and spam Great Combustion to kill it with two hits. Loot the ground for a Lightning Spear and approach the nearby lift.

When you get onto this lift, turn around immediately and walk forward into the wall as it heads up. This lift will kill you if you stay on it, so you need to exit it as soon as it partially stops.

Walk up the stairs and head out to the right, to find the rolling ball mechanism. Firstly, you will need to direct the mechanism to where you just came from.

Doing so will break a wall at the bottom, revealing a friendly NPC. Once you have seen the wall broken, turn the mechanism 180 degrees so the ball gets pushed outside.

Important NPC

You are about to come across a very power sorcerer NPC who sells some of the strongest Sorceries in game. You also need these sorceries for trophies and he has a side quest you need to complete. Do not harm him accidentally or on purpose.

Follow the pathway down and look for a cage on the right, which has Big Hat Logan captive inside.

Open the cage with the Master Key after speaking to him, then speak to him until his dialogue repeats.

To the left is another cage you can open for a Soul of a Hero. Make your way back up to the mechanism.

You will need to move the mechanism again to face the path that leads to nothing. You will then want to take the pathway that has a corridor to the right of it.

Off the side of this sloping downwards path you will see a Serpent Mage and a corpse with an item. Kill it with Sorceries and drop down to loot the corpse for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Ignore the path that drops down, instead enter the hallway to find another corpse with a Black Sorcerer Set and Sorcery: Hush (15/24). Open the door above.

If you are interested, you can head out the opposite pathway from where you dropped down to find a corpse with a Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring. This ring is optional, but it makes your character produce no sound. This is great for avoiding enemies as they won't notice you.

If you do collect this ring, drop down onto the nearby path with the axe and make your way back up to the ball mechanism.

Before moving on, once again ensure the mechanism shoots balls to the doorway where it leads to nothing. This is important as it allows Siegmeyer to continue his quest.

Enter the corridor nearby and activate the trap, quickly walking backwards. Ahead is another row of axes, but this time you must run through all of them at once.

If you are worried about losing souls, you can make a backup now before attempting.

Kill the two Man-Serpents and Serpent Mage in the next area. You can loot a corpse for 2 Large Titanite Shards before ascending the stairs.

You can shoot the next Serpent Mage in between it's attacks with Sorceries. The final row of axes can be cleared by doing the following:

Move past 2 axes, then wait. Move past 2 axes, then be careful of the trap button on the floor to the right.

As you enter the fog gate you will be outside, but immediately under attack from bombs coming from above.

Run to the left and up the stairs, looting the Large Soul of a Brave Warrior, then drop down through the broken wall to a bonfire.

Rest, kindle and repair any equipment. You will also want to level up here.

Levelling Up

At this point in the walkthrough you will need to level up once again using the Soul Duplication Glitch. In your inventory, the major soul items that are going to be used are 1 Soul of a Hero, 2 Large Souls of a Brave Warrior, 3 Souls of a Brave Warrior, 2 Large Souls of a Proud Knight, 1 Soul of a Proud Knight and 2 Large Souls of a Nameless Soldier. If you have more soul items, DO NOT spend them as you will need them for purchases. Allocate your souls to the following attributes below.

Once you are done, attune the following spells: Great Chaos Fireball Leave the bonfire then head through the nearby path. This will bring you back to the previous room with traps.

Head outside and run up the stairs past the drop, loot the body for 2 Large Titanite Shards and head along the path towards the Tower Shield Knight.

Kill the Tower Shield Knight and continue past it. Descend the ladder towards the tower. As you walk up the stairs you will see a hollow NPC Ricard the Archer, who can be killed by keeping the shield up at the bottom of the stairs, then shooting a Sorcery once he shoots an arrow.

Loot the ground for Ricard's Rapier (required for Unique Weapon creation) and the chests inside the tower for a Rare Ring of Sacrifice and a Divine Blessing.

Return to the previous area before the Tower Shield Knight. Head right up the stairs and follow the narrow pathways to the right and into the next part of the large building.

Head past the cages and back outside, being careful of bombs again and an Undead Knight Archer to your right. Kill it when you are next to it as you can still get bombs dropped on you.

Ignore the fog gate to the right and head back outside to the next tower. From here you can aim up at the building you came from with the Black Bow of Pharis+5.

Shoot at the bombs here to reveal the Giant that has been throwing the bombs at you. Shoot it with arrows enough to Poison it. Repeat until it is dead, then head up to where it was to loot a Titanite Chunk.

Return to the narrow pathway and get to the intersection with a gap. Nearby is a gap you will need to jump across, but first you can kill the Giant that is dropping the rolling balls through the hole.

If you think you aren't going to make the jump across, back your save up prior to attempting it.

Once you jump across, speak to the Crestfallen Merchant inside and purchase the following if you are able: 91 Titanite Shards for 364,000 Souls 99 Green Titanite Shards for 495,000 Souls Thunder Stoneplate Ring and Spell Stoneplate Ring for 30000 Souls If you are interested, you can also purchase the Catarina Set for 34000 Souls, which is a better set, but has questionable looks.

Head down the stairs nearby and kill the Serpent Mage at the bottom. Loot the nearby corpse for the Cage Key, which will create a shortcut between the start of Sen's Fortress and this upper area.

Return to the top and stand next to the gap. Use Fall Control to drop down to the corpse on the left for a Sniper Crossbow and 12 Sniper Bolts.

Drop down and kill the Baldur Knight, then continue straight ahead. In the corner to the right is another Baldur Knight with a chest behind it. Loot the chest for a Flame Stoneplate Ring.

Return to the fog gate at the top of this area, interacting with the cages to open the shortcut on the way.

Please read the strategy below on the next boss, the Iron Golem

You will want to swap your Ascended Pyromancy Flame+5 with your Sorcerer Catalyst for this fight. You should also summon Iron Tarkus to aid you in this fight.

Enter the fog gate and the Iron Golem will begin by slashing and sending a shockwave in your direction. This will hit the structure in front of you, so just wait a few seconds.

Allow Iron Tarkus to run ahead to gain the aggro and then run behind the Iron Golem and begin using Great Combustion on it's legs. After a few casts, the boss will stumble and then fall down. If you are close to the side of this area, it can fall to it's death. If not, continue casting until it dies.

The Iron Golem mainly uses slash attacks, but if you stay behind it can't really hit you. Keep your shield up for the most part and hit it with your Great Combustion.

If you take too long with casting at it's legs, it can grab you or it can stomp it's feet, potentially breaking your guard and damaging you. If you get grabbed, spam L2 + R2 to avoid most of the damage.

It will slash anything in front of it with it's giant axe. Keep your shield up or roll out of the way of it's attacks.

Once defeated, the Iron Golem drops a Humanity and the Core of an Iron Golem. Interact with the nearby glowing ring of light to be swept off your feet by some Bat Wing Demons and taken to Anor Londo.

You will unlock Reach Anor Londo.

Swap back your Ascended Pyromancy Flame+5 with your Sorcerer Catalyst and descend the stairs.

These large knights are Sentinels and are easily exploitable by shield blocking and walking behind for easy Sorcery casts. Do note that they don't take damage from the front, so always try to get behind them.

Loot the chest for a Demon Titanite.

In a nearby room is a bonfire you can rest at, with a friendly NPC Darkmoon Knightess. She is a Firekeeper and is aligned with a certain covenant.

Do not attack her as it will disable warping from the bonfire later on. Due to some story events later on, she will become hostile, at which point you will be directed to return and kill her for a Fire Keeper Soul.

Exit this room and head left for some more Sentinels and two chests. Kill these enemies and then cast Great Combustion twice on the chest to the right, killing the Mimic.

Loot it and the chest on the left for a Crystal Halberd and a Twinkling Titanite. Return to the area in front of the previous bonfire and descend down the nearby elevator.

At the bottom of the elevator is a path leading towards a Gargoyle. If you failed to acquire the Gargoyle Tail Axe from earlier, you can attempt to cut the tail off here.

Drop down to the left of the stairs as you look at it for a chest with a Demon Titanite, walk under the stairs to find a slope leading up.

Be very careful as you walk up this slope as the camera acts strange and will throw your character off, potentially falling off the sides.

You need to run at the top and then jump over to the balcony on the right. Inside you will find 2 Painting Guardians.

It might be worth making a backup save here before traversing the roof beams above. Falling will result in death, even with Fall Control.

Climb the ladder and walk along the beams. As you get closer to the Painting Guardians, use your shield to block their knives, then cast Sorcery when they run to you.

Attack the chandelier to make it drop down into the room below. This will allow you to collect a Sorcery at a later point.

Continue along the beams carefully and disposing of the two remaining Painting Guardians. Climb down the ladder and enter the fog gate to head back outside.

Push the lever twice to make the giant lift go down two levels. You may also be attacked by a Gargoyle.

Walk down the stairs to the bottom of the lift to find a small room with a bonfire inside. Rest, kindle and repair any equipment.

Loot the corpse for the Ring of the Sun's Firstborn, then return to the lift and push the lever to go up one level.

Walk up the stairs leading to the main cathedral building, either kill the Sentinels or ignore them, then carry on through the right.

Ahead are some Bat Wing Demons that should be killed from a distance. They shoot Lightning so be careful of their attacks.

Follow the path down to the left and kill the other 2 Bat Wing Demons.

This next section has to be maybe the worst possible section to get through in the game. On the path heading up are two Silver Knights that shoot tracking Dragonslayer Arrows.

The approach will be to reach the first giant pillar, wait until the one on the right stops shooting, then peek and shoot it with your Black Bow of Pharis+5 and Poison Arrows.

Two shots will Poison them, then wait for it to die. Ignore the one on the left and run up to the point where the right Silver Knight was. Follow the path around and drop down to the balcony below.

Enter the fog gate and enter the doorway to the left. Light the bonfire, kindle and repair any equipment.

Speak to Solaire until he begins repeating himself. Leave and open the door opposite for a room with a Silver Knight inside. They are easy to backstab, just keep your shield up and rotate around for a backstab.

Loot the chest for 3 Sunlight Medals.

In this area of Anor Londo are variants of Silver Knights that will drop unique weapons that you require for a trophy. It is worth taking the time to grind out these weapons while you are here.

If you choose to do it now, ensure you equip the Covetous Gold Serpent Ring and farm them for the following:

Silver Knight Str. Sword (7/48) Silver Knight Spear (8/48) Silver Knight Shield (9/48)

Walk past the stairs and enter the room on the left. The fireplace has an illusionary wall inside it, so strike it to reveal a new area.

Out of all the chests down in this area, the one that is alone on the left is a Mimic. Use Great Combustion twice to kill it quickly. Loot the body for an Occult Club.

The chests contain a Dragon Tooth (10/48), Havel's Greatshield (11/48) and Havel's Set. Leave the room and return to the stairs.

Walk to the top of the central stairs and at the top, ignore the right door and enter the left. Kill the Silver Knight and loot the corpse in the room for a Soul of a Hero.

There is two chest outside to either side of the stairs, which are both Mimics. Kill both and loot them for a Gold Coin and 5 Silver Coins.

There is a Silver Knight at the end of the corridor that you can kill. Open the door on the left and head inside. The next door ahead has a Silver Knight to the right inside.

Walk up the stairs in the small room to reach the roof. Ignore the Silver Knight with the bow and enter the nearby tower with another Silver Knight.

Speak to Siegmeyer who has been trapped by some Silver Knights in the next room. Continue the dialogue until he repeats himself, then enter the next room.

There is one enemy directly to the right, then two ahead in this bedroom. Kill all of them, open the door and then speak to Siegmeyer again. He will give you a Tiny Being's Ring.

Loot the chest in the room for 2 Demon Titanite.

Return to the roof and kill the archer Silver Knight. Enter the doorway and walk down the stairs inside.

The doorway on the left has a Titanite Demon inside, which hits harder than the ones you have fought thus far. Kill it for 2 Demon Titanite.

There is a path heading forward which is to the main area of this cathedral. Ignore this for now and enter the room on the right.

In this room are two Silver Knights and two chests below. Open these for a Silver Knight Set. Open the door in the room to open a shortcut back to the bonfire.

Return to the previous hallway and enter the big cathedral. At the split on the left, head upwards to reach the upper ramparts.

Exit out of the broken window at the top and drop down. Walk around the ledge to find a new area you can roll down to. Do so and loot the corpse for a Dragonslayer Greatbow (12/48) and 1 Dragonslayer Arrow.

Cast Fall Control and Plunge Attack the Bat Wing Demon below. Kill this enemy and kill the other one nearby. Turn around and open the gate for a shortcut to a previous area.

Important NPC

The blacksmith working nearby must not be attacked as he will upgrade weapons using Boss Souls. As they are required for trophies, he must be kept alive through all playthroughs.

To the left you can find two Bat Wing Demons and a corpse with a Titanite Chunk. Speak to the Giant Blacksmith and purchase the following items:

Giant's Halberd (13/48) for 5000 Souls Enough Twinkling Titanite for 99 units. If you don't have enough souls, use any soul items in your inventory with the Soul Duplication Glitch, but DO NOT use the Soul of a Hero.

Roll to the left of the Giant Blacksmith for a chest with the Hawk Ring, then roll back past him. Walk up the nearby stairs to the top.

To the left is a Silver Knight that you should kill first. Below are some Royal Sentinels that have the same moveset as the Sentinels, but cast Wrath of the Gods if you stick close for too long.

Once dead, operate the lever nearby to open the large set of doors into this area, creating another shortcut.

There is an infamous boss duo you are about to fight called Ornstein & Smough. Please read below on the strategy on how to defeat them as they can be considered quite difficult to beat.

Swap your Ascended Pyromancy Flame+5 with your Longsword+5 for this fight, both enemies are weak to Fire and to avoid damage you will want to use ranged Sorceries. Your main focus for this fight is to kill the fat one, Smough.

Summon Solaire and wait for him to spawn in. If you run away immediately he falls for some reason and takes unnecessary damage. Once he spawns in, head to the fog gate and enter to begin the boss fight.

Ornstein will fly across the room and attack you immediately as the fight begins. Have your shield up to tank the attack and try to move away from him so he focuses on Solaire. This is your cue to attack Smough with Great Combustion.

His attacks are easy to telegraph and if you stay close to his body with your shield up, attack him in between his own attacks. Try to get this done as soon as possible to ensure Solaire doesn't lose too much health to Ornstein.

There will be a cutscene once you have killed Smough, leaving Ornstein to become super-sized. The remainder of the fight should be at range with Sorceries. The trick to finishing off is swapping aggro between yourself and Solaire. Watch out for the following attacks:

Ornstein can shoot lightning at you with his spear. There are two variants of this attack and this will usually occur at range. You must roll to dodge this attack as your shield won't block the damage.

He can also jump up in the air and slam down on the ground, dealing Lightning Damage in a close proximity. If you see him jump in the air sitting, he will do this attack. You must roll away to avoid damage.

Ornstein can sweep his spear from either side of his body. You will be able to tank this attack with your shield or you can roll through the attack. He can also swing the spear vertically down, so roll to either side.

Similar to his flying spear attack when you entered the boss area, he can do this same attack, but with more damage. You will be able to tank the damage with your shield, or roll to the right to avoid damage.

He has one final attack where he pulls the spear to the side of his body and it sparks. He will drive the spear into either you or Solaire and lift you off the ground with it, causing an electrical explosion. This deals massive damage, so you must roll away from this attack at the right moment.

Once defeated, you will acquire the Soul of Ornstein, Leo Ring, a Humanity and a Sunlight Medal if Solaire survives. Enter either of the elevators at the back of the boss area and go up.

Rest at the bonfire, kindle and repair any damage equipment.

Head onwards and open the doors for a great sight ahead. Come hither child and kneel before Princess Gwynevere to acquire the Lordvessel and obtain Lordvessel.

Speak to her again and agree to enter the Princess's Guard covenant to acquire a Ring of the Sun Princess, unlocking Covenant: Princess's Guard.

Before moving onto the next part of the walkthrough, ensure you have found or purchased the following Sorcery and Unique Weapons. If you haven't, please retrace your steps to find out what you have missed and acquire them before moving on.

Hush Acquired inside Sen's Fortress. Silv. Knight Str Sword Dropped by sword-wielding Silver Knight.

Silver Knight Spear Dropped by spear-wielding Silver Knight. Silver Knight Shield Dropped by Silver Knight.

Giant's Halberd Purchased from the Giant Blacksmith. Dragonslayer Greatbow Found in Anor Londo.

Dragon Tooth Found in Anor Londo. Havel's Greatshield Found in Anor Londo.

The focus of part 5 of this walkthrough is to enter the Painted World of Ariamis and defeat Crossbreed Priscilla, The Lifehunter. Prior to this, some exploring will be undertaken to advance Siegmeyer's quest, acquire a useful Miracle and join another covenant.

Use the nearby bonfire to warp to Firelink Shrine. Speak to Siegmeyer of Catarina and when prompted, select YES. He will reward you with Miracle: Emit Force (8/23).

Continue the conversation and he should begin repeating himself. He will disappear shortly to continue his journey.

Next to Griggs of Vinheim is Big Hat Logan who will sell you Sorceries. Speak to him and purchase the following:

Great Soul Arrow for 6000 Souls Heavy Soul Arrow for 2000 Souls Great Heavy Soul Arrow for 8000 Souls Homing Soul Mass (16/24) for 20000 Souls Soul Spear (17/24) for 20000 Souls Magic Weapon for 3000 Souls Magic Shield for 3000 Souls Soul Arrow for 1000 Souls If you do not have sufficient souls, you may perform the Soul Duplication Glitch with the Soul of a Hero in your inventory. Just allocate souls to your attributes to not waste them.

At the bonfire, remove the following spells: Great Chaos Fireball Great Fireball Heavy Soul Arrow Attune the following spells Homing Soulmass Great Soul Arrow (x2)

Great Heavy Soul Arrow (x2) Soul Spear

Warp to the Undead Parish and head down to Andre for some weapon and armor upgrades. If you haven't discovered already, to turn a weapon from +5 to +6, you must MODIFY it.

To upgrade it from +6 to +7, you go back to the upgrade menu. The same process occurs from +10 to +11, and when applying elements on a weapon.

Weapon & Armor Upgrades

You will be able to upgrade weapons with the Large Titanite Shards you purchased earlier to go to +10 with some select weapons. Upgrade the following weapons with Andre, with one weapon upgrading to Divine.

Falchion to Falchion+10 Longsword+5 to Longsword+10 Iaito to Iaito+10 Black Bow of Pharis+5 to Claymore to Claymore+5 Tower Kite Shield+5 to Black Bow of Pharis+10 Tower Kite Shield+10 to Divine Claymore+5 You may also upgrade any armor you may have chosen to use. The guide author likes the look of the Elite Knight Set, so it was upgraded to the Elite Knight Set+6.

Warp to Chamber of the Princess and head down either of the elevators to the lower level. Run past the Royal Sentinels, climb the right stairs and past the Silver Knight to the Giant Blacksmith.

The Giant Blacksmith has the ability to turn +10 weapons into Unique Weapons with the boss souls that you collect.

Weapon Upgrades

At this point you will only upgrade two weapons with Giant Blacksmith. The remainder of items that you can turn into Unique Weapons will be completed during cleanup prior to the final boss of playthrough 1. Upgrade the following items:

Longsword+10 to Greatsword of Falchion+10 to Quelaag's Furysword Artorias (14/48) (15/48) The Greatsword of Artorias you want to create has stats of 24/18/18/18 for required parameters. There is another Greatsword of Artorias that can be crafted, which requires a Straight Sword Hilt, so don't craft that one. Return to Andre once completed and upgrade Quelaag's Furysword to Quelaag's Furysword+5.

Prior to warping, ensure you have at least 3 Purple Moss Clumps. If you don't, visit the Undead Merchant in the waterway to buy some, then do not use them.

Warp to Daughter of Chaos and head back into the Blighttown Swamp. Equip Quelaag's Furysword+5 in lieu of whatever weapon you had in your right hand. Keep the Sorcerer's Catalyst in your second right slot, and equip the Rusted Iron Ring.

Follow the right hand wall in the swamp and move to the other side of the area. First on the right is two Infested Barbarians with a corpse holding a Great Club (required for Unique Weapon creation).

Further along you can see a corpse ahead in the swap with a Giant Leech over in the far corner.

Follow the pillar around to the right to find a corpse with Pyromancy: Poison Mist and the Tattered Set Loot the corpse ahead for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight, ignore the Giant Leech and continue on.

Ahead on the right are more Giant Leeches and Siegmeyer who is sleeping. Kill the Giant Leeches and then speak to him. Give him the purchased Purple Moss Clumps by choosing YES.

He will give you a Pierce Shield in return and continue on his way once you leave.

Ahead is another area with a large group of Giant Leeches. There is a Large Titanite Shard and a Server ahead if you wish to loot it.

Leave this area and continue following the pathway around. You will come across a pathway leading up.

Underneath this tree root leading upwards is a Green Titanite Shard. Walk up the root to find a corpse with a Plank Shield. Hit the nearby wall to the left to open a new area.

Loot the chest for a Twin Humanities, then hit the wall behind it for another illusionary wall. Follow the path down into The Great Hollow, then rest, kindle and repair at the bonfire.

There is a chance when descending the roots of the tree here that you may fall to your death, which is completely fine. To decrease the chances of this happening, ignore Crystal Lizards and regularly cast Fall Control.

Walk down the first root ahead and look down to the right. The trunk is visible and a corpse can be see. Drop down and loot the corpse for the Chloranthy Ring, drop down and out to the next root.

Follow the root to the right and you may see two corpses ahead. Roll to the next root and loot the corpse for a Titanite Chunk.

The next corpse has a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier, but beware of the Basilisks off to the left inside of the cave.

Following the root to the left and dropping down numerous other roots will lead to a corpse with a White Titanite Chunk.

If you feel this is too risky, there will be an opportunity to farm these later on at the end of the first playthrough.

On the same root, turn around and drop down to find another corpse on a lower root. This corpse has a Blue Titanite Chunk.

There is another corpse that has a Red Titanite Chunk back at the top, but the guide author skipped this as the root you drop to has a tendency to be slippery and results in a fatal fall.

If you skipped the above Red Titanite Chunk, you can head down another path towards the bottom of this section to find another corpse with a Red Titanite Chunk All of the above chunks can be farmed at a later point.

On the lower area with some Basilisks, you will need to either drop down or climb down a ladder to continue down the trunk.

Look for a hole with a corpse that has another Blue Titanite Chunk. Beware looting this as the Basilisks below will attack you.

Look for a corpse that is at the top of a root leading down, this is the path down to the bottom of the trunk. Loot the corpse for a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

A corpse below on a mushroom has another Titanite Chunk. This one is easily accessible so grab the item.

Safely navigate your way around the perimeter of the trunk on mushrooms to the bottom of the area.

There is a large group of small and large Mushroom People that are waiting at the bottom. Ignore them and run into the tunnel, entering the fog gate into Ash Lake.

Follow the path forward and around to the right is the bonfire. You may rest, kindle and repair any damaged equipment.

Your objective is to reach the large stump in the distance, but you have a Black Hydra that will attack and follow you.

You can either make a run for it, or kill the Black Hydra. If you choose to kill it, use the safety of the nearby broken tree root as cover, shooting with the Black Bow of Pharis+10 and the Hawk Ring.

Here is a reference of where you want to stand to shoot the Black Hydra. As it can't be Poisoned, swap to the Standard Arrow. Do not use the Wooden Arrows as they are for glitching souls.

When it gets down to a couple of heads, get close to it and finish it off with Sorceries when it's heads attack. It will drop 2 Dragon Scales. To the left of it's location you will also find a corpse with another Dragon Scale.

Continue on towards the large stump in the distance. Along the way you can find two corpses with Dragon Scales.

The Man-Eater Shells can be killed with Pyromancies or your Quelaag's Furysword+5. Their poise will break easily with these attacks.

Once you reach the stump, the entry is to the left on the other side of the sand berm.

Inside will be two Basilisks and a large Mushroom Person. Kill both of these and head outside on the nearby root. Kill the next Basilisk, then stop.

Below is a hollowed out root you need to drop to, but very slowly. Once you drop down, head inside it and loot the corpse at the end for Miracle: Great Magic Barrier (9/23).

Leave the stump back out the way you entered and walk to the left. Ahead is the direction you want to walk until you reach the giant tree.

Follow the path inside the giant tree until you see a bonfire and the Everlasting Dragon.

Approach the Everlasting Dragon and pray. Choose to enter the covenant and join. You will now be a part of the Path of the Dragon covenant, acquiring a Dragon Head Stone and Dragon Eye.

You will also unlock the trophy, Covenant: Path of the Dragon.

Before moving on, walk around the back of the Everlasting Dragon and attack it's tail. After a few strikes it will be cut off and you will unlock the Dragon Greatsword (16/48).

Use the bonfire to warp to Anor Londo.

Take the elevator down to the lower level ahead. The large lift should be where you left it, so head down the stairs into the cathedral.

If the lift is not available for use, warp to the Darkmoon Tomb and call it to you with the lever.

Walk up the stairs if this is the case when the lift arrives.

There is a large group of Painting Guardians surrounding the chandelier you dropped earlier. Kill them all and loot the corpse for Sorcery: Great Magic Weapon (18/24).

Walk towards the large painting and off to the left is another Painting Guardian and a corpse with a Black Iron Set and Black Iron Greatshield (17/48).

Approach the painting and examine it to be taken to the Painted World of Ariamis.

From this point on until you defeat the boss of this area, you will not be able to warp. The first priority is creating a shortcut between the bonfire ahead and a courtyard.

Rest at the bonfire across the bridge, kindle and repair any equipment. It may be worth swapping to the Black Iron Set you just picked up, keeping the Crown of Dusk equipped.

There is mainly Hollows in this area, but a couple of new enemies appear, Engorged Hollows and Harpies. There are also some other enemies which will be explained later.

Head up the stairs in the next area, killing Hollows along the way. Once you can see the courtyard to the lower right, look to the left to see stairs which you can walk up.

At the top is a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight. Looting this will cause two Harpies to attack you.

When you kill these enemies, they have a chance to drop a Souvenir of Reprisal, which you will need 10 of before leaving after the boss.

Drop down next to the corpse to find another with a Twin Humanities.

Inside this small building downstairs will be two Snow Rats and a corpse with a Soul of a Brave Warrior. Return to the top of the stairs and exit the building.

To the right will be some Engorged Hollows and a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight. Walk across to the next building ahead.

Once inside the building, dispose of any enemies that give you grief. On the balcony to the left you can cut down a corpse that will drop to a lower area.

On the upper level of this building you can jump across the broken floor for a corpse with a Soul of a Brave Warrior and Egg Vermifuge.

The nearby ladder leads to a lower area with two Snow Rats and a Painting Guardian Set.

Head out of this building, looking to the left for a corpse with a Large Soul of a Proud Knight. Enter the nearby round structure and head upwards on the stairs.

Beware of Harpies inside and at the very top of the stairs is a corpse with a Red Sign Soapstone. This allows invasions into other player's worlds.

Using Fall Control, drop to a lower corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior, then safely make your way to the bottom.

Walk up the stairs and outside. In this distance you will see some corpses and items. Approach them and run back to the stairs.

An Undead Dragon will approach, so retreat and kill it from a distance with your Black Bow of Pharis+10.

Once dead, loot it and all the items on the bridge for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight, Dragon Scale and Bloodshield (18/48).

Return into the large circular structure and enter the fog gate to the courtyard mentioned earlier.

As you enter, there will be a large group of Phalanx surrounding a statue. Not sure what game has similar looking enemies, but it seems familiar. Kill them by two-handing Quelaag's Furysword+5 and slashing them quickly.

Open the door directly ahead to create a shortcut between here and the bonfire. You may rest if you need to, but the Phalanx will come back.

To the right is a large area with impaled corpses and a few Hollows. Entering this area will cause Dark Spirit King Jeremiah to spawn in so be careful.

There are items to loot in this area, including 2 Souls of a Proud Knight and a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Behind a wall to the right is a corpse with Pyromancy: Acid Surge (15/19).

Dark Spirit King Jeremiah mainly uses a wide list of Pyromancies, so try to keep your distance. He will use Firestorm you get close.

It's best to use Great Heavy Soul Arrow, Homing Soul Mass and Soul Spear to get his health low. He does dodge quite frequently as well.

Be careful of his whip as it inflicts Bleed damage. Once he is dead, loot where he died for a Notched Whip.

In the courtyard near the Phalanx will be the corpse you cut down with a Humanity. Nearby some stairs that lead to a Ring of Sacrifice and a well heading down. Ignore this well.

Walk towards the doors you opened and to the right of them is some stairs leading upwards. Walk to the top and directly ahead to a ladder.

Down in this next area are enemies called Bonewheels. They are basically skeletons on wheels, that can deal serious damage. As there are numerous of them down here, they can kill you very easily.

Once at the bottom, slowly move right and get the attention of the Bonewheels one at a time. Shield up, wait for them to stop and kill them. Repeat until all in the area are dead.

Once they are all dead, loot the corpses in this area for a Soul of a Brave Warrior and a Soul of a Brave Knight.

Turn the mechanism handle here to open up some doors which lead to the boss of this area. Before you continue, there are some hidden corridors to explore, with more Bonewheels.

There is an illusionary wall close to you, so slash and enter. At the intersection, attack the right wall to reveal another corridor, which you should enter.

This leads to a Bonewheel and a corpse with an Annex Key. Return to the previous intersection, then go right.

Follow the corridor around and at the next intersection, go right for another Bonewheel. Kill it and walk up the stairs to find a lone Engorged Hollow.

Kill this enemy from a distance and it will drop Pyromancy: Fire Surge (16/19). Return to the top of the ladder you climbed down previously.

As you exit this area up the stairs, to the right is a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight. Beware as there will be an ambush by Hollows. Cut down a nearby corpse and return to the bonfire.

The corpse you cut down has a Humanity.

Enter the courtyard and to the right of the Phalanx is a small chapel and a locked door. Open it with the Annex Key and walk up the stairs inside.

Ahead is an Engorged Hollow, with another two just past it in a courtyard below. Kill them all and approach the corpse.

Loot it for a Dark Ember (4/10), but be careful of the Harpies that will fly down an attack you.

Return to where you entered this area and look to see some wooden planks blocking a path. Destroy them and walk to the end of the path for Velka's Rapier (19/48).

Back out of this area and walk past the door you entered the area with.

Kill the Engorged Hollow and climb to the top of the stairs. At the top of this structure is Miracle: Vow of Silence (10/23).

This area is going to be your farming spot for Souvenirs of Reprisal. You must have 10 before you move on as you will not be returning here.

Equip your Covetous Gold Serpent Ring, use a Homeward Bone and return here. Repeat until you have 10.

There is a giant hole in this tower and some stairs leading away from the farming area. To the left you will find a corpse with Velka's Set.

Drop down and turn around to find a corpse with the Soul of a Brave Warrior. Use a Homeward Bone to safely return to the bonfire in preparation for the upcoming boss fight.

Levelling Up

At this point in the walkthrough you will need to level up once again using the Soul Duplication Glitch. In your inventory, the major soul items that are going to be used are 1 Soul of a Hero, 5 Souls of a Brave Warrior, 4 Large Souls of a Proud Knight and 6 Souls of a Proud Knight. If you have more soul items, DO NOT spend them.

Once you have levelled up, attune the following spell: Remove Fall Control and Combustion, then attune Vow of Silence.

Equip the Talisman in lieu of the Sorcerer's Catalyst, as the upcoming battle will be melee only for 99% of the fight.

Enter the courtyard and run past the Phalanx and outside the other end of the circular structure.

Ahead are some Hollows that are waiting to ambush you, so move forward and kill as you go. Kill the Tower Knight ahead and approach the fog gate. Please read below for the strategy on how to defeat Crossbreed Priscilla.

Missable Item

The upcoming boss Crossbreed Priscilla has a special weapon you require, which is called Priscilla's Dagger. This weapon is acquired by cutting her tail off, but after the first strike she turns invisible. It is recommended you use the Cloud Save or a USB Device to back your save up and retry if you miss the opportunity, as at your current level it is very easy to kill her before cutting the tail off.

Ensure you have the Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring equipped when beginning the fight. Enter the fog gate and approach Crossbreed Priscilla. She will be non-hostile, which gives you an opening to remove her tail. Cast Great Combustion on her tail to remove it instantly.

She will turn invisible once you do this and become hostile. Retreat up the nearby stairs and cast Vow of Silence. This will prevent spells, but it will put a massive target on where you can find her, with the rune on her body.

Watch where she walks, as in watch the rune come towards you. Get behind it and slash away. After a few attacks she will become visible again, leaving you to target her and attack her from behind.

Crossbreed Priscilla has massive sweeping slash attacks that cause massive Bleed damage and heal her in the process. As long as you stay behind her with your shield up, you will have minimal trouble finishing this fight off.

Hopefully you acquired Priscilla's Dagger (20/48). You will acquire the Soul of Priscilla and a Twin Humanities for defeating her.
