You will also unlock a trophy, Defeat Crossbreed Priscilla. Loot the corpse at the top for the Xanthous Set, then walk out to the end of the path to warp back to Anor Londo.

Before moving onto the next part of the walkthrough, ensure you have found or purchased the following Sorceries, Pyromancies, Miracles and Unique Weapons. If you haven't, please retrace your steps to find out what you have missed and acquire them before moving on.

Greatsword of Artorias Crafted at the Giant Blacksmith. Quelaag's Furysword Crafted at the Giant Blacksmith.

Black Iron Greatshield Found in Anor Londo. Velka's Rapier Found in the Painted World of Ariamis.

Priscilla's Dagger Cut the tail off Crossbreed Priscilla. Dragon Greatsword Cut the tail off the Everlasting Dragon.

Bloodshield Found in the Painted World of Ariamis. Great Magic Barrier Found in Ash Lake.

Vow of Silence Emit Force Speak to Siegmeyer of Catarina in Found in the Painted World of Ariamis.

Firelink Shrine.

Soul Spear Homing Soul Mass Purchased from Big Hat Logan.

Great Magic Weapon Acid Surge Found in Anor Londo. Found in the Painted World of Ariamis.

Fire Surge Found in the Painted World of Ariamis.

h: Part 6: The Four Kings, Inheritors Of Souls
t:
For this part of the walkthrough you will be fighting your first Soul Lord required to gain access to the final part of the game. Four Soul Lords in total will be required, with the Four Kings being one of them. There aren't too many items to miss in this section; however, there will be a Sorcery and a Unique Weapon to collect.

Once you have returned to Anor Londo, leave the cathedral and ignore any Painting Guardians. Head to the Anor Londo or Darkmoon Tomb bonfire and warp to Firelink Shrine.

The next task ahead is heading into New Londo Ruins and defeating the Soul Lords, the Four Kings. Prior to this, there is some equipment you may upgrade at the bonfire.

Weapon & Armor Upgrades

The following items should be upgraded to tackle some upcoming enemies and the next boss. The upcoming boss has very dangerous magic attacks that are stronger than anything you have faced so far. To counter this, upgrade the following:

Havel's Greatshield to Havel's Greatshield+5 Black Iron Set to Black Iron Set+5 The Black Iron Set+5 will be used for the remainder of the game, with the Crown of Dusk.

Replace the Tower Kite Shield+5 with Havel's Greatshield+5, then equip the Black Iron Set+5, excluding the head piece. Head down into New Londo Ruins.

Remember, you must use a Transient Curse to attack and defend against the Ghosts. Head towards ruins and at the stairs, look to the right for a corpse in a jar. Hit it for another 2 Transient Curses you can use.

As you ascend the stairs, two Ghosts appear nearby. Enter the building ahead, but beware to the right. As you enter the first room, you will be ambushed by 5 Ghosts.

Exit down the stairs to the next open area.

The corpse ahead has a Parrying Dagger, but a Ghost is waiting inside the wall directly to the side of it.

Ahead is the fog gate you will need to enter. If you follow the path around you will find a Banshee, an enemy that shoot Lightning. They also have the ability to bypass your shield, so be careful.

h: Part 6: The Four Kings, Inheritors Of Souls
t:
The corpse has 2 Transient Curses.

Enter the fog gate and proceed forward. Directly ahead is a corpse with a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier, but you will be attacked from above as you head towards it.

Kick the ladder down and kill the two Ghosts at the bottom.

Continue along the upper path and down the stairs towards the large building. As you approach the doorway on the right you will be ambushed by five Ghosts, three from the water and two from the building.

Retreat back up the stairs to fight them safely.

Enter the building and head into the first room to the left, past the large jars. There will be a Banshee waiting in this room.

Kill it and then five more Ghosts will appears from the walls, floor and ceiling. Once dead, continue into the fireplace and climb up.

Be careful as some Ghosts may attack you.

On the roof of this building is a NPC you must speak to and purchase a Sorcery. Ingward will notice you have the Lordvessel and deem you worthy of continuing on into the Abyss.

He will grant you the Key to the Seal, then speaking to him again will allow you to purchase:

Enough Transient Curses for 99 units Resist Curse (19/24) for 5000 Souls

Climb down the ladder and exit the room. Follow the hallway to the left around for a Soul of a Proud Knight, but beware of hidden Ghosts nearby.

Drop down the break in the wall and turn around. Following this hallway to the end will lead to a corpse with a Cursebite Ring.

Exit the large building and continue on outside. There are two corpses along the way, one with a Green Titanite Shard, one with a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

If you take the stairs up to the right you can find a corpse with a Humanity, and one on the roof of the large building with a Rare Ring of Sacrifice.

Enter the nearby tower with the inoperative lift, open the door with the Key to the Seal, then push the lever on the mechanism to drain all the water from the area.

h: Part 6: The Four Kings, Inheritors Of Souls
t:
If you are interested, at the top of the stairs next to the lift there is a corpse with a Composite Bow and 16 Large Arrows.

Pull the lever for the lift and take it down to the lower area. In this next area is an enemy called a Darkwraith. They can drop Titanite Chunks & Titanite Slabs, so you can come here to farm for those items if you need to.

Beware of their Dark Hand ability that will take significant health from you (they charge their hand up and grab you).

Kill the first Darkwraith that will attack you, then look to your right to see some Drakes looking away from you. Beyond them is a bonfire you can use and create a respawn point for the upcoming boss.

You can either shoot them safely from a distance with the Black Bow of Pharis+10 with Poison Arrows.

There is ladder to your left that leads to the Red Tearstone Ring. This ring will be used to exploit a DLC boss that will be in the next part of the walkthrough.

The corpse on the bridge has a Brigand Set and another Spider Shield.

Directly ahead is a large structure with a slope of dirt. Walk up the slope and to the left to find an opening leading to a lift.

Take the lift up and head into the tunnel to find a bonfire. This path will continue on into Darkroot Basin, but you need to return to New Londo Ruins.

Kill the respawned Drakes and Darkwraith, then head into the wooden shack at the top of the stairs.

There is a corpse with a Large Soul of a Proud Knight and another Darkwraith as you exit the wooden shack.

Enter the fog gate ahead to enter the next part of New Londo Ruins.

In this next large room is three Darkwraiths and a Mass of Souls. Kill this monster with your Sorceries from a distance and beware of the heads it summons. These heads explode when you get close.

Head right from where you entered and follow the upwards pathing.. There will be a corpse a Humanity and one with a Soul of a Brave Warrior on the way.

h: Part 6: The Four Kings, Inheritors Of Souls
t:
At the top will be a chest that has a very important Very Large Ember (5/10), which will allow you to upgrade weapons to +15.

Back on the ground level, exit this building back outside, opposite the way you entered. Directly ahead will be another Darkwraith and a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

To the right will be an illusionary wall with a Darkwraith behind it. Loot the chest for a Titanite Chunk.

Ahead is another Large Soul of a Proud Knight, and to the left by a well is 6 Cracked Red Eye Orbs.

Inside the building ahead are some Ghosts, Darkwraiths and another Mass of Souls. Once through, the fog gate to the next boss is directly ahead.

To the right of the fog gate, around a corner is a summon sign for Witch Beatrice, which you can summon shortly.

Equip the Covenant of Artorias ring, then please read the strategy for the upcoming bosses, the Four Kings.

For this fight you can equip Havel's Set for more Magic Defense, but it's completely up to you. For the majority of the battle you will be hiding behind the shield taking minimal chip damage from the boss' attacks. As all attacks from the Four Kings are magic based, eliminating damage is going to be impossible.

Summon Witch Beatrice and wait for her to appear. Once you enter the fog gate, walk down the stairs to the bottom and wait for her. If you jump too early, she will take fall damage for some reason. Once you reach the bottom with her, walk off into The Abyss.

Once you land, cast Homing Soulmass and begin rotating the camera. Once you locate the boss, run immediately to it as it will cast a homing disc of magic.

Once you are close, have your shield up to tank all of the attacks and cast Soul Spear to begin with. Hopefully Witch Beatrice will also be on the offensive and you will kill the first king before the next arrives. If it doesn't, you can split off with one while your summon takes the other on.

h: Part 6: The Four Kings, Inheritors Of Souls
t:
Slowly get the health down on the Four Kings, rotating the camera when you kill one to locate the next one quickly, casting another Homing Soulmass while you wait. Continue casting your Sorceries until they are all dead.

An alternative to Sorceries are Pyromancies, but you need to get close and doing so will normally lead to a large AOE magic blast attack. Being at distance puts you at an advantage as you are out of range of their more powerful attacks.

Their attacks vary, but can be summarized as the following: Homing magic disc that will follow you until it hits you. If this occurs, just tank the attack with your shield for minimal chip damage. The Four Kings will normally do this when you are too far away from them. Alternatively, they can do the same attack, but the disc splits off into 6 smaller ones.

They can perform a general side to side slash that deals minimal chip damage with your shield up. You can roll through these, but it's simpler to just tank the attack.

The Four Kings can perform an overhead slash or thrusting attack with their sword. You can roll to either side or just jog to the side to avoid this one. Additionally, you can just tank it with your shield.

They can do a charge up, then try to grab you. This attack can deal large damage, but if you get grabbed you can spam L2 + R2 to avoid the big hit of damage.

The final attack normally occurs when you stick close to them in melee range. They will charge up and do a large AOE explosion, dealing close to a quarter of your health at this level. On NG+ and onwards, this increases to over half of your health and more.

Run away or tank the damage with the shield.

Once the battle is over you will acquire the Bequeathed Lord Soul Shard and 1 Humanity. You will also acquire Defeat the Four Kings.

Approach the large snake creature in the distance, Darkstalker Kaathe. Speak to him and select YES when the option is given. He will take you to the Firelink Altar.

h: Part 6: The Four Kings, Inheritors Of Souls
t:
Approach the altar ahead and place the Lordvessel. Doing so will open up some new areas you will need to explore and defeat the remaining Soul Lords.

At any point you can return to the altar and deposit the souls of these lords. At this point you can offer the Bequeathed Lord Soul Shard to the altar.

Speak to Kaathe to return to the Abyss.

Talk to Kaathe again and enter the Darkwraith covenant. Doing so will reward you with the Dark Hand (21/48). You will also acquire Covenant: Darkwraith.

If you are interested, you may offer 30 Humanity for a Darksword, Red Eye Orb and Darkwraith Set. This is completely optional, but if you want to dress up as them, you can do that.

Warp to the Anor Londo bonfire when you are ready to continue.

Prior to moving onto the next part of the walkthrough, ensure you acquired the one Sorcery and Unique Weapon from this short section. You will not be returning to The Abyss or the main portion of New Londo Ruins for the remainder of the playthrough. You will return to the first section near Firelink Shrine to visit a blacksmith that has not been mentioned just yet.

Remedy Dark Hand Acquired by joining the Purchased from Ingward. Darkwraith covenant.

This portion of the guide is completely optional. The purpose of completing the Artorias of the Abyss DLC is to acquire some very powerful Sorceries to make NG+ and NG++ much easier to breeze through. You will also acquire another Titanite Slab, a White Titanite Slab and Blue Titanite Slab. This will reduce the rigmarole of searching for them in the main game in NG+.

Leave the bonfire area and head to the left towards the area with Sentinels. Walk out the doorway on the right and either kill or roll past the third Sentinel.

Ahead is the Duke's Archives. This area has a Soul Lord that you need to fight in the future. For now you will be acquiring an item and heading to Darkroot Basin.

Ahead will be two Fang Boars you need to kill to get past. Keep your shield up and kill them with Sorceries. It will penetrate their armor.

Rest at the bonfire here, kindle and repair any equipment that may be damaged.

Pull the lever ahead to ascend on the lift. At the top will some Crystal Hollows who can pack quite the punch. They are particularly weak to Quelaag's Furysword+5, so try to backstab where possible.

Don't head into the library, kill the Crystal Golem at the top of the small stairs for a Broken Pendant.

Head back to the bonfire and warp to Firelink Shrine

Speak to Griggs of Vinheim until he lets you purchase again. Purchase the following items from him:

Soul Spear for 40000 Souls Homing Soul Mass for 20000 Souls Attune those two spells as well as:

Fall Control Power Within Warp to the Undead Parish bonfire, enter Darkroot Garden and into the Darkroot Basin.

Return to the area where you rescued Dusk of Oolacile from the Golden Crystal Golem. There will be a dark portal ahead, which you should examine to be taken to Sanctuary Garden. This officially begins the DLC Artorias of the Abyss.

Rest at the nearby bonfire and kindle the flame. In this DLC, all enemies are considered 'late game' and will deal significantly more damage than you are used to. Because of this, it is recommended you use Sorceries from a distance to deal with enemies.

There is an upcoming boss, Sanctuary Guardian, so please read the strategy below before fighting it.

This boss is quite aggressive, but you will be able to beat it with your powerful Sorceries.

Keep your shield up to tank it's attacks or roll if it uses ranged Lightning attacks. It has varying attacks that range from Physical to Lightning Based damage. When you have an open window in between it's attacks, use Soul Spear to deal the most amount of damage.

The following moves are what are available to the Sanctuary Guardian, with all of them being able to be tanked with your shield.

It will use a melee attack that has three to four consecutive blows. There will be a brief period once it completes the attack where it gains it's stamina back, giving you a good window.

It may have used the ranged Lightning attack when you entered the area. You can roll to either side or run to avoid the 5 orbs that head your way.

It has a ground and flying variant of a Lightning attack that you can tank with your shield. The ground based attack is hard to roll away to avoid damage.

If you stand behind the Sanctuary Guardian it will attack with its tail. This will inflict a large amount of Poison build up to your character. If you cut the tail off, it will replace this with a rearwards kick.

The Sanctuary Guardian has two variants of a charging head strike, both from the ground and air. You can tank this with the shield, but there will be an animation of your character being rolled over. This causes no damage.

If the tail is still intact, it can whip you with it while it is flying. Tank this attack with your shield for low Poison build up.

The final attack is a ground slam that will deal large amounts of Stamina based damage and can stagger you. Keep your shield up to take no damage, but you may need to lower the shield afterwards to regain stamina quickly.

Once you are successful, it will drop the Guardian Soul and a Humanity. Head through the doorway nearby with stairs to enter the next area, Oolacile Sanctuary.

Rest at the bonfire as you enter the next area. Kindle it and repair any damaged equipment.

Nearby is a large mushroom, Elizabeth, who you can speak to. Select YES when the option is given.

You can now purchase some items which are quite useful. Purchase the following: 99 Repair Powder for 29700 Souls The Repair Powder allows repairing of equipment away from the bonfire, which could be potentially useful to you during NG+ and onwards.

Continue down the path ahead into the next area. In this next area there will be some enemies who like to ambush and team up on you. Additionally there are pitfalls everywhere that lead to death.

Take this area slow and take enemies on in lower numbers. Walk across the bridge to enter the Royal Wood.

You will be attacked by some Treant Gardeners, which have varying attacks, but can be killed with Great Soul Arrow in one shot.

There will also be Stone Guardians in this forest, but they can run unlike their Darkroot Garden counterparts. Keep your shield up and hit when you are able.

If you follow the right wall along the forest edge you will locate a dilapidated stone building. This is a shortcut to a lower area you will discover later.

At the top of the stairs is a corpse with Guardian Gauntlets.

In the centre of this forest section is a congregation of enemies around a small pool of water. Kill them all and look amongst the plants.

Loot the chest here for a Blue Titanite Slab. This item is very important and will be used to upgrade weapons to Crystal or Magic, for two trophies. You need two of these, one more being found later in the playthrough.

On the left side of the forest are some more enemies and the path into the next area. The corpse in the flowery area has Guardian Leggings.

Approach the bridge ahead, but stop as a black dragon will attack. This dragon, Kalameet is quite dangerous, but is an optional fight for this DLC.

Cross when it flies away.

Ahead are some giant pitfalls that were previously mentioned. Beware as some are quite difficult to see.

Drop down and head to the left to begin with, jumping across a tear in the ground to get to the left side.

After you cross the gap, head left again and you can find two corpses with a Guardian Armor and 8 Gough's Great Arrow.

To the right of the gap you crossed is a corpse up on a hill. You will need to run and jump across a gap to reach it. This is optional, but the item is a Guardian Helm, completing the set.

As you drop down, to the left is a narrow pathway that leads to a corpse with an Elizabeth Mushroom, a very useful healing item.

Head back across the gap and ahead will be a path leading straight ahead. To the right of this path is a corpse with a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Ahead will be a tower that leads to the next area. Behind it is a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight.

To the left as you look at the tower is a corpse with a Gold Coin, then continuing up a hill to the left of the corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Enter the tower, taking the lift down.

Ahead is the fog gate to a very tough boss, but before entering you should walk to the right and speak to the NPC Marvelous Chester.

Select YES when the option is given and you may also purchase items from him if you wish. It may be a good idea to purchase some Black Firebombs for a future boss exploit.

It's almost as if this NPC belongs in another FromSoftware game...

Head right and head up the lift in the tower to link the shortcut. It may be worth using a Homeward Bone to replenish any spells before the boss fight.

Return to the fog gate once you are ready, then read the following strategy below for Knight Artorias.

Knight Artorias hits very hard and at a certain phase of the fight, can almost kill you instantly with a certain attack. Your Havel's Greatshield+5 will tank all of his attacks very easily.

Before the fight, consume a Green Blossom to increase Stamina Recovery whilst tanking the hits. If you don't have one, you should be able to still tank hits, but put the shield down when you have an opening to recover the Stamina.

With your shield up, wait for Knight Artorias to either do his attack where he jumps in the air and strikes from above, or when he pulls the sword back and does a thrust attack. Each time this occurs, you can use Soul Spear.

When he rolls back twice away from you, he is buffing with Abyss power, so quickly use Soul Spear twice to interrupt this. Only attack twice as he can attack you whilst you are casting.

Repeat this process until he dies, using Great Heavy Soul Arrow when you run out of casts. Beware of the following attacks during your fight with him:

Excluding the above two mentioned moves, he can do an overhead somersault swing which normally repeats a couple of times. Keep your shield up and he will run out of steam before you run out of stamina.

He has very fast slashes that occur in a 2 to 3 hit combo. Again, shield up to tank all of the hits.

If you stand behind him for too long he will throw Abyss sludge at you. Quite disrespectful, but it can be tanked with the shield.

Once his health gets very low, he will retreat away from you using the double roll and will unleash a large explosion and buff him even more than the first time he does it.

Beware as he will do this frequently and the buff will stack. If he hits you whilst buffed multiple times it will instant kill you.

Once successful, you will acquire the Soul of Artorias. Leave the boss area and quit the game.

Reload and enter the boss area to find a woman named Lord's Blade Ciaran. Speak to her and when she asks for the souls, give it to her to receive the Dark Silver Tracer and Gold Tracer, two very strong weapons for Dexterity builds.

Replace Quelaag's Furysword+5 for the Gold Tracer.

Ignore the fog gate to the right and the stairs to the left, head forward and rest at the bonfire. Kindle and repair any equipment.

Once you have completed the below upgrades, continue onwards into the Oolacile Township.

Weapon Upgrades

At the bonfire, reinforce the following weapon: Gold Tracer to Gold Tracer+5

In the area ahead there are some Oolacile Residents and Oolacile Sorceresses. Beware of the very dangerous dark magic they use and target the sorceress first where you can.

There is a corpse you can loot straight ahead for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Continue through the township until you see a corpse in a corner of a tower ahead. Around the back of this is a path leading down.

Loot the corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior, then head around the back.

Follow the path around and roll to the next building when you reach a gap. You'll need to enter a large house and head down the stairs. Be very careful fighting the two Oolacile Sorceresses.

Loot the chest at the bottom for a very powerful spell called Dark Orb. If you head up the stairs and outside to the right, you will find a Oolacile Sorceress that can be killed for a I'm Sorry Carving.

Exit the house through the top and a staircase to the right. Roll across to a wooden walkway and loot the corpse for Soul of a Brave Warrior.

From the corpse, turn around and follow the walkway around and you can find a roof you can jump across to. Aim for the stairs that sit behind the sloped roof.

Walk up the stairs heading up to the right and the chest at the top is a Mimic. Attack and kill it for a Very good! Carving, which is very good indeed. Before heading down, snipe the Oolacile Sorceress in the distance before walking along the narrow walkway ahead.

Beware moving through the next large area as there are numerous ambushes from Oolacile Residents and Oolacile Sorceresses. Take it slow and kill them progressively.

The corpse as you enter has some Rubbish... Exactly what you were looking for.

At the bottom of the stairs will be a large group of Oolacile Residents and Oolacile Sorceress on a wooden platform above. At the bottom of the stairs is a doorway to the right, enter it and head upwards.

At the very top of this building is a room with a broken floor and a chest. To access the chest, look to the left wall of the broken floor to see a beam.

Jump across to the beam and walk to the chest, opening it for a Red Titanite Chunk.

In the previous room is an area you need to roll to, with the laughing Oolacile Resident. Kill it and then attack the chest for another Mimic.

It will drop a Crest Key, which is useful for accessing a NPC later.

Don't drop down, instead head into the next room and climb down the ladder. Quickly kill the Oolacile Sorceress and cut down the corpse.

Cast Fall Control, drop down and kill any remaining Oolacile Residents and loot the corpse for Dark Fog.

Head outside and look to the left to see a corpse, which you should head inside and loot for a Soul of a Hero.

Return back outside and walk along the rooftops. Ahead will be some Oolacile Residents and Oolacile Sorceresses. Ignore them and turn around for a lift that will create a shortcut back to the bonfire.

Kill the enemies ahead from a distance with your Black Bow of Pharis+10 and wait for the Poison to kill them off.

In the large open area ahead is a Chained Prisoner, who hits like a truck and through your shield. Keep your distance and three casts of Soul Spear should kill it.

Loot it's body for Chain Armor and a Chain Helm. Continue forward and call the lift. Kill the Oolacile Resident and head down.

Rest at the nearby bonfire, kindle and repair your equipment. Attune the following spells: Remove Power Within and attune Cast Light.

The next area is going to be very dark and there will be numerous falls that lead to death. Cast Light will be essential. Continue on ahead into the Chasm of the Abyss.

Follow the path around to the left and you will see a group of Oolacile Residents and a Oolacile Sorceress. Kill them and loot the corpse behind them for Dark Bead, which is one of the sole reasons for coming to the DLC.

Extremely powerful and will be used for the remainder of the walkthrough.

As you venture further down the chasm you will see what looks like Humanities, which are actually hostile Giant Humanities. They don't have an attack, but move into you and deal large damage.

Kill them from a distance if you get close to them, otherwise you can ignore them.

When the path heads down to the right past the Giant Humanities, look to the left for a ledge. Walk on this and it will disappear, dropping you to a lower area.

Follow the Spirit of Alvina until you see a doorway on the left. Head up the lift to create a shortcut to the Royal Wood.

To the left of where the Spirit of Alvina disappeared is an illusionary wall you can break. Inside will be Giant Humanities and an a small Sif cub.

Kill them and Sif will disappear and leave behind a Cleansing Greatshield.

Head out of this secret area and follow the path leading down that is marked by a Prism Stone. At the fork, the path leading up has a Humanity and a Oolacile Sorceress.

The path leading downwards has some more Giant Humanities and a powerful spell, Black Flame, which you should acquire.

Head to the top path and roll off. Ignore the Giant Humanities and look for a slope leading down. If you are interested before heading down, look to the right for a corpse on a lower ledge. It has a Help me! Carving, which may prove useful?

Walk down the slope to continue on when you are ready.

Underneath the stone walkway is a corpse with a Twin Humanities. As you enter the tunnel and walk on the path leading to a fog gate, look to the right for a smaller tunnel. At the end of it is a corpse with a very important White Titanite Slab.

Return to the main path and head down towards the fog gate. Kill any remaining Giant Humanities and looting the corpse in a corner for a Soul of a Hero.

Look at the fog gate, then at the Abyss below to see some large red glowing eyes, which is Manus, Father of the Abyss.

This boss is quite a handful, but you won't need to fight him for his soul. Read the below exploit strategy.

Equip the Hawk Ring, Black Bow of Pharis+10 and your Standard Arrows. If you purchased Feather Arrows from any of the merchants, use those instead.

Walk close to the ledge where you can see Manus, Father of the Abyss below. Aim in line of where he is standing, using the first-person mode to line the shot up. Once you have done this, return to normal mode and move your L down and shoot.

You may have to re-adjust the height at which you shoot it, but the video shows what you are looking for. Once you have confirmed a hit, continue to spam arrows until he dies.

When he dies you will acquire 10 Humanities and the Soul of Manus. Drop down into his boss room to find Dusk of Oolacile.

Rest at the bonfire, then warp to Oolacile Sanctuary.

Speak to Elizabeth to acquire 3 Elizabeth's Mushrooms for saving Dusk of Oolacile. At the bonfire, attune the following spells:

Remove Cast Light and attune Dark Orb. Remove Fall Control and attune Dark Bead. Equip your Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring and warp to Oolacile Township, through to Royal Wood.

Walk back through the Knight Artorias boss room and to the right. There will be a path leading down which you should follow.

Loot the corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior before doing so.

At the bottom of the path, turn around and you will see a corpse in the distance. As you move closer two Abyss Attack Dogs will attack you.

Kill them and loot the corpse for a Large Soul of a Brave Warrior. Continue on the path following the running water.

Pass through the wooden gate and approach the nearby edge of the cliff. Black Dragon Kalameet will fly by, which is your next boss.

Head down the nearby ladder and when you get to the lower area, immediately run across to the other side to a large rock formation.

Black Dragon Kalameet will attack, then fly away. Use a Homeward Bone to return to Oolacile Township.

Walk towards the Knight Artorias boss room and walk right up the stairs. Unlock the door with the Crest Key and head inside the tower.

Speak to the giant inside, Hawkeye Gough exhausting all dialogue. Leave the conversation, then talk to him again and be sure to select YES and YES during the dialogue.

He will shoot down Kalameet for you.

Kalameet will now be unable to fly, giving you a fair fight with it. Head down the ladder and return to the boss area you were at previously to refight the dragon.

Along the way, loot a corpse past the stairs for a Soul of a Hero. Approach the fog gate and read the below strategy.

Kalameet is quite a tough boss, even with the current walkthrough stats.

Thanks to Hawkeye Gough, Black Dragon Kalameet will no longer fly away when you attempt to fight it. It will not be impaired though, so be very careful fighting it. Similar to all the previous fights, tanking with the shield will be the viable strategy.

As you slide down the ladder and step foot into the lower area, the fight begins. Use a Green Blossom if you have one and cast Homing Soul Mass for a cheap shot when you approach it.

It will most likely begin by shooting a straight beam of energy towards you. This can be avoided by rolling to either side. When you get close, it's time to use Soul Spear when you have an opportunity, then Dark Bead when you run out of casts.

The attacks to look out for will be relentless, but are avoidable and explained below: A brief pause in it's attacks will usually mean it will charge directly at you. Have your shield up to not take any damage, but the animation of rolling over will occur. This doesn't mean you take damage. When its health gets lower, it will do this attack, but immediately turn around and spray energy in a circular pattern.

Kalameet will do a swiping attack, usually two in quick succession. You can guard with the shield to avoid damage.

It may get up on its back legs, but there are two attacks that normally occur when this happens. The first is one where it sprays energy directly down on the ground in front of it, in a S shaped pattern. When it gets on its back legs, its arms will be close to the body.

The second variant of this attack is telegraphed by its arms being wide open. It will suck you in with a telekinetic attack and you will begin floating. This will de-buff you and you will begin taking double damage. Roll away immediately backwards from Kalameet.

If you stand underneath it for too long, it will begin stamping violently to get you away from it. Simply stay away from its legs and shoot Soul Spear only when the right window appears.

Kalameet will fly up in the air and do two attacks. The first one will be a charging attack where it flies down and charges through you. This will bowl you over, but if you have the shield up it won't do anything.

The second is a large AOE flame attack and it will breathe it directly below itself. Run away from it when you see it fly directly up, or tank with the shield.

It may also do a circular fire breath attack. Run to the left as you look at it and run towards the neck. You will be able to get a cast or two off while it does this attack.

If you stand behind it for too long, it will swipe with the tail, or it can just plainly swipe you with it for a normal attack. The shield will once again protect you from all damage.

Once the mighty dragon is dead, it will drop a Calamity Ring. This ring is mainly for challenge runs and the such, it doubles incoming damage so you won't have any need for it.

There is a waterfall nearby with a chest behind it. Loot this for a Titanite Slab. Loot all the remaining items in the area for 2 Souls of a Brave Warrior, Soul of a Hero and some of Gough's Great Arrows.

Return to Hawkeye Gough and talk to him one final time. He will grant you the Gough's Greatbow for killing Kalameet. You may purchase Gough's Great Arrows and using this bow if you wish in lieu of the Black Bow of Pharis+10, but that is up to you.

Leave the tower and head to the nearest bonfire. Before leaving the DLC, read below for some levelling information. Warp to Firelink Shrine once completed.

Levelling Up

During the DLC you should have acquired all of the high tier souls items that will increase your level quite high. As you have hit the cap for most of your stats, the focus will be on your Health and Equip Load for the most part. Using 4 Souls of a Hero, 1 Large Soul of a Brave Warrior, 7 Souls of a Brave Warrior, 5 Large Souls of a Proud Knight and 2 Souls of a Proud Knight, duplicate them one at a time using the Soul Duplication Glitch. DO NOT use any other soul items not listed.

Head to the lift that leads to Undead Parish and jump off onto the roof as it begins. Make your way to the giant nest again and Curl up like a ball to be taken to Northern Undead Asylum.

Kill the Hollows and walk to Snuggly the Crow. Drop the Soul of Manus in his nest, then quit and reload. You can now pick up the spell Pursuers.

Return to Firelink Shrine to move on with the remainder of the playthrough, with Seath the Scaleless up next.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
This section of the walkthrough will conclude your Sorcery hunting endeavor and Big Hat Logan's questline. There will be two Miracles to find in this section, and some other very important items of interest. This section will also guide you to defeating the second Soul Lord Seath the Scaleless.

Warp to the Undead Parish and speak to Andre. He will mention the Very Large Ember you have in your possession, which you should give with YES.

While you are here you can upgrade any weapon to +15 at this point in time. You will also unlock two trophies from the below upgrades recommended.

The Lightning Spear weapon can also be upgraded; however, you may not have enough Titanite Chunks.

Weapon Upgrades

Upgrade the following weapons with Andre. At the end of this process, replenish any used Titanite Shards with Andre and warp to Anor Londo to replenish your Large Titanite Shards with the Giant Blacksmith.

Black Bow of Pharis+10 to Black Bow of Shortsword+5 to Raw Shortsword to Pharis+15 Raw Shortsword+5 Upgrading these two weapons to the levels mentioned will unlock Strongest Weapon and Raw Weapon trophies. The remainder of upgrade weapon trophies will be unlocked close to the end of the first playthrough (if you acquired the slabs from AotA DLC).

Before leaving Andre, speak to him a second time and give him the Dark Ember when he requests it with YES.

Rest at the bonfire and attune the following spells: Remove Great Heavy Soul Arrow (x2) Attune Pursuers From this point forward, you will want to save your Dark Sorceries for bosses or tough enemies. Their spell count is low, but they are very powerful.

Warp to Anor Londo and return to the bonfire inside of The Duke's Archives. The enemies in here are weak to fire, so you can equip the Quelaag's Furysword+5, or continue using what you have equipped.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
Take the lift up and kill the Crystal Hollows ahead. You need to enter the library, kill the Channeler and into another lift. Before heading up the stairs, underneath you can find a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Before using the lift, there are some items you can collect from the upper levels. One of the chests is a Mimic, which is close to the open balcony with a corpse.

Loot the items in this upper area for a Crystal Knight Shield and two Twinkling Titanite. Use the lift to ascend to the top of the library.

As you enter the narrow hallway ahead you will find a Crystal Knight blocking your way. Quickly kill him with Dark Bead.

Before entering the fog gate at the top, equip the Rare Ring of Sacrifice. You are about to die, which is inevitable, but the ring will stop you from losing anything and being cursed.

Enter the fog gate and stand there while Seath the Scaleless kills you.

You will now be in a prison cell with no way out it seems. Rest at the bonfire and kindle. In front of your cell will be a Man-Serpent that will die in one hit. Loot it to acquire the Archive Tower Cell Key.

Once you open your cell and alarm will sound and the guards will come running, so be prepared.

Immediately kill the two Man-Serpents running away with Soul Spear. Don't allow them to run as they will block a ladder you need to escape with.

If you look to your left you will see Pisacas coming to attack you. They can be killed with Great Soul Arrow.

Kill the group of Pisacas at the end of the stairs and enter the cell area to the right. The two lone Pisacas are tougher than the others, but must be killed.

Loot their bodies for Miracle: Bountiful Sunlight (11/23) and Miracle: Soothing Sunlight (12/23).

In the cell is Big Hat Logan who wants you to rescue him again. You won't be able to do this yet, but exhaust all of his dialogue.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
Head up the nearby ladder once you have finished talking to him.

At the top of the stairs is the alarm device that you must turn off. To the left are two Man-Serpents and a Serpent Mage.

Kill them, turn the alarm off by pulling the lever and loot the chest at the back for the Archive Tower Giant Door Key.

Your goal is to walk up the stairs to the top, climb a ladder and enter the library again. Until you rescue Big Hat Logan, try not to use a bonfire.

Along the way, loot the cells on the left as you ascend for the Archive Prison Extra Key and a Large Soul of a Brave Warrior.

If interested, you can drop down from a wooden platform at the top of a ladder that leads to your cell with a Maiden Set and a White Séance Ring.

In your cell is another door that was actually a shortcut to the alarm device. If you drop down you can find a corpse with a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Open the doors at the top with the Archive Tower Giant Door Key and continue on through. Watch out for Crystal Hollows hiding in corners.

Enter the library to find two Channelers and a rotating stair mechanism. There are two of these, each moving each other, but opposite directions.

Kill the Channeler to your left and continue straight. Kill the Crystal Hollows in the next library portion and interact with the handle on the stair mechanism.

There is a chest if you walk down the stairs that has a Twinkling Titanite. Continue walking up the stairs back into the previous library section.

To get to the next Channeler you will need to drop down onto the stairs. Be careful as it will cast spells at you as you run up. If you fail to kill it, rotate the stairs and it will be at the top on the other side.

On the original side the Channeler was, at the top there is a chest that contains Sorcery: Great Magic Shield (20/24).

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
Turn the stairs so they point towards the level that is opposite where you entered the library.

There will be an archer Crystal Hollow and a ladder leading down. Kill it, then climb/slide down the ladder to the bottom.

Interact with the lever at the bottom.

There is a dark room nearby that contains a chest with a Blue Titanite Chunk. This will be where Big Hat Logan will set up shop once you rescue him shortly.

The next room has a number of chests inside, with one of those being a Mimic. The Mimic is the chest shown in the image on the right and if this is the last one, you will acquire the Symbol of Avarice and an Enchanted Falchion.

The remainder of chests contain the Crystal Ember (6/10), Archive Tower Giant Cell Key and a Channeler's Set.

Return to the cell that Big Hat Logan was in and open the cell door. Speak to him inside and he will be on his way shortly.

Loot the corpse in the cell for a Fire Keeper Soul. Return to the bottom of the stairs near the dark room in the library.

Past the lever at the bottom is the lower section of the library. To the left as you enter is a balcony that has the Duke's Archives bonfire.

Rest here, kindle and repair any equipment. Head back into the dark room to speak to Big Hat Logan.

Missable Items

Big Hat Logan is going to be inaccessible once you defeat the upcoming boss Seath the Scaleless. Due to these story events, he will no longer sell anything to you and become hostile.

Now is your only chance to purchase the below items for this playthrough. If you fail to do so, you will need to complete his questline in NG+.

Speak to Big Hat Logan and purchase the following: Crystal Soul Spear (21/24) for 50000 Souls Crystal Magic Weapon (22/24) for 20000 Souls Homing Crystal Soulmass (23/24) for 30000 Souls

Attune the following spells at the bonfire: Remove one Soul Spear and attune Crystal Soul Spear Remove one Homing Soulmass and attune Homing Crystal Soulmass Return to the room with the chests and interact with the lever to lower a staircase. Underneath is a Crystal Hollow and a chest with 20 Prism Stones.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
If you didn't purchase these earlier, they are very important and needed for an upcoming item.

Enter the next area through the fog gate and climb down the ladder, ensuring you have Quelaag's Furysword+5 equipped.

This area is filled with Crystal Golems and in particular, a Golden Crystal Golem. Try and thin out the regular ones before fighting the gold one.

There are some items in this area, including a Blue Titanite Chunk and the Crystalline Set.

Important NPC

Beware of attacking after you have killed the Golden Crystal Golem, as a trapped NPC will appear and must not be harmed. Doing so will lock you out of another Titanite Slab for this playthrough.

Once the Golden Crystal Golem is dead, a NPC will appear, Sieglinde of Catarina. Speak to her to exhaust her dialogue, and when she asks if you have seen her father, you must select YES. She will leave once you continue onwards.

Your path ahead delves deep into a cavern that has invisible walkways and every fall should be considered deadly.

Walk to the edge of the forest and you will see the Crystal Cave past two Crystal Golems.

Past the Crystal Golem is the first of many invisible pathways in the cave. You can identify them as crystal flakes will pop as they hit the ground.

To the left is one you can walk through and loot a corpse for a Humanity. Ignore the Moonlight Butterflies in this area as much as possible.

Continuing on is an invisible walkway, identified with a message on the ground. Before walking forward you will be able to see a Golden Crystal Golem ahead to the left.

Using a bow, or great bow, shoot it to lure it over to this larger area. The crystal it stands on is very narrow and a nightmare to fight on.

Kill it, then walk across the invisible walkway. Use the crystal flakes as a guide.

There is another message ahead once you reach the area behind the Golden Crystal Golem's original location. This marks the next invisible walkway.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
Drop down, then immediately turn around to find a cave with some Crystal Lizards. They have Twinkling Titanites.

In the distance you can barely see a corpse with an item, but the path leading there is invisible, it is also not straight ahead.

Here is where you need to use the Prism Stones to mark your path. Throw one down with when equipped. If it lands in front, there is a walkway. If it falls to the chasm below, there is nothing in front.

Slowly and carefully mark the path to the item.

The path taken looked like the image shown during the walkthrough playthrough.

Loot the corpse at the end of the invisible path for a Blue Titanite Slab. This is the second and final one you require for two weapon upgrades. If you didn't complete the DLC, you will need to return here on NG+.

Carefully return to the cave where the Crystal Lizards were.

There is an item below you when you walk out with a Golden Crystal Golem. Don't even think about dropping down as you will most likely slide off and die.

Carefully walk ahead on the invisible walkway. You may use Prism Stones if you aren't sure of where to walk.

Your path ahead is to the right, but before entering you should check to the left for a corpse with a Soul of a Hero. The Moonlight Butterfly might attack you, so run into the right area if it does.

Ahead is five Man-Eater-Shells, with a sixth around to the left. Fight them one by one before moving ahead. It is important they don't follow you into the next area.

Once they are dead, please read the below strategy on the next boss, Seath the Scaleless.

Missable Item

Seath the Scaleless has a special weapon you require, which is called the Moonlight Greatsword. This sword is acquired by cutting his tail off. This is very difficult to do as Seath won't let you near it during regular battle. He will spin to reposition himself, or slam his tail violently to prevent you from cutting it. The method to doing so will be explained shortly. It is recommended you use the Cloud Save or a USB Device to back your save up and retry if you miss the opportunity.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
Once you walk into the large area ahead there will be a cutscene where Seath flies down to attack you. When it is over, run towards the Primordial Crystal and wait for him to get close.

When you see him raise his head to use his breath attack, hit the crystal and run immediately behind him.

You can either use Dark Bead or Quelaag's Furysword+5 to attack the tail, but you will only have a few seconds before he turns around or starts slamming the tail. If you fail, reload your save to retry.

It should be noted you need to target the chunkier of his three tails. There are two shorter and thinner ones to his side, but the one that needs to be cut is the thicker one.

The video shows the Guide Author attacking the correct one. Seath ain't got scales, and he hasn't got any legs either, which means he is very vulnerable and very slow. Your magic is much stronger than his, so begin using Dark Bead. Once you run out, swap to Pursuers and cast once before swapping to Crystal Soul Spear. After a few casts he will be dead.

Watch out for his attacks as they are wide spreading and can inflict curse if you are not careful. Look out for the following:

He used his crystal breath to kill you earlier, and he will use it again in here. You can run behind him if you see him raise his head and direct the crystal beam in a circular motion in front of him. This has two variants, one which causes massive damage, or one that causes curse damage.

If you stand in front of Seath he will swing wildly directly in front of him. He is very weak so you can either guard with the shield or just roll out of the way and continue with your spells.

If you see Seath curl up, you will need to run as far away from him as possible. This will cause a massive magical explosion, which is then followed up with a crystal blast. This has the potential to kill you, so get away from him.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
As mentioned, he will slam his tail if you are to the sides or behind him at any point. Just stay away and cast from a distance.

Cutting Seath the Scaleless' tail off will reward you with the Moonlight Greatsword (22/48) and defeating him will reward you with the Bequeathed Lord Soul Shard and a Humanity.

You will also acquire Defeat Seath the Scaleless. Rest at the bonfire and warp back to The Duke's Archives.

Return to Big Hat Logan and speak to him. Due to reading some questionable books on magic and other dirty deeds, he has gone completely mad.

Return to the bonfire, quit and reload the game. He has now left this section of the library and is located where Seath the Scaleless was in the first encounter.

You can get back to the lift by going into the library section near the bonfire, up the stairs and to the left. At the top of these stairs, head right into the next library section and look immediately right for the lever.

You will find Big Hat Logan at the top, with only his hat and remaining dignity left. Kill him in one shot with Dark Bead; Sorry Logan.

Loot his corpse for Sorcery: White Dragon Breath (24/24), the Big Hat and Tin Crystallization Catalyst. You will also earn Wisdom of a Sage.

The chest ahead contains the Large Magic Ember (7/10), which will be useful towards the end of the playthrough.

Climb the stairs in this area to find a corpse with a Soul of a Great Hero, which is very useful.

Use a Homeward Bone to return to the Duke's Archives bonfire.

Return to the dark room where Big Hat Logan was previously to find a chest where he was sitting.

Open it for the Sage's Set and Logan's Catalyst. You may equip this catalyst or the Tin Crystallization Catalyst. The latter has less spell casts, but more damage. The former has more casts, but more power than your current catalyst.

h: Part 8: Seath The Scaleless, Inheritor Of Souls
t:
The Guide Author recommends more casts, but it's solely your choice. Warp to Firelink Shrine once you are done.

Prior to moving onto the next part of the walkthrough, check off the below Sorceries, Miracles and Unique Weapon from this section. You will return to The Duke's Archives near the conclusion of this playthrough to farm another Unique Weapon, but it will be explained later. If you haven't acquired the items as they were specified, you will need to do so in NG+.

Crystal Magic Weapon Purchased from Big Hat Logan. Strong Magic Shield Found in a chest inside The Duke's Archives.

Crystal Soul Spear Purchased from Big Hat Logan. Homing Crystal Soulmass Purchased from Big Hat Logan.

Bountiful Sunlight Killed the Pisaca next to the large cell. White Dragon Breath Killed Big Hat Logan at the top of the library.

Soothing Sunlight Moonlight Greatsword Killed the other Pisaca next to the large cell Cut the tail off Seath the Scaleless.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
For this section of the walkthrough you will acquire another Lord's Soul by defeating the Bed of Chaos. You will also conclude Siegmeyer of Catarina's questline and find the remaining Pyromancies that are left for this playthrough.

Approach Sieglinde of Catarina and speak to her. When she asks if you have seen her father once again, you must say YES for her to continue her search.

Speak to Anastacia of Astora and reinforce your Estus Flask+3 to Estus Flask+4. Warp to Daughter of Chaos once you have completed these two tasks.

Speak to the Daughter of Chaos and enter the Chaos Servant covenant again. Offer 30 Humanity to her and she will give you Pyromancy: Chaos Storm (17/19).

She will also unlock a secret shortcut that you will need to open in this section of the walkthrough.

Leave this area into the Demon Ruins.

At this point due to your current stats, it may be worth swapping to the Moonlight Greatsword and upgrading it as much as possible with Dragon Scales.

Walk down the hill past the Egg Carriers and into the previously lava filled area. Look ahead for numerous Taurus Demons.

Slowly approach them and fight them one by one. They all have the same moveset as the first Taurus Demon you fought during the first section of the walkthrough.

They have a chance to drop the Demon's Greataxe, but they will not respawn once you kill them all.

Ahead is a corpse in a lake of lava. If you try to acquire this you will take serious fire damage. To counter this, equip the Black Iron Helm+5 and Flame Stoneplate Ring. Additionally, use 1 Elizabeth's Mushroom.

Loot the corpse for the Chaos Flame Ember (8/10). There is a corpse nearby you can jump to for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Don't forget to re-equip previous gear once you collect these items.

Ahead is a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight and a Capra Demon. You now have all the room in the world to fight it, so use your Sorceries or melee to kill it quickly.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
Continue following the path into the ruins ahead, being mindful of a Dark Spirit appearing shortly.

As you follow the path around you will see numerous Capra Demons. You will also be invaded by Dark Spirit Knight Kirk.

To the right you will see a lower area and a bonfire. Roll down there and wait for Knight Kirk to reach you. Kill him with Dark Bead, loot him for the Spiked Shield.

Rest at the bonfire, kindle and repair your equipment once you kill the Burrowing Rockworm.

It might be worth duplicating 1 Humanity to get back to 99. Once done, loot the corpse nearby for a Soul of a Proud Knight.

Continuing on you will see the fog gate for another boss in the distance. Loot the corpse to the right of the stairs and the Stone Demon for another Soul of a Proud Knight.

Kill the Stone Demons on the stairway and wait for the Taurus Demon to notice you before moving forward.

Once it is dead, head left and kill the next two on this path to another section of ruins.

In the distance you can see a chest, but as you progress some Burrowing Rockworms will appear from above. It is advised to run straight between the two that spawn as two more appear to ambush you.

Open the chest for the Large Flame Ember (9/10). Instead of wasting spells on this group, use a Homeward Bone, then return to the bottom of the previous stairs.

Kill the previous enemies and walk towards the fog gate. To the right is a Capra Demon and a corpse with the Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Prior to entering the fog gate, take a detour to the right and open the mentioned shortcut from earlier.

Ahead is a large hallway with a vine that leads down to a large door. This is the shortcut you need to open.

Before walking down the nearby vine, jump across to the right and loot the corpse for another Soul of a Brave Warrior.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
Drop down onto the vine and continue towards the door.

Near the door is a group of Chaos Bugs that will jump away from you when you approach. These enemies have a chance to drop Sunlight Medals and can be farmed at a later point.

Touch the door to open it, then kill all of the Chaos Bugs in this area. One of them will drop a Sunlight Maggot helm, which is very important.

Once you have acquired this item, return to the fog gate and read below for the next boss.

Equip the Tin Crystallization Catalyst prior to entering the fog gate. You will out-magic the Demon Firesage very quickly with your spells in this upcoming battle. There will be a bonfire afterwards to replenish your spells, so go ham on it. This battle should take 3 casts of Dark Bead to defeat this boss with no buffs.

Once you enter the fog gate, the Demon Firesage will run straight towards you. Do not block with your shield, just roll through the attack and begin casting Dark Bead.

The Demon Firesage won't like that you are close, so it may back-step. If it does this, get close again and roll to dodge its attacks. Continue casting Dark Bead until it dies.

If for some reason you missed the casts, continue with Crystal Soul Spear or Soul Spear until it dies.

It has the same moveset as the Stray Demon, but is faster. Please read the strategy for dodging its attacks in the Stray Demon boss fight instruction (if it's alive for that long).

The Demon Firesage will drop a Humanity and a Demon's Catalyst that you can pick up from the ground.

Continue on out of this area and rest at the bonfire at the bottom of the stairs leading down. Kindle the flame and repair any equipment.

Before heading anywhere else, warp to Sunlight Altar.

Speak to Solaire of Astora that is standing beside the Sunlight Altar. During the dialogue, it is important that you select YES to continue his questline.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
He will be able to help with an upcoming boss and the final boss of the game. Rejoin the Warrior of Sunlight covenant when he asks (the shortcut is open so this is fine).

Do not offer any Sunlight Medals, so leave and warp to Daughter of Chaos. Once you arrive, walk out of this area and you may notice the blue circle below the bell lever is active.

Stand on this lift to be taken back down to the Demon Ruins. Walk down the stairs (not fall) and loot the corpse behind three Stone Demons for a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Continue down the stairs to the bonfire and rest.

Walk down the vine ahead of the bonfire and you will see Solaire's summon sign on the ground and a fog gate to the next boss.

Please read below on the strategy to defeating the next boss, Centipede Demon.

You won't be summoning Solaire for this fight, but this has no consequence on his questline.

It is much easier if you go in solo as you will be exploiting this boss. Ensure you have Havel's Greatshield+5 equipped before heading in, then use a Green Blossom just before the fog gate. Enter when you are ready to fight the Centipede Demon.

Once you enter and the cutscene ends, run to the left corner as shown in the video. Keep your guard up with the shield for the entirety of this exploit. The Centipede Demon will continually attack you, but you must stay wedged in the corner.

When it gets close to you, it will grab you and try to eat you. When this happens, spam L2 + R2 to avoid all of the incoming damage. If the positioning is right, it will be placed out of the map.

If the positioning wasn't right, it will be in front of you, so reposition into the corner and try again. Once it is done correctly, it will die as it falls into non-playable area outside of the map. If you find it's not dying, run along the left wall to the fog gate out of this area and it will die.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
The Centipede Demon will drop the Orange Charred Ring, Humanity and Homeward Bone. Equip the ring before doing anything else.

Leave through the large open tunnel to continue on.

Through the tunnel you will find Solaire sitting away from the bonfire on the right. Speak to him and he will begin repeating himself.

Rest at the bonfire, kindle and continue on to Lost Izalith. Solaire will leave once you do.

One important note with the Orange Charred Ring is that it doesn't stop equipment damage from the lava. Each time you visit a bonfire, repair everything equipped.

In the area ahead, there are large Bounding Demons that are only aggressive if you get close to them. It's best to ignore them and run past them.

Follow the vine along to the left and prepare to run past all of the Bounding Demons. To the left before you run, loot the corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Your destination is a tower directly ahead, so quickly run there trying to stick to the roots sticking out to the left. The corpse on the way has a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Inside the first tower is a chest that contains a Soul of a Great Hero. Beware of any Stone Demons that aggro when you approach from the lava.

As you leave the tower, you need to walk to the right and run up the root. As you do this, you will aggro a Bounding Demon.

Run up the root to the top of the tower and there will be a corpse with Twin Humanities. Drop down onto safe ground below.

Directly under the corpse is a tower wall that is actually an illusionary wall. Hit it to reveal a bonfire.

This bonfire will be used if you die to the upcoming boss, which may happen. Rest, kindle and repair all of your equipment.

There is no item worth the hassle in this remaining area, so when ready head outside and look straight ahead.

There is a broken archway ahead that has a vine that leads into the next area. The vine to the left of it will get you attacked by a Bounding Demon, so ignore it.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
You may re-equip your Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring once you have escaped the lava.

Progress through the next area, killing the Stone Demons along the pathway. There will be a staircase on the right that you need to head up, but before that, look to the side of it for a corpse with a Large Soul of a Brave Warrior.

At the top of the stairs is a Chaos Eater, which will destroy your equipment with its spray attack. Fight it from a distance, or get behind it.

There is a Daughter of Chaos at the top of the next stairs that you can kill quickly with Sorceries, but be quick as Dark Spirit Knight Kirk will invade shortly after.

Crystal Soul Spear will eliminate both of them before they knew what hit them. Loot the corpses for an Izalith Catalyst and Barbed Straight Sword.

Ignore the fog gate for now, instead continue past it and kill the Chaos Eater ahead. Loot the chest behind it for Pyromancy: Chaos Fire Whip (18/19).

Return to the other side of the stairs and head down the vine with the large group of Stone Demons. Kill them all and you will see two paths.

The one on the right leads back to the shortcut you unlocked earlier, with a respawning Titanite Demon.

Ignore this.

The path on the left leads to a poisonous pit and Siegmeyer of Catarina, who is once again trapped.

Hugging the left wall, the floor will break away and reveal a vine you can walk down. It is important you don't fall down or kill any Chaos Eaters in the swamp.

Important NPC

Before you walk down the vine, it is recommended you make use of the Cloud Save or USB Device to back your save up. In this next situation, Siegmeyer must not get below 50% health when he fights four Chaos Eaters in a swamp, this will fail his questline. You also cannot kill these enemies prior to speaking to him, as this will also fail his questline. There is a solution that will be explained below.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
Prior to speaking to Siegmeyer, cast ONLY ONE Great Soul Arrow one each of the Chaos Eaters.

Alternatively, you can lower their health with the Black Bow of Pharis+15 so they are basically one hit from death.

Equip the Rusted Iron Ring, have Dark Bead ready to cast and then speak to Siegmeyer. He will tell you his plan about killing the Chaos Eaters and allowing you to slip away.

Once he drops down, immediately drop down below and kill the Chaos Eaters with Dark Bead when he starts attacking them.

Speak to him once they are all dead and exhaust all of his dialogue. He will move on to another location once you leave.

Loot the nearby corpses for a Red Titanite Chunk, Soul of a Brave Warrior and a Green Titanite Shard.

There are numerous corridors you can walk down, but the ongoing Poison is going to be a determining factor. Beware of the pitfalls in this swamp as well.

Kill a nearby Chaos Eater and walk past it and the pit. There will be a long dead-end corridor with a chest that has a Red Titanite Slab.

Continue following the path ahead in the swamp and you will find the way out by walking up some stairs.

Beware as you walk up these stairs as there is a Chaos Eater waiting at the top. The nearby corpse has a Red Titanite Chunk.

You may drop down onto the floor below this higher section and navigate through the roots to find the way out.

The way out is the same way you came in. If you get lost, there is another stairway in the swamp that leads to the root that you need to walk on.

Return to the bottom of the stairs that the Daughter of Chaos was located and walk to the right of the root you just walked up.

Follow this path and you can see an item on a corpse down below. Work your way down and loot it for a Soul of a Hero.

Return to the fog gate you passed earlier for the next boss Bed of Chaos. This boss fight is renowned for being poor in design and quite frustrating for players on their first try.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
Read the below strategy on how to beat it with minimal hassle.

Boss Exploit

The below exploit can only be performed during the first encounter with the Bed of Chaos. If you wish to make your life easier with this boss, it is recommended you do the exploit. If so, it may be worth making use of the Cloud Save or USB Device in case you make a mistake and need to retry.

Prior to this fight, you should have either Firebombs or Black Firebombs in your possession.

If you need to purchase some, you can visit the Crestfallen Merchant in Sen's Fortress, or the Marvelous Chester is the Royal Wood.

Equip your Black Bow of Pharis+15 or any other bow, and equip either variant of the firebomb. Enter the fog gate and slide down to the bottom. Once you land, run immediately under the Bed of Chaos to avoid any attacks.

In the video above, there is a position on the ground below the boss that you will need to stand on to make this exploit easier to execute. Look at the floor and you will see some tiles.

One tile for this explanation is considered a square with 4 smaller tiles. Walk 3 tiles forward and stand there.

Look to the left and you can see some roots above as shown in the video. The one on the left you need to aim to is the higher of the thin roots. The Guide Author is shooting to show you which one is correct.

Look to the right and you will see the next root that you need to aim to for this exploit. What needs to happen now is you aim in first person mode with the bow (two hand , then press L1 ), aim at the root, then exit first person mode without moving R . Throw a bomb with to destroy a part of the Bed of Chaos and advance the fight.

Once you destroy the first part, you need to be quick to aim to the second one and throw the next bomb.

After you destroy both parts of the Bed of Chaos, roll immediately forward into the passage ahead and continue to do roll through the roots until you reach the actual boss. During this time, the boss will be casting Firestorm so you must be quick. Hit the boss once and it will die.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
The Bed of Chaos will drop a Lord Soul and a Humanity. You will also acquire Defeat Bed of Chaos for your efforts.

You are finished in Lost Izalith for this playthrough. Prior to concluding this section of the walkthrough there are some cleanup tasks to be done.

Warp to Firelink Shrine to continue Siegmeyer's questline.

Speak to Sieglinde who will thank you for your help and notify you that she has found her father. She will set off to find him, then need to find her again in Ash Lake. More on this shortly.

Warp to Daughter of Chaos and take the lift back down into the Demon Ruins.

Return to the shortcut with the Chaos Bugs and you will find Solaire sitting on the ground down here moping about not finding his sun. Luckily for him you killed a Chaos Bug earlier that would have driven him mad.

Equip the Covetous Gold Serpent Ring and Symbol of Avarice. Beware as your health will continually drop.

Kill all of the Chaos Bugs down here until you have a total of 10 Sunlight Medals. If none drop, walk up the root and use the bonfire before the Centipede Demon, then repeat killing them.

Once you acquire 10 Sunlight Medals, warp to Daughter of Chaos and enter Blighttown.

Return to Quelana of Izalith and speak to her. She will thank you for killing her sister and will reward you with Pyromancy: Fire Tempest (19/19).

This is the final Pyromancy you can acquire for this playthrough, but you may re-purchase or find all of them again in NG+ if you want to try a Pyromancer only playthrough.

You will unlock Bond of a Pyromancer. Use a Homeward Bone, then warp to Stone Dragon.

From the Everlasting Dragon, run all the way to the first bonfire in Ash Lake where you exited from the Great Hollow.

You will find Sieglinde standing over the corpse of Siegmeyer who is now dead. He went Hollow due to your helpful actions throughout the playthrough.

h: Part 9: Soul Lord Bed Of Chaos
t:
Some people just can't be helped it seems. Speak to her and she will give you a Titanite Slab.

This marks the end of the questline, so warp back to Firelink Shrine.

Prior to moving onto the next portion of the walkthrough, check off the following Pyromancies that were found during this section. They all are very straightforward to find if you missed them.

Chaos Storm Reach Rank+1 in the Chaos Servant covenant. Fire Tempest Complete Quelana of Izalith's questline and speak to her.

Chaos Fire Whip Found in Lost Izalith.

In this section of the walkthrough you will acquire the final Lord Soul required to access the final area of the game. You will also acquire quite a handful of Unique Weapons, join the second-last covenant and find some Miracles. If you are a fan of the series, you shall discover a recurring NPC during this section.

From the bonfire, walk towards the giant snake creature and out the archway to the left. It will make a comment on how you are a fool, but we know what we're doing.

There is a graveyard ahead with some Skeletons that will rise as you get closer from piles of bones.

In the coming section of the playthrough there will be more of these Skeletons that can't be killed with normal weapons.

To counter this, equip the Divine Claymore+5 and killing them will make them permanently die.

Additionally, there are Undead Mages that are summoning these skeletons, so kill them too.

There isn't really any notable loot in the graveyard, but if you are interested you can find the following: 2 Large Souls of a Lost Undead Caduceus Round Shield Zweihander Winged Spear Binoculars Walk down the stairs on the far side of the graveyard and enter the tunnel to the Catacombs.

For you own benefit, it may be worthwhile equipping the Sunlight Maggot so you can what you're doing and where you're going.

Kill any Skeletons that you may come across, they won't be mentioned from this point forward unless necessary.

Continue down the path until you find a hole in the wall on the left. Enter this hole.

Inside this hole is a room with an Undead Mage and a large lever. Kill it and interact with the lever to move a path further on.

Rest and kindle at the bonfire, then repair any equipment and continue on your way outside to the left.

Follow the path outside and cross over to the right to find a congregation of bones and an Undead Mage.

Loot any rooms you come across for a Lucerne and a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier. Your path leads outside again.

There is another lever to interact with to the right, but ahead are some explosive Wisps and the statues on the sides of the path will poke you when you get close.

Try to trigger the explosions by moving close and running away. Once all three are gone, continue down the path and interact with the lever.

To the right of the lever is a corpse with a Soul of a Proud Knight. If you peer past the rocks, you can see a very mild-mannered, trusty and unbreakable man ahead. He will most likely push the lever and plunge you to your death, but maybe he wont.

Backtrack and you will see the path has moved and you can cross safely. Head inside the next portion of the area and kill the next Undead Mage.

Ignore the paths inside this next area, instead return back outside onto the bridge.

Look down to the left to see some broken stairs and a lower platform to the left of it. Drop down onto the stairs and follow the path inside.

Once back outside, do not walk along the bridge to the right. You will be thrown off and die. Instead continue down the path to find a ladder.

Climb the ladder and you will find Trusty Patches playing around with the lever here. Speak to him and when the option is given, you must select NO.

This will keep him as an ally for now. To the left of the ladder is an illusionary wall that you can hit and reveal a bonfire. You may rest and kindle, or continue on.

Return to the broken stairs and drop down to the ledge below it and then once again to the next lower area.

Pillage the corpse for the Great Scythe, then interact with the nearby lever to open some paths up close by.

Walk up the stairs in this dark area and you will need to head back outside through a doorway to the left.

Before this, you can loot various rooms here for 2 Souls of a Proud Knight. Head outside, drop off the broken stairs again to the lower level.

Drop through the empty grave on the left and head inside the nearby tomb. Walk directly forward inside and you will discover a Titanite Demon Loot it for a Demon Titanite, then loot the corpse that was behind it for 3 Eyes of Death. This should equal to or more than 10 in your inventory.

Walk back towards the exit and look to the right to see a coffin with the lid removed. Before jumping inside, you must have at least 10 Eyes of Death.

If you didn't acquire this many, you must return to the Depths and farm the Basilisks. Approach the coffin and nestle inside it. Wait a few moments and there will be a cutscene where you are taken away to the Tomb of the Giants.

Once you arrive, walk around this chasm until you find a giant sarcophagus. Pray to the sarcophagus Gravelord and enter the covenant with YES. You will now be a part of the Gravelord Servant covenant, unlocking the Gravelord Sword (23/48), Miracle: Gravelord Sword Dance (13/23) and Covenant: Gravelord Servant.

Offer the Gravelord 10 Eyes of Death and you will acquire Miracle: Gravelord Greatsword Dance (14/23).

Return to the coffin and nestle to be taken back to the Catacombs.

Walk outside of this tomb and look to the right for a path leading up. Avoid the Wisps or wait for them to explode, then follow the path around and enter the next tomb.

To the left is a broken wall. Roll through it and run through the stairs across into a small room. Beware as a Giant Skeleton will drop from above.

Ahead is a partially opened coffin. Loot the Darkmoon Seance Ring from inside it. This is important as it allows you to access a secret area in Anor Londo in the next section of the walkthrough.

Continue on through the path next to the coffin and at the top, climb the ladder to the right.

Pillage the corpse at the top for Miracle: Tranquil Walk of Peace (15/23). Drop through the empty grave to return to a previously accessed area. Return to the bridge where you dropped off to the broken stairs.

Walk into the next tomb and continue directly forward down some stairs. You will need to walk down the next set of stairs until they break away with a large pit below.

Hugging the right wall, walk off the ledge (don't roll) towards the rock sticking out of the wall. You will drop down to a ledge.

Next, walk off the ledge hugging the right wall to the corpse below. This corpse has a Green Titanite Shard.

Heal up and drop down again hugging the right wall and you will see a break in the floor. Drop down here for a cutscene.

Important NPC

Do not attack the upcoming skeleton blacksmith as he is used to upgrade weapons to Flame and Chaos infusions for two trophies. Killing or harming him will spoil his focus and prevent you from unlocking these trophies in this playthrough.

Speak to Vamos the Blacksmith and he will comment on the embers you have in your possession. First, give him the Large Flame Ember with YES. Leave, then speak to him again and give him the Chaos Flame Ember with YES.

Turn around, rest and kindle at the bonfire. Nearby is a hole in the wall, leave through this when you are ready to continue.

You may unequip the Divine Claymore+5 for something better for now if you like, or continue using it.

In this open chasm there are numerous Bonewheels that will most likely attack you all at once. Once they are all dead, head to the left first.

Enter the tomb and to your immediate left is an Undead Mage and his skeleton brethren. Climb the ladder to find two more Skeletons and two breakable floors in this room. Before dropping down, loot the corpse at the top of the next ladder for a Large Soul of a Nameless Soldier.

Drop through the floor and kill the Black Knight for a White Titanite Chunk. Loot the corpse for a Soul of a Proud Knight, then drop down back into the chasm.

The loot ahead on the upper ledge isn't worth the effort so ignore it and continue on towards the narrow path.

There is a very difficult boss through the next fog gate, so ensure you read the strategy below before you fight Pinwheel.

Equip your Tin Crystallization Catalyst and Crown of Dusk for the next fight if you want a good laugh. Enter the fog gate when you are ready to take down this boss.

Cast Pursuers and have Dark Bead at the ready, then drop down into the giant sarcophagus ahead. Watch the frightening cutscene and once over, run directly to Pinwheel.

As soon as you are close, Pursuers will fly off towards the boss, then cast Dark Bead to crush it. This is the strategy for this boss on NG+, just don't give it an opportunity to do anything.

You will acquire the Rite of Kindling from Pinwheel, which will allow you to kindle your bonfires further for 20 uses of the flask. The boss will also drop a Humanity and a Homeward Bone.

Unlocking the Rite of Kindling will also grant you the Rite of Kindling. Re-equip the Sunlight Maggot and Logan's Catalyst, then climb up the ladder to enter the Tomb of the Giants.

It is quite dark in this giant cave, so be careful where you step and take things slowly. Follow the Prism Stones and walk on the path ahead.

Walk across the coffin and in the darkness ahead is a Giant Skeleton. These ones don't get back up after you kill them.

To the left of the Giant Skeleton is the ledge of the path with a coffin below. Dropping down you can see a corpse below that has a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Nearby is a ladder that goes down, ignore this and climb the ladder built into a wall that leads back to the start of the area. Loot the corpse at the top of the dirt path for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.

Don't walk off, instead turn around and walk back down, looking down to the left for another corpse with 3 Eyes of Death, too little too late.

Drop down to the corpse next to the ladder that leads down for a Large Soul of a Proud Knight.
