When you drop down from this corpse you will take a large amount of fall damage, but there will be two Giant Skeletons at the bottom. Quickly kill them when you land.

Walk down the dirt path and you will come across a hole to the left with a ladder leading down. Climb down into this large tomb.

Inside will be numerous Giant Skeletons below. You can shoot them with a bow from the upper level if you like, but you can Plunge Attack them when they pile up at the ladder.

Pillage the corpses in this area for a Large Divine Ember (10/10) and a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Climb out of this tomb and back into the cave section to continue.

Walk along the narrow pathway ahead and you will be able to see a bonfire to the left. Drop down when you get closer and light the bonfire. Rest and kindle THREE times here. You will now have 20 Estus Flask+4 charges to use from this bonfire.

Levelling Up

This is going to be the final level up for this playthrough and mark the end of recommended levelling for the walkthrough. Any souls found for the remainder of the playthrough are recommended for use with upgrading weapons for Unique Weapons or infused weapon trophies. From the list of souls you should have, use the Soul Duplication Glitch with 2 Souls of a Great Hero, 2 Souls of a Hero, 2Large Souls of a Brave Warrior, 9 Souls of a Brave Warrior, 4 Large Souls of a Proud Knight and 7 Souls of a Proud Knight. DO NOT use any other soul items not listed.

Climb up the ladder and walk into the darkness. A familiar face will appear, Trusty Patches. Guess what? He has found a treasure and wants you to take it for yourself.

Approach the ledge with the Prism Stone and he will show you where the treasure is.

Loot the three corpses at the bottom for 2 Large Souls of a Proud Knight and a Skull Lantern.

To your right is a friendly NPC Rhea of Thorolund, who was last seen praying at Firelink Shrine. Speak to her and she will warn you that her two companions have gone Hollow.

Walk forward past Rhea to find her two companions. Eliminate them both with your spells before they attack her.

Speak with Rhea and she will thank you for saving her. She will give you Replenishment (16/23). She will leave to Undead Parish once you leave her.

Before continuing on with the main quest at hand, a detour is required to save Rhea of Thorolund again and acquire more Miracles.

Check the area before heading past where the Hollow companions were to find a White Titanite Chunk on a slope.

Beware of Bone Towers that may spawn in this area, but note that they drop White Titanite Chunks.

Follow the narrow path to a ladder and an illusionary wall. Hit and head right.

Return to Trusty Patches and speak to him. Forgive him when he begs you with YES. You could kill him, but you're a saint, stuck in a cave underground...

Wrong game. Use the nearby bonfire and warp to Firelink Shrine.

When you arrive, quit and reload your game. This will respawn an NPC in the area that will not be here otherwise.

Go to Petrus and KILL HIM immediately. He was going to kill Rhea of Thorolund for a special talisman, but you need her for Miracles.

Take the lift up to the Undead Parish and look to the left when you arrive at the altar from the beginning of the playthrough.

Rhea is praying here, but you can interrupt her for some purchases: Great Heal (17/23) for 10000 Souls Wrath of the Gods (18/23) for 10000 Souls Magic Barrier (19/23) for 6000 Souls If you want additional spells you can purchase the others she has as well. Return to Firelink Shrine and warp to Tomb of the Giants.

To the right of Trusty Patches is the path forward. You will notice a large skeleton on all fours, which is a Skeleton Beast.

Keep your distance at all costs as they can pack quite the punch and deal large damage. If you are game enough, you can guard and strike them with melee in between their attacks, or kill them with Soul Spear.

Enter the fog gate and run directly towards the item on the floor in the distance. Kill this Giant Skeleton and wait for a Black Knight to approach you from the direction of the fog gate (to the right).

Kill it and loot it for a White Titanite Chunk. You can loot the nearby corpse for a Soul of a Brave Warrior if interested.

Looking at where you came from the fog gate, to the right is another Skeleton Beast and a path leading down. Once down here, head right at the fork and follow the path.

At the end is a corpse with an Effigy Shield (24/48). Return to the fork and continue on straight.

Walk down the path to a lower area and you can see another Skeleton Beast to the right. Just past this to the left you can find a path winding around to the left.

Here is another bonfire that you can rest at and kindle three times. Attune the following spell:

Replace Great Soul Arrow (x1) with Fall Control

Walk back out to the Skeleton Beast and past it you can see a corpse with an item. This item is a Covetous Silver Serpent Ring. During this walkthrough souls are not an issue, so it will be ignored.

Walk down a pathway to the left and loot the corpse in the small nook to the right for a White Titanite Chunk.

Ahead will be some Skeleton Beasts you can ignore by walking to the right down a path. Underneath this path is a corpse with a Soul of a Brave Warrior.

Continue down the pathway until you find a ladder. Climb down this and walk along the path into a tunnel ahead. At this point you will be invaded by Dark Spirit Paladin Leeroy Jenkins.

Cast Pursuers and have Dark Bead at the ready. If he doesn't die to the first spell, finish him off with Dark Bead.

Loot his corpse for 2 Humanity, Grant (25/48) and Sanctus (26/48).

Through the tunnel you will be walking on a narrow ledge. There will be three Bone Towers and two Giant Skeletons ahead. Once you kill two of the towers, ignore the third as it will flee.

Run right past the Giant Skeletons as there is one to the left that will kick you straight off the ledge.

Turn around and kill them if you wish.

Inside the cavern ahead is numerous Pinwheels and infinitely spawning Skeleton Babies. The priority is to acquire the White Titanite Slab in this room and enter the fog gate at the top of the area.

Other loot in the room consists of 2Souls of a Hero.

On your way up to the fog gate, keep any eye out on the left wall as you run up the path. Enter the hole and at the back of the tunnel is a corpse with the final White Titanite Slab. This is final slab needed to acquire all weapon infusion trophies during this playthrough. If you acquired all mentioned previously, there will be no trophy requirement for them in NG+ and N++.

Approach the fog gate at the top of the path and equip the Divine Claymore+5 and Crown of Dusk.

Before fighting the next boss Gravelord Nito, please read the below strategy on how to defeat him.

Cast Fall Control to get things started and enter the fog gate. Drop down into the chasm below and watch the cutscene with Gravelord Nito. Once this cutscene is over, the boss has the ability to attack you within seconds, so beware.

The main attack to be concerned about is his Gravelord Dance. You will hear a woman's scream coming from Nito just before he strikes his weapon into the ground. Once you see the blade connect with the ground, roll to the left or right as a giant sword will come out of the ground.

Now that this attack is explained, shield up and take out the first three Skeletons with the Divine Claymore+5. They will remain dead once you kill them. Try not to advance further into the area as there are Giant Skeletons ahead.

From a distance, cast Pursuers and cast Crystal Soul Spear to kill him off quickly. You may supplement the magic with Dark Bead if you want to kill him with less spells.

Gravelord Nito has some dangerous attacks which are explained below. There will be no shield guarding as he will just hit straight through it.

He can slash and stab with his sword, which will inflict Toxic to you if hit multiple times. Roll out of the way of this attack when you see him raise or pull the sword back to his sides.

If you see him bow down, you must run away from him. He will cause a massive shockwave which will inflict large damage, break your Stamina and cause toxic if you fail to get away.

If you get close to him he has the ability to grab you, which can be negated by spamming L2 + R2 , or just stay away from him.

Upon defeat, you will acquire the Lord Soul from Gravelord Nito and a Humanity. You will also unlock the trophy Defeat Gravelord Nito.

Loot the corpse in this cavern for a Paladin Set, then light the nearby bonfire and warp to Firelink Shrine.

Walk towards the graveyard from earlier in this section and you will find Trusty Patches doing his signature squat.

Purchase the following from him: Crescent Axe (27/48) for 10000 Souls Any other item that you may be interested in.

Leave him and return to the bonfire. Warp to Anor Londo and kindle the bonfire there twice, then warp to Darkmoon Tomb to conclude this portion of the walkthrough.

Below is the checklist of items you should have acquired during this section of the playthrough.

Due to how missable these were, if you did not acquire the Miracles specifically, you will need to collect them during NG+ or onwards.

Crescent Axe Purchased from Trusty Patches. Grant Acquire by killing Dark Spirit Paladin Leeroy.

Gravelord Sword Join the Gravelord Servant covenant. Sanctus Acquire by killing Dark Spirit Paladin Leeroy.

Effigy Shield Found in the Tomb of the Giants. Replenishment Acquired from Rhea of Thorolund by saving her from Hollows.

Gravelord Sword Dance Join the Gravelord Servant covenant. Gravelord Greatsword Dance Reached Rank+1 in the Gravelord Servant covenant.

Tranquil Walk of Peace Found in the Catacombs. Wrath of the Gods Purchased from Rhea of Thorolund.

Magic Barrier Purchased from Rhea of Thorolund. Great Heal Purchased from Rhea of Thorolund.

h: Part 11: Dark Sun Gwyndolin, The Darkmoon God
t:
This section of the walkthrough will be quite short. You will join the final covenant for this playthrough, Blade of the Darkmoon and acquire the remaining Miracles that can be acquired as well. The remainder of cleanup will be performed during the next portion of the walkthrough.

Equip the Darkmoon Seance Ring whilst in the vicinity of the bonfire and the wall to the right of the corpse will disappear.

This will expose a secret area that has the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant. There is a fog gate inside which must not be entered.

As you approach the fog gate, Dark Sun Gwyndolin will demand you stop. After the dialogue you will be able to kneel at the alter to the Darkmoon.

Do this and agree to enter the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant with YES. Doing so will grant you a Blue Eye Orb, Darkmoon Blade Covenant Ring and Covenant: Blade of the Darkmoon.

Offer 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal to acquire Miracle: Darkmoon Blade (20/23) and the Darkmoon Talisman.

Equip the Hawk Ring and the Black Bow of Pharis+15 for the upcoming boss fight. You may equip any great bow if you have the ammo for it, making this boss fight go by quicker.

Please read the below strategy on how to easily defeat Dark Sun Gwyndolin. This boss will warp frequently, so an exploit will be used.

Dark Sun Gwyndolin is going to continually warp away from you as you get close to him, so fighting at close range can be troublesome. Additionally, he will use Soul Spear and Homing Soul Mass, both of which will track you and hit you through walls. He also has a tracking ranged bow attack as well.

To make things easier for yourself, you are going to Poison him from a distance with the bow. This will take anywhere from 10-15 minutes while you wait for the Poison to kill him.

You may supplement damage during this time with a great bow if you have one with ammo or upgraded (optional).

h: Part 11: Dark Sun Gwyndolin, The Darkmoon God
t:
Once you enter the fog gate and the cutscene is over, move forward and to the left, 2 pillars as shown in the video. Dark Sun Gwyndolin will warp away and be non-aggro. From here, you can begin shooting him with Poison Arrows. Watch his health bar to confirm the Poison has started taking his health.

Do not move forward from this position as he will aggro and begin his ranged attacks. Repeat the shooting and application of Poison until he is dead.

Once defeated, he will drop the Soul of Gwyndolin and you will acquire Defeat the Dark Sun Gwyndolin.

Continue on down the corridor for some items ahead.

Ahead are three chests in this giant tomb. The more important one is in the centre. Open it for Miracle:

Sunlight Blade (21/23). The chest on the right has a Brass Set and the left chest is empty. Return to the bonfire and warp to Anor Londo bonfire.

The Darkmoon Knightess will be hostile as you arrive, so kill her with any of your sorceries. She will drop a Fire Keeper Soul upon death.

The bonfire here is now inactive and cannot be used for the remainder of this playthrough. You won't be returning to this part of Anor Londo, so that's fine.

Warp to Daughter of Chaos to acquire another Fire Keeper Soul.

Kill Egg Carrier Eingyi, but beware of the Vile Maggots that appear when he dies. He drops 2 Egg Vermifuge.

Rest at the bonfire and kindle it twice. Once done, kill the Daughter of Chaos and loot the Fire Keeper Soul she drops.

Before leaving, loot the corpse in the hallway of this area for Thorns Set.

Walk to the Demon Ruins bonfire, kindle it three times and then warp to Firelink Shrine. Speak to Anastacia of Astora and reinforce your Estus Flask+4 to Estus Flask+6.

This is the end of this portion of the playthrough.

There were only two Miracles that were acquired during this short section of the walkthrough. If you didn't acquire them, you can retry during the next playthrough.

h: Part 11: Dark Sun Gwyndolin, The Darkmoon God
t:
Sunlight Blade Found in the Darkmoon Tomb in Anor Darkmoon Blade Reach Rank+1 with the Blade of the Londo.

Darkmoon Covenant.

This is the final section the first playthrough and you will defeat Gwyn, Lord of Cinder and conclude the story. Before this there will be some trophy cleanup and acquiring the remainder of the Unique Weapons for this playthrough.

Warp to Undead Parish for some cleanup prior to ending the first playthrough. Speak to Andre of Astora in preparation for some upgrades, giving him the Large Divine Ember when he asks for it.

Purchase the following: Caestus for 200 Souls. Longsword for 1000 Souls.

Weapon Upgrades

The below weapons are going to be used to upgrade to Unique Weapons or to special infused weapons, unlocking those respective trophies either during this playthrough, or NG+ and NG++. If you need more Large Titanite Shards, visit the Giant Blacksmith.

Knight Shield+5 to Knight Shield+10 Short Bow+5 to Short Bow+10 Greataxe to Greataxe+10 Caestus to Caestus+10 Halberd to Halberd+10 Great Club to Great Club+10 Longsword to Longsword+10 Partizan to Partizan+10 Ricard's Rapier to Ricard's Rapier+10 Straight Sword Hilt to Straight Sword Hilt+10 The infusion related upgrades will be upgraded once some farming has been completed. You will return to Andre shortly.

Once you have completed all of the above upgrades, head through into Darkroot Garden and return to the bonfire close to Alvina.

If you didn't acquire them earlier, you will need to farm the Giant Stone Knights until you have acquired the Stone Greatsword (28/48) and Stone Greatshield (29/48).

Remember you can equip the Covetous Gold Serpent Ring and Symbol of Avarice to boost your drop rates.

Warp to The Duke's Archives to farm another rare weapon.

From The Duke's Archives bonfire, look up the stair mechanism at the top of this library section. You will want it to be ascending from right to left.

Before farming, ensure you have your item discovery gear is equipped. To farm the Channeler without the unwanted attention of Crystal Hollows, climb up the ladder in the room to the right.

Run to the stair mechanism and interact with the handle. As the stairs are turning, run up and cast Dark Bead or Crystal Soul Spear at close range to the first Channeler.

Run down the stairs and kill the second Channeler using the same spell method. Once dead, return to the stair mechanism and interact with the handle to put it back to it's original position. Use a Homeward Bone to repeat the process as needed.

Upon successful farming you will acquire the Channeler's Trident (30/48). Do note that this weapon is extremely rare to find and may take a few runs to acquire.

Warp to the Chamber of the Princess and head to the Giant Blacksmith. When you speak to him he will ask for the Crystal Ember, which you should agree to with YES. Read below for a list of weapon modifications.

Once you have acquired all of the below Unique Weapons, warp to Firelink Shrine.

Weapon Upgrades

These unique weapons will be the only ones you can craft during this playthrough. During NG+ and NG++ you will be able to craft more using the Boss Souls you acquire.

Halberd+10 to Lifehunt Scythe (31/48) Partizan+10 to Dragonslayer Spear (32/48) Caestus+10 to Dragon Bone Fist (33/48)

Short Bow+10 to Darkmoon Bow (34/48) Ricard's Rapier+10 to Moonlight Butterfly Horn (35/48)

Once you arrive, head towards the graveyard and drop down the large open hole where the snake creature was previously.

This will drop you safely into the Firelink Altar.

In the next area you will be farming a few Black Knights for various Titanite Chunks. Rest at the Lordvessel and repair all of your equipment before moving on.

Offer all of the Lord Souls to the Lordvessel to open the doors ahead into the Kiln of the First Flame.

This is the final area of the game, and Gwyn, Lord of Cinder, is the final boss ahead. Prior to fighting him, you will need to farm the Black Knights in this area for the following: 14 Blue Titanite Chunks 14 White Titanite Chunks 14 Red Titanite Chunks 14 Titanite Chunks Black Knight Sword (36/48)

Black Knight Greatsword (37/48) Black Knight Greataxe (38/48) Black Knight Halberd (39/48) Black Knight Shield (40/48)

When farming these items, ensure you wear the required item discovery gear, then use a Homeward Bone to return to the Lordvessel once the five Black Knights are dead.

The first Black Knight is guaranteed to drop the following item: Titanite Chunk It also has the chance to drop the following items:

Black Knight Sword Black Knight Shield

The second Black Knight is guaranteed to drop the following item: Red Titanite Chunk It also has the chance to drop the following items:

Black Knight Greatsword Black Knight Shield

The third Black Knight is guaranteed to drop the following item: Titanite Chunk It also has the chance to drop the following items:

Black Knight Sword Black Knight Shield If you look to the right as you face this Black Knight you can see a corpse on a ledge. Loot this for the Black Knight Set.

The fourth Black Knight is guaranteed to drop the following item: White Titanite Chunk It also has the chance to drop the following items:

Black Knight Greataxe Black Knight Shield

The fifth Black Knight is guaranteed to drop the following item: Blue Titanite Chunk It also has the chance to drop the following items:

Black Knight Halberd Black Knight Shield

Once you have acquired the required items mentioned, leave the Kiln of the First Flame and warp to Undead Parish.

Speak to Andre of Astora for the final time during this playthrough and upgrade the mentioned weapons below.

Weapon Upgrades

Divine Claymore+5 to Divine Claymore+10 Occult Club to Occult Club+5 Lightning Spear to Lightning Spear+10 Crystal Halberd to Crystal Halberd+5 Upgrading these weapons will unlock Crystal Weapon, Lightning Weapon, Divine Weapon and Occult Weapon trophies for these infusions.

Once these trophies have unlocked, warp to the Catacombs bonfire. Speak to Vamos the Blacksmith and upgrade the following items below. Some weapons will need to be upgraded to +5 before you can infuse them.

Weapon Upgrades

Dagger to Dagger+5 to Fire Dagger to Zweihander to Zweihander+5 to Fire Dagger+5 to Chaos Dagger to Zweihander to Fire Zweihander+10 Chaos Dagger+5 Upgrading these weapons will unlock Fire Weapon and Chaos Weapon trophies for these infusions.

Warp to Firelink Shrine and venture down into New Londo Ruins. Instead of heading left once you reach the first area, look over the right side to find some stairs leading down.

Walk down the stairs and speak to the captive NPC, Rickert of Vinheim. Leave the conversation once the menu appears, then speak to him again, then select YES to give him the Large Magic Ember. Do the same for the Enchanted Ember.

You can purchase items from him if you wish, but more importantly, upgrade the following weapons below.

Weapon Upgrades

Composite Bow to Composite Bow+5 to Enchanted Falchion to Enchanted Magic Composite Bow to Magic Falchion+5 Composite Bow+10 Upgrading these weapons will unlock Magic Weapon and Enchanted Weapon for these infusions.

Walk back up to Firelink Shrine and rest at the bonfire. Before ending this playthrough it is recommended you warp around to all the bonfires and upgrade them and all of the non-warping ones that you can find. This will make NG+ and NG++ a bit more easier, as you will have 20 Estus Flasks to use for your playthroughs.

This is only a recommendation, but it is worth the effort.

Drop down into the Firelink Altar and rest at the Lordvessel. Head into Kiln of the First Flame and kill all of the Black Knights in this area.

Please read below on the strategy for defeating Gwyn, Lord of Cinder and completing your first playthrough.

Multiple Endings

You may use Cloud Save or a USB Device to backup your save once you have defeated Gwyn, Lord of Cinder. The reason for this is to acquire both ending trophies now, rather than later. Players who acquired their Unique Weapons or Covenant Items through trade could limit their playthrough to 1 with this method. If playing solo offline, you still need to complete one more full playthrough, so the choice is yours.

Complete Ending A unlocking the respective trophy, then download your backup save. Complete Ending B to acquire the other story related trophy.

Begin by summoning Knight Solaire from the top of the stairs leading down to the fog gate. He will be great in this fight to take the heat off you from Gwyn, Lord of Cinder. On the next playthrough, Solaire will take significant damage from the boss, so be quick killing Gwyn.

Walk down to the fog gate and wait for Solaire to be directly behind you before entering (unlike the video above). Gwyn will always run towards you and perform a leaping slash attack.

Once he performs this, back away from him and run behind or close to Solaire. Odds are that Solaire will hit him with a Lightning Spear and draw aggro, or Gwyn just changes. Keep your Havel's Shield+5 up at all times to tank all of his attacks.

Wait until Gwyn has performed any of his attacks, then get behind him and cast Dark Bead at point-blank range to destroy his health. After 2-3 casts he will be ashes.

This will be a very underwhelming fight with your current stats and will be over very quickly.

One thing to mention is to be careful of Gwyn's grab attack, this will deal a bit of damage and will ignore your shields. He will usually perform this if you are close to him and have his attention.

Additionally, you don't have to parry as shown in the video above. The Guide Author just wanted to go out with a bang for the final boss fight video of this playthrough.

At the conclusion of this battle, you will acquire the Soul of Gwyn, Lord of Cinder. If Knight Solaire survived this fight, you will also acquire a Sunlight Medal.

Please see below for the two ending options. If this is your second playthrough, select the opposite to what you chose the first time.

Approach the bonfire in the middle of the area and press to link the fire. This is considered the good ending.

This will unlock the trophy To Link the Fire.

Ending B

Leave through the doorway that you entered the boss area with. This is considered the bad ending.

This will unlock the trophy Dark Lord.

Some additional information to be aware of, enemies in NG+ and NG++ will deal increased amounts of damage, including all bosses. Particular attention must be paid to not get hit as much during these playthroughs as you may find you can die quite quickly. For bosses, strategies that require tanking hits should be replaced with rolling or dodging where applicable.

Do note that you can craft all of the Unique Weapons during NG++, but you might as well get them out of the way right now. Included is an additional piece of info to skip a certain section of the game as well.

When you reach the Undead Parish you must rejoin the Warrior of Sunlight covenant. Offer your 10 Sunlight Medals to the altar for Great Lightning Spear (22/23).

Offer the Soul of Gwyn, Lord of Cinder to the altar for Sunlight Spear (23/23). You will unlock Prayer of a Maiden.

Once you ring the First Bell of Awakening return to Firelink Shrine and head into New Londo Ruins.

Walk to the right side of the first area and use the shortcut to Valley of Drakes with the Master Key.

You can skip Lower Undead Burg, Depths and the majority of Blighttown by crossing the bridge and entering through the previous top exit.

When you reach the Ornstein & Smough boss fight, you must kill Ornstein first this time around. This will allow you to fight Super Smough and acquire the Soul of Smough.

The fight is basically the same but Super Smough is slower than his ally. With your end-game stats from the first playthrough you will be able to spam Pursuers and Dark Bead to defeat him.

For this playthrough you can completely skip the Demon Firesage and the Centipede Demon if you wish. You may use the shortcut by giving the Daughter of Chaos another 30 Humanity.

The downside to doing this is you won't have Solaire of Astora to help you with Gwyn, Lord of Cinder.

If you choose to fight the Centipede Demon again during NG+, summon Solaire of Astora to fight with you.

Instead of hugging the wall in the boss room, this time you will want to keep your shield up and get close to the Centipede Demon.

Spam Pursuers and Dark Bead to defeat it, either when it is focused on Solaire, or when it jumps and slams. Just remember to stay out of the lava, and maybe positioning onto the larger island is preferable.
